izzyondroid:com.vpnhood.client.android.w.name: VpnHood! CLIENT: Self-host VPN
izzyondroid:com.vpnhood.client.android.w.summary: Self-hosted, secure, and open-source VPN client (require server key)
izzyondroid:com.vpnhood.client.android.w.description:
NOTE: This app REQUIRES A SERVER KEY.
 VpnHood! CLIENT is a fast, secure, and reliable VPN solution powered by the ★★VpnHood! ENGINE★★, which is open-source and the first VPN developed fully with the .NET platform.
 It is a client application that establishes encrypted, secure tunnels to a VPN server using the VpnHood protocol to VpnHood servers. The VpnHood protocol has no fingerprint and cannot be detected by censorship filtering.
 To use this app, a ServerKey is required. You can acquire one through the following methods:
 ▶ Get server keys from friends or communities that distribute them.
 ▶ Purchase server keys for yourself or your friends from third-party sellers.
 ▶ Set up your own VpnHood server on a hosting service and create server keys yourself.
 Key Features:
 ★ Free with No Ads: VpnHood! is open-source, completely free, and contains no ads.
 ★ Easy to Use: You can connect to VpnHood! with a simple click of the connect button.
 ★ Fast and Secure (The speed may vary depending on the server provider and your Internet connection.)
 ★ Open Source: Built on the open-source VpnHood engine (on GitHub), VpnHood! is transparent and trustworthy.
 ★ First VPN in .NET: VpnHood! is the first VPN app in the world to be developed with the .NET platform—showcasing innovation and technical excellence.
 ★ Broad Compatibility: Supports Android 6 and above, including Android TV and Windows.
 ★ IPv4 & IPv6 Support: Ensures maximum compatibility and performance.
 Customizable Options:
 ✔ Split Tunneling for App: Choose which apps use VpnHood! with flexible filter options. You can exclude, include, or select all apps.
 ✔ Split Tunneling for Country: Keep traffic to your own country outside the tunnel, so local services that reject foreign IPs keep working and local connections stay fast.
 ✔ Split Tunneling for Local Network: Exclude your local network to maintain access to local resources while using VpnHood!.
 ✔ TCP, UDP & QUIC: Choose the transport protocol that performs best on your network.
 ✔ Proxy Support: Route your connection through SOCKS or HTTP proxies, entered manually or taken from your device settings.
 Why Choose VpnHood!?
 ▶ Undetectable: The VpnHood! protocol is designed to bypass censorship filters. It is a secure protocol without any fingerprint. Its traffic patterns look exactly like regular HTTPS websites, making it virtually indistinguishable.
 ▶ Constantly Evolving: VpnHood! is committed to continuous improvement and innovation, ensuring you enjoy unrestricted and censorship-free internet access. Try VpnHood! today and experience the true freedom of the web!
 Your Privacy:
 VpnHood! CLIENT does not require an account and never asks for personal information. We do not log your browsing activity, the websites you visit, or the content of your traffic.
 The app can send anonymous usage and diagnostic data - such as app version, language, connection results and error messages - so we can find and fix problems. It is identified only by a random id that is not linked to you, and you can turn it off at any time in Settings > Privacy. We never sell your data or share it with third parties for their own purposes.
 Privacy Policy: https://www.vpnhood.com/privacy-policy
 We’re Here for You Around the Clock!
 VpnHood’s dedicated customer support team is available 24/7 to assist you. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us at support@vpnhood.com . We’re always here to help!

fdroid:com.vonglasow.michael.satstat.name: SatStat
fdroid:com.vonglasow.michael.satstat.description:
A diagnostic tool that displays data reported by sensors in the phone.
GPS and other location providers:
* Refresh AGPS data (if supported by phone) either manually, or when a new data connection is detected
* Status notification whenever an app accesses GPS (configurable)
* Location, speed, bearing and error
* Satellites in view and satellites used
* Signal-to-noise ration (SNR) for each satellite
* Time to first fix and time of last fix
* Map view for comparison of different location providers
Sensors (as supported by your phone):
* Accelerometer (acceleration and gravity)
* Rotation
* Magnetic field
* Orientation (azimuth, pitch and roll)
* Ambient temperature
* Pressure
* Relative humidity
* Ambient light
* Proximity
Networks:
* GSM/CDMA/LTE cells in range with network type and signal strength
* WiFi networks in range, with encryption type, channel and signal strength
Known limitations:
* Some phones will report only the network cell with which they are currently registered. On such phones you will only see one cell under "GSM" or "CDMA". This is a limitation of the phone's radio firmware, and SatStat has no way of getting more information from the device.
* Some devices ignore the command to refresh AGPS data. This is a limitation of the GPS driver (which varies from device to device and is usually proprietary). Starting with version 2.0, SatStat has a workaround in place for automatic AGPS updates.

fdroid:org.ghostsinthelab.app.rakurakuim.description:
RakuRaku IME is a modern rebuild of the classic EZ Input Method (輕鬆輸入法)
for Android, built with Jetpack Compose and Room. Type Traditional Chinese
using 高衡緒's shape-based radical system, with a live candidate bar and
near-instant prefix matching powered by a full-text-search dictionary that
ships pre-packaged inside the app — no initial download required.
Features
* Full EZ radical layout with phrase composing rules.
* English word prediction backed by the Google 10K common-word corpus.
* Emoji keyboard with eight categories and 1,184 emojis.
* Dialer-style number pad.
* Split keyboard in landscape, adjustable height, optional keypress vibration.
* Material You theming on Android 12+, with a Solarized fallback on older
 devices or by user choice.
* Traditional Chinese (臺灣) and English UI; per-app language picker on
 Android 13+.
* Fully offline — no network access, no analytics, no tracking. Your
 keystrokes never leave the device.
Credits
* Dictionary data by 高衡緒 and 輕鬆資訊企業社 (no longer operational),
 distributed under GPLv2 and the 《輕鬆資訊「輕鬆輸入法大詞庫」公眾授權書》.
* English word list: Josh Kaufman's Google 10000 English (MIT).
* Emoji layout: adapted from the MeaninglessKeyboard project (GPL-3.0).
This app is free software, licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.
Source code and issue tracker: https://github.com/hiroshiyui/RakuRakuIME

flathub:at.vintagestory.VintageStory.description:
To play this game, you must purchase an account at
 https://www.vintagestory.at/.
 Vintage Story is an uncompromising wilderness survival sandbox game
 inspired by lovecraftian horror themes. Find yourself in a ruined
 world reclaimed by nature and permeated by unnerving temporal
 disturbances. Relive the advent of human civilization, or take your
 own path.

flathub:chat.quadrix.Quadrix.name: Quadrix
flathub:chat.quadrix.Quadrix.summary: Minimal, simple, multi-platform chat client for the Matrix protocol
flathub:chat.quadrix.Quadrix.description:
- No data collection
 - Completely free, no ads
 - Does not support End-to-End Encryption
 - Video-conferencing (uses Element Call -- https://github.com/vector-im/element-call#readme)
 - Desktop apps for Windows, MacOS, and Linux (amd64, arm64, armhf)
 - Mobile apps for Android and iOS
 - Unique top-down messaging feed
 - Ideally used with a private Matrix homeserver -- https://matrix.org/docs/guides/installing-synapse
 - Open source on github -- https://github.com/alariej/quadrix
 - Interested to sponsor this project? -- https://github.com/sponsors/alariej

flathub:com.github.unrud.djpdf.name: Scans to PDF
flathub:com.github.unrud.djpdf.summary: Create small, searchable PDFs from scanned documents
flathub:com.github.unrud.djpdf.description:
Create small, searchable PDFs from scanned documents. The program divides images into bitonal
 foreground images (text) and a color background image, then compresses them separately. An invisible
 OCR text layer is added, making the PDF searchable.
 Color and grayscale scans need some preparation for good results. Recommended tools are Scan
 Tailor or GIMP.
 A GUI and command line interface are included.

flathub:com.heroicgameslauncher.hgl.name: Heroic
flathub:com.heroicgameslauncher.hgl.summary: Play Epic, GOG and Amazon Games
flathub:com.heroicgameslauncher.hgl.description:
Heroic is an Open Source Games Launcher. Right now it supports launching games from the
 Epic Games Store using Legendary, GOG Games using our custom implementation with gogdl
 and Amazon Games using Nile.
 Main Features:
 Have access to your Epic, GOG and Amazon Games in a intuitive User Interface.
 Add Games outside GOG, Amazon or Epic Games Store native or not. Even Browser apps
 are supported
 A Download queue to download multiple games at once.
 Install and launch your Windows Games using Wine or Proton. Or Launch your Native
 GOG Games.
 Cloud Saves support for GOG and Epic Games.
 Import Games installed through the Epic Store or GOG Galaxy.
 Verify and Repair corrupted installations or even move your installation to
 different folders.
 Integrated Proton/Wine Manager for easy installation of new and updated ones
 Integrated Winetricks
 Support for install and uninstall of Games DLCs
 Access the Epic and GOG store and also Heroic Wiki directly from the App.
 Check Metacritic, IGCB or OpenCritic score for the game.
 And many more features
 Current Limitations on the Flatpak:
 Due to issues with controller on SteamDeck Gaming Mode Heroic uses Flatpak Runtime 23.08 on stable branch. If you need runtime 24.08 to have HDR support and more please use the beta branch of flathub.
 Heroic will not find or use Wine and Proton Flatpak versions. At least for now.
 For now would be better to use the Built-in Wine Manager to download and install
 Wine and Proton Versions.
 It should find Proton from the Steam folder for both Steam Flatpak and non-Flatpak
 if they are on installed on the library inside your $HOME folder
 Heroic cannot access /usr/bin so it won't be able to find any wine or proton
 isntalled there for now.

flathub:com.mastropaolo.www.tabela.name: Tabëla
flathub:com.mastropaolo.www.tabela.summary: Format tables to Markdown or HTML
flathub:com.mastropaolo.www.tabela.description: A really small utility to format tables coming from spreadsheets (or manually typed) into Markdown or HTML. Input can be any text separated by TAB, commas or semicolon and it can output the table formatted for Markdown (and ASCII art) or plain HTML. For use with spreadsheets, simply copy the spreadsheet cells, and paste it into the upper text area. Handles large tables reasonably well.

flathub:com.nextcloud.desktopclient.next.name: Nextcloud Desktop Client
flathub:com.nextcloud.desktopclient.next.summary: Sync and collaborate on your desktop or laptop
flathub:com.nextcloud.desktopclient.next.description:
The Nextcloud desktop client keeps photos and documents always up to date, enabling you to work

flathub:edu.stanford.protege.name: Protégé
flathub:edu.stanford.protege.description:
Protégé Desktop is a feature rich ontology editing environment with
 full support for the OWL 2 Web Ontology Language, and direct
 in-memory connections to description logic reasoners like HermiT and
 Pellet.
 Protégé Desktop supports creation and editing of one or more
 ontologies in a single workspace via a completely customizable user
 interface. Visualization tools allow for interactive navigation of
 ontology relationships. Advanced explanation support aids in
 tracking down inconsistencies. Refactor operations available
 including ontology merging, moving axioms between ontologies, rename
 of multiple entities, and more.

flathub:io.gitlab.liferooter.TextPieces.name: Text Pieces
flathub:io.gitlab.liferooter.TextPieces.description:
Powerful scratchpad with ability to perform a lot of text transformations, such as:
 Calculate hashes
 Encode text
 Decode text
 Remove trailing spaces and lines
 Count lines, symbols and words
 Format JSON and XML
 Escape and unescape strings
 Convert JSON to YAML and vice versa
 Filter lines
 And so on.
 The application is extendable with your own script-based actions.

flathub:me.proton.Pass.name: Proton Pass
flathub:me.proton.Pass.summary: Encrypted password manager to keep your login credentials safe
flathub:me.proton.Pass.description:
Get the password manager created by the scientists who met at CERN behind Proton Mail, the world’s
 largest encrypted email provider. Proton Pass is open source, end-to-end encrypted, and protected
 by Swiss privacy laws.
 Pass offers more than other free password managers and has no ads or data collection. You can
 use it for free forever on all your devices to create and store unlimited passwords, autofill logins,
 generate 2FA codes, create email aliases, secure your notes, and more.
 How can Proton Pass be free forever?
 We offer Pass for free because everyone deserves online privacy and security. This is possible
 thanks to our supportive community on paid plans. If you would like to support our work and get
 access to premium features, consider upgrading your plan.
 Protect more than just your passwords.
 Join over 100 million people who have signed up for Proton’s privacy ecosystem, which includes
 Proton Mail, Proton Drive, Proton Calendar, Proton VPN, and more. Take back control of your privacy
 online with our encrypted email, calendar, file storage, and VPN.
 Protect your logins and their metadata with battle-tested end-to-end encryption
 While many other password managers only encrypt your password, Proton Pass uses end-to-end encryption
 on all your stored login details (including your username, the website address, and more). Pass
 protects your information with the same battle-tested encryption libraries all Proton services
 use.
 Audit Pass’s open-source code
 Like all other Proton services, Pass is open source and built on the principle of trust through
 transparency. As scientists, we know that transparency and peer review lead to better security.
 All Proton Pass apps are open source, meaning anyone can verify our security claims for themselves.
 With Proton Pass, you can:
 Store and auto-sync unlimited logins on unlimited devices: You can create, store, and manage
 your credentials from anywhere with our browser extensions and apps for Android and iPhone/iPad.
 Sign in faster with Proton Pass autofill: You no longer need to copy and paste your username
 and password. Easily and securely log in with Proton Pass autofill technology.
 Avoid weak passwords: With our built-in secure password generator, you can easily generate
 strong, unique, and random passwords based on the security requirements for every website you
 sign up to.
 Safely store encrypted notes: You can save private notes in Pass and access them on all your
 devices.
 Protect Proton Pass with biometric login access: You can add an extra layer of protection
 to Proton Pass by using your fingerprint or face to unlock the app.
 Create unique email addresses with hide-my-email aliases: Proton Pass helps you hide your
 personal email address with email aliases. Keep spam out of your inbox, avoid being tracked everywhere,
 and protect yourself from data breaches.
 Make 2FA easy with our built-in authenticator: With Pass’s integrated 2FA authenticator,
 using 2FA is finally fast and convenient. Easily add a 2FA code for any website and autofill
 it when you log in.
 Easily organize and share your sensitive data with vaults: Manage your logins, secure notes,
 and email aliases with vaults. Share individual items or an entire vault with your family, friends,
 or colleagues.
 Quick offline access to your login data: Access your stored passwords and notes in Pass from
 wherever you are, even when your phone has no internet connection.
 Secure your Pass account with additional security measures: Protect all your data with another
 layer of protection, either with TOTP or U2F/FIDO2 security keys.
 Get unlimited email forwards: There’s no limit on the number of emails you can have forwarded
 from your alias to your inbox.

flathub:net.sourceforge.wavbreaker.name: wavbreaker
flathub:net.sourceforge.wavbreaker.summary: GUI tool to split WAV, MP2 and MP3 files
flathub:net.sourceforge.wavbreaker.description:
wavbreaker's purpose in life is to take a WAV file and break it up
 into multiple WAV files. It makes a clean break at the correct position
 to burn the files to an Audio CD without any dead air between the tracks.
 wavbreaker also supports breaking up MP2 and MP3 files without re-encoding
 meaning it's fast and there is no generational loss. Decoding (using mpg123)
 is only done for playback and waveform display.
 The GUI displays a waveform summary of the entire file at the top. The middle
 portion displays a zoomed-in view that allows you to select where to start
 playing and where it will make the break. The bottom portion contains a list
 of track breaks. You may change file names and uncheck parts that you do not
 want to have written out to disk when saving.
 There is also a command line tool wavmerge to merge WAV files together.
 If you download a show and don't like how it was tracked, you can merge them
 together with wavmerge and then break them back up with wavbreaker. The
 wavmerge tool will only work on files that have the same format (for example,
 44.100 Hz sample rate, 16-bit sample size, etc.).

flathub:org.cznic.Datovka.name: Datovka
flathub:org.cznic.Datovka.description:
Datovka is a multiplatform desktop application for accessing data boxes.
 A data box is an electronic storage site in Czech Republic. It is intended
 for delivery of official documents and for communication with public
 authority bodies.
 Datovka allows receiving, sending, and checking the integrity of data messages,
 exporting proofs of delivery or full messages, exporting complete
 correspondence for a defined period, etc.
 The user interface resembles the interface of common e-mail clients.
 This flatpak is not maintained by CZ.NIC, z.s.p.o.

flathub:org.gnome.Crosswords.Editor.name: Crossword Editor
flathub:org.gnome.Crosswords.Editor.description:
A tool for authoring and editing pencil-and-paper style
 puzzles. Its features include:
 Creates Crosswords, Cryptics, Barred, and Acrostic puzzles
 Loads and saves .ipuz file format
 Suggests words when creating grids
 Autofill functionality and theme word best-fit
 Word definitions and indicator hints for writing clues
 Grid overlays for spell checking, unchecked cells, and dead cells
 Style support for individual cells
 Puzzle preview and printing

flathub:org.gnome.Tali.name: Tali
flathub:org.gnome.Tali.description:
A variation on poker with dice and less money, this game is a family classic.
 Throw the dice three times in a row, holding back the ones you like, in order
 to make the best possible hand. You can also play a lesser-known variant with
 colored dice.
 Play between one and five opponents at three difficulty levels.

flathub:org.mapeditor.Tiled.name: Tiled
flathub:org.mapeditor.Tiled.description:
Tiled is a general purpose 2D level editor with powerful tile map editing
 features. It’s built to be easy to use and is suitable for many type of
 games.
 The Tiled map format is supported by a large amount of game engines and
 libraries. In addition, Tiled supports plugins to read and write map formats
 other than its own map format.

flathub:org.upnproutercontrol.UPnPRouter.name: UPnP Router Control
flathub:org.upnproutercontrol.UPnPRouter.summary: A simple program that manages UPnP compliant routers
flathub:org.upnproutercontrol.UPnPRouter.description:
A GTK application to access some parameters of the router like:
 the network speed, the external IP and the model name. It can manage
 port forwarding through a simple GUI interface.
 UPnP Router Control uses the Internet Gateway Device Protocol v1,
 so UPnP it must be enabled on your router in order to use its functions.

firefox-addons:2669328.summary:
Effortless legal access to full text scholarly articles: 
Open Access Helper will help you identify legal open access copies of academic articles, using unpaywall.org and other sources.
firefox-addons:2669328.description:
Open Access Helper: Effortless Access to Scholarly Articles
 Stop Hitting Paywalls 
You find the perfect paper. Then you see a paywall. Open Access Helper solves this problem. It automatically finds a free, legal version of the article instead. It uses data from Unpaywall and other trusted sources to find open access copies of scientific papers.
 How It Works 
When you open a research article, Open Access Helper checks it automatically. It looks for the article's DOI (a unique code for the paper) and searches for a free version.
If a free version exists, a badge appears. Just click the badge to open the article.
Before you click, you can hover over the badge to see what type of version it is:
 Published Version – the final, official version
 Accepted Version – the version accepted after peer review, before final formatting
 Submitted Version – the first version submitted by the authors
 Easy Access Through Your University 
Does your university use EZProxy or OpenAthens? Set your university's domain one time (for example: harvard.edu ). After that, one click connects you to your university library, even when you're off campus.
 Safe and Private 
All links go to official, legal copies of the articles. We do not collect personal data. We only collect anonymous usage statistics, to help us improve the extension.
👉 Install Open Access Helper today and spend less time searching, more time reading.

bluejetty:00068089:ios.summary: An essay is, generally, a piece of writing that gives the author's own argument — but the definition is vague, overlapping with those of a paper, an article, a pamphlet, and a short story. Essays have traditionally been sub-classified as fo
bluejetty:00068089:ios.description:
An essay is, generally, a piece of writing that gives the author's own argument — but the definition is vague, overlapping with those of a paper, an article, a pamphlet, and a short story. Essays have traditionally been sub-classified as formal and informal. Formal essays are characterized by "serious purpose, dignity, logical organization, length," whereas the informal essay is characterized by "the personal element (self-revelation, individual tastes and experiences, confidential manner), humor, graceful style, rambling structure, unconventionality or novelty of theme," etc.
Essays are commonly used as literary criticism, political manifestos, learned arguments, observations of daily life, recollections, and reflections of the author. Almost all modern essays are written in prose, but works in verse have been dubbed essays (e.g., Alexander Pope's An Essay on Criticism and An Essay on Man). While brevity usually defines an essay, voluminous works like John Locke's An Essay Concerning Human Understanding and Thomas Malthus's An Essay on the Principle of Population are counterexamples.
In some countries (e.g., the United States and Canada), essays have become a major part of formal education. Secondary students are taught structured essay formats to improve their writing skills; admission essays are often used by universities in selecting applicants, and in the humanities and social sciences essays are often used as a way of assessing the performance of students during final exams.
The concept of an "essay" has been extended to other media beyond writing. A film essay is a movie that often incorporates documentary filmmaking styles and focuses more on the evolution of a theme or idea. A photographic essay covers a topic with a linked series of photographs that may have accompanying text or captions.
This is an offline app that helps read and improve your English Skills.
There are 25+ Essay categories which are very helpful for Class 9, 10, 12 and Junior College Students.
This Application provides you thousands of latest topic essays in 300 to 1000 words.
Using this application student can learn how to write an essay and how to perform on stage.
This application will be helpful for both IELTS academic / IELTS general students and TOEFL Essays.

bluejetty:00035816:ios.description:
أهلا بكم إلى التطبيق الأكثر حماية لملفاتكم الخاصة! برنامج قفل الصور والفيديو الذي يستخدمه الملايين حول العالم!
هل تريد حماية ملفاتك بعيدا عن المتطفلين وخارج البوم الصور الخاص بك؟ برنامج قفل الصور والفيديو مناسب لك. بعد اختيار الصور والفيديو الخاصة بك ووضعها داخل هذا التطبيق، لن يستطيع أحد الوصول إليها حتى لو تم أخذ الهاتف منك وهو غير مقفول. هل تخشى من تسريبات الملفات المتكررة؟ لا تقلق بعد الآن! بإمكانك حفظ الصور في مكان لا يصله أحد غيرك.
يمكنك التطبيق من حماية اي صورة او فيديو برقم سري أو باستخدام تعريفات البصمة والوجه، وحفظ الصور والفيديوهات في البومات مختلفة مخصصة، وخاصية استرجاع الملفات حتى بعد حذف التطبيق. حمل التطبيق لتتمتع بالمميزات التالية: 
- حفظ الصور والفيديوهات وحمايتها بكلمة سر
- الحماية باستخدام البصمة وتعريف الوجه
- خاصية معرفة من حاول الدخول إلى جهازك (مجانية)
- استعراض الصور من داخل التطبيق بمتصفح سلس
- مشاهدة الفيديوهات بداخل التطبيق بمستعرض فيديو سريع
- اضافة البومات مختلفة لتصنيف ملفاتك
- امكانية اعادة الصور والفيديو من التطبيق الى مكتبة الجهاز لاحقا
- إمكانية استرجاع كلمة السر باستخدام البريد الإلكتروني
- إمكانية استرجاع الملفات حتى بعد حذف التطبيق أو فقدان الهاتف*
*خاصية الاسترجاع مشمولة بنسخة البريميوم التي تضمن لك الميزات التالية:
- تطبيق خالي من الإعلانات
- جميع الأيقونات متاحة للاستخدام
- أكثر من 100 غيغابايت تخزين سحابي لخدمات استرجاع الصور والفيديو في حالة فقدان الجهاز
- جميع المزايا والخصائص المستقبلية
التطبيق مجاني وسهل الاستخدام، قم بتحديد كلمة سر عند فتح التطبيق لأول مرة ثم أضف الصور والفيديوهات من مكتبة الجهاز وتحكم بمستوى الخصوصية من الشاشات المختلفة. أضف بريدك الإلكتروني لخدمة استرجاع كلمة السر في حال نسيانها.
ما الذي يجعلنا الأفضل؟
- تطوير مستمر للحماية وإضافة الخصائص للتطبيق
- خدمة دعم فني مستمرة لجميع المستخدمين عن طريق الصفحة الإلكترونية والبريد الإلكتروني
- واجهة مستخدم أنيقة جميلة سهلة الاستخدام والتنقل 
- واجهة مستخدم ليلية لتصفح مريح
للأسئلة والدعم الفني الرجاء التواصل معنى عبر البريد الإلكتروني:

bluejetty:00062674:ios.description:
Original simulator of ship-handling, maneuvering and mooring to a pier with tugboats. 
30 high-detailed ships, included passenger ships, cruise liners, cargo ships, battleships and aircraft carriers, from historical steam ships of 19th century till modern nuclear. 
Realistic control of single and multi-screw vessels (including famous Titanic, Britannic 1874 and 1914, Carpathia, Mauretania, Aquitania, Californian) and azimuth propulsion.
Maneuvering with thrusters. 
Mooring the vessel to the berth using two tugboats with separate control.
Departure from the berth and arrive into target area. 
Narrow-swimming, bypass of hazards, minefields, passing with other AI vessels. 
Sea marks of hazards and channels according to international rules.
Day and night modes, different environment and weather conditions, calm or storm water with ocean waves and icebergs.
Sandbox mode. You can create and pass your own levels.
Damage and sinking of ships at collisions, splitting in half while sinking.

bluejetty:00018528:ios.description:
24HMoney – Chứng khoán, cổ phiếu và đầu tư trong một ứng dụng
24HMoney là ứng dụng chứng khoán dành cho nhà đầu tư muốn theo dõi cổ phiếu, phân tích chứng khoán và phát hiện cơ hội đầu tư mỗi ngày. Ứng dụng kết hợp dữ liệu chứng khoán, phân tích cổ phiếu, bộ lọc cổ phiếu, cảnh báo biến động và tin tức thị trường trong cùng một nơi.
Thay vì phải chuyển qua nhiều nguồn, bạn có thể xây dựng một quy trình theo dõi rõ ràng hơn: mở bảng giá để nắm nhịp thị trường, kiểm tra mã cổ phiếu đang quan tâm, đọc tin tức liên quan, đối chiếu dữ liệu và dùng công cụ phân tích trước khi tự đưa ra quyết định đầu tư.
THEO DÕI THỊ TRƯỜNG CHỨNG KHOÁN VIỆT NAM
• Cập nhật bảng giá chứng khoán realtime cho VN-Index, HNX và UPCOM
• Theo dõi diễn biến của nhiều mã cổ phiếu quan trọng trên thị trường Việt Nam
• Quan sát giá, biến động và thông tin đáng chú ý trong phiên
• Quay lại nhanh với các mã cổ phiếu bạn đang quan tâm
TIN TỨC CHỨNG KHOÁN VÀ TÀI CHÍNH
• Cập nhật tin tức chứng khoán, tin tức tài chính và diễn biến thị trường từ nhiều nguồn
• Theo dõi nội dung liên quan đến doanh nghiệp và cổ phiếu đang nghiên cứu
• Nắm bối cảnh thị trường trước khi đánh giá một cơ hội đầu tư
• Giảm thời gian tổng hợp thông tin rời rạc trong ngày
PHÂN TÍCH CỔ PHIẾU VÀ DỮ LIỆU
• Xem phân tích cổ phiếu và phân tích kỹ thuật cho quá trình nghiên cứu
• Đọc báo cáo tài chính và tham khảo dữ liệu doanh nghiệp
• Sử dụng biểu đồ và tín hiệu kỹ thuật để quan sát diễn biến của từng mã
• Kết hợp dữ liệu chứng khoán với tin tức thay vì nhìn giá riêng lẻ
CẢNH BÁO VÀ THEO DÕI CỔ PHIẾU
• Thiết lập cảnh báo giá cho những mã cổ phiếu bạn quan tâm
• Nhận biết các biến động quan trọng mà không cần liên tục mở bảng giá
• Duy trì danh sách mã cần theo dõi theo nhu cầu đầu tư của riêng bạn
• Quay lại đúng nội dung cần xem khi thị trường thay đổi
BỘ LỌC CỔ PHIẾU VÀ TÍN HIỆU
• Khám phá bộ lọc cổ phiếu để thu hẹp danh sách cần nghiên cứu
• Tham khảo tín hiệu kỹ thuật và dữ liệu liên quan đến từng cổ phiếu
• Tìm mã phù hợp với tiêu chí theo dõi thay vì chỉ dựa vào tin đồn
• Xây dựng quy trình phân tích chứng khoán nhất quán hơn mỗi ngày
CỘNG ĐỒNG VÀ HỌC ĐẦU TƯ
• Tham khảo nội dung chuyên sâu và góc nhìn từ cộng đồng đầu tư
• Học thêm kiến thức về cổ phiếu và thị trường chứng khoán theo cách dễ tiếp cận
• Trải nghiệm game chứng khoán để làm quen với cách xây dựng và kiểm tra chiến lược
• Bổ sung kiến thức nền tảng trước khi tham gia đầu tư thực tế
24HMONEY PHÙ HỢP VỚI AI?
• Người mới cần một ứng dụng chứng khoán Việt Nam để học cách đọc thị trường
• Người muốn theo dõi cổ phiếu, bảng giá và tin tức trong cùng một nơi
• Nhà đầu tư cần phân tích cổ phiếu, báo cáo tài chính và dữ liệu chứng khoán
• Người cần cảnh báo giá, bộ lọc cổ phiếu và tín hiệu để hỗ trợ công việc hằng ngày
• Người muốn tham khảo thêm góc nhìn từ cộng đồng trước khi tự đưa ra quyết định đầu tư
VÌ SAO NÊN DÙNG 24HMONEY MỖI NGÀY?
• Một hành trình liền mạch từ theo dõi thị trường đến nghiên cứu cổ phiếu
• Kết hợp bảng giá, tin tức, phân tích và cảnh báo trong một ứng dụng
• Có công cụ cho nhà đầu tư thường xuyên và nội dung dễ tiếp cận cho người mới
• Giữ trọng tâm vào chứng khoán Việt Nam, cổ phiếu và nhu cầu đầu tư thực tế
24HMoney không thay bạn quyết định nên mua hay bán. Ứng dụng giúp tập hợp thông tin, dữ liệu và công cụ để bạn nghiên cứu chủ động hơn. Tải 24HMoney để theo dõi thị trường chứng khoán Việt Nam, phân tích cổ phiếu và xây dựng quy trình đầu tư phù hợp với chính bạn.
Lưu ý: Nội dung và dữ liệu trên ứng dụng được cung cấp cho mục đích thông tin, tham khảo và học tập; không phải là khuyến nghị mua hoặc bán chứng khoán. Đầu tư luôn có rủi ro. Người dùng cần tự đánh giá và chịu trách nhiệm với quyết định của mình.

bluejetty:00074002:ios.description:
New topics address bioweapons, disaster preparedness and critical care challenges of an air-transmissible, pandemic-causing pathogens like COVID-19. 
POCKET ICU FEATURES
• Concise guidance written by attending physicians for everyone in critical care
• Entries with diagnosis, treatment, and management details
• Coverage of subspecialty areas including pediatric, neuro, cardiac, transplant, burn, and more
• Detailed images, figures, and decision support algorithms
• Overview of Statistics and Evidence-Based Medicine (EBM)

MORE ABOUT POCKET ICU
With content from the highly regarded Pocket Notebook series, Pocket ICU provides users with an essential tool for quickly locating information from every subspecialty area of critical care. This powerful resource can be downloaded to your smartphone and tablet and is great for preparing for rounds or consulting expert recommendations while on the ICU floor.

bluejetty:00065719:ios.summary:
Tawazun is your nutrition clinic, in your pocket. One app brings together online consultations with a licensed dietitian, a meal plan built around your food, and progress you can follow step by step.
ONLINE CONSULTATIONS WITH A LICENSED DI
bluejetty:00065719:ios.description:
Tawazun is your nutrition clinic, in your pocket. One app brings together online consultations with a licensed dietitian, a meal plan built around your food, and progress you can follow step by step.
ONLINE CONSULTATIONS WITH A LICENSED DIETITIAN
• Answer three short questions and we suggest the dietitian who fits you.
• Pick a time that suits your day and book inside the app.
• Join the video call from the app, wherever you are.
A MEAL PLAN MADE TO MEASURE
• A weekly plan your dietitian builds from your favourite food, culture and schedule.
• Every meal with its ingredients, calories and swaps.
• Recipes and videos to help you prepare.
PROGRESS YOU CAN SEE
• Weight, body mass index and body composition in one report.
• Compare measurements between visits.
• Add your own measurements any time.
SIMPLE DAILY HABITS
• Track water and steps from the home screen.
• Optional Apple Health connection to read steps and log water.
STAY IN TOUCH WITH YOUR CLINIC
• Send questions and follow-ups to the clinic team in chat.
• Reminders for appointments and check-ins.
ARABIC AND ENGLISH
The whole app is available in both languages, with full right-to-left support.
IMPORTANT
Tawazun's advice supports, and does not replace, care from your doctor. If you take medication for diabetes, blood pressure or any other condition, check with your doctor before changing how you eat. Results vary from person to person.
SUBSCRIPTION
Some services need a subscription billed to your App Store account. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Duration and price are shown in the app before you confirm.
PRIVACY BY DESIGN
Your health data is used only to provide your nutrition care. It is never used for marketing and never sold. You can request deletion of your account and data from inside the app.
Privacy policy: https://nutrihealth.blob.core.windows.net/policies/PrivacyPolicy.htm
Terms of use: https://nutrihealth.blob.core.windows.net/policies/Termsofuse.htm

DOMINATE 5 LEGENDARY SPEEDWAYS WITH THUNDERING V8 POWER!
Get behind the wheel of roaring V8 stock cars and master oval racing on 5 diverse speedway tracks!
From high-speed superspeedways to technical short tracks, experience heart-pounding NASCAR-style competition with advanced physics and wheel-to-wheel battles.
AUTHENTIC OVAL RACING MASTERY
Feel the raw power of V8 engines as you master drafting, banking, and strategic positioning.
Our advanced physics engine delivers genuine stock car handling with realistic weight transfer, tire grip, and aerodynamic effects that define oval racing.
5 DIVERSE SPEEDWAY CHALLENGES
Superspeedways - Master high-speed drafting at 200+ mph
Short Tracks - Navigate tight technical racing with close competition

- HD Graphics showcasing detailed speedway environments and car models
- Multiple Camera Views including immersive cockpit and dramatic chase angles

Whether you're passionate about stock car heritage, oval racing tactics, or V8 engine power,
this simulator honors NASCAR tradition with competitive racing that captures the spirit of America's premier motorsport.

Perfect for NASCAR fans, stock car enthusiasts, oval racing strategists, V8 engine lovers, mobile racing gamers!

bluejetty:00151314:ios.name: School Timetable - class study
bluejetty:00151314:ios.summary: School Timetable is the most easy to use, yet versatile scheduling app for students of school, college or university. Easily keep track of your weekly school schedule and events like homework assignments, exams and quizzes in this beautiful
bluejetty:00151314:ios.description:
School Timetable is the most easy to use, yet versatile scheduling app for students of school, college or university. Easily keep track of your weekly school schedule and events like homework assignments, exams and quizzes in this beautiful tracker accompanied by an Apple Watch app. Check out the following features which makes School Timetable the most complete schedule organizer app for students:
- Simply swipe left and right to see all weekdays
- Color coded classes
- Add room and location, professor name, phone number, email and other information for each class with notes
- Classes show break times and conflict time to next class
- Multiple week timetable
- If you have a very mixed up schedule with the same class at different times on different days, no need to add the same class multiple times. Simply add a variation and choose the days and time. Variations can be given a name too!
- Reminder notifications can be set to remind you X minutes before the class where X can be set as 5, 10, 15...55 minutes.
- Support for Apple Watch app and many complications
- Interactive large widget for home screen for iOS 17+ devices. Legacy widget is still supported on older devices which can be added using steps described at the bottom.
- Setup reminders for upcoming events, exams and homework assignments. These reminders will remind you a week before, 2 days before, 1 day before and the morning of the event to keep you on top of your game!
- Beautiful landscape view of the entire week at once (Just tap the fullscreen landscape button on top)
- Accent theme color settings
- No need to unlock your phone as it comes with a lockscreen widget for all your classes and tasks
- Force touch the Apple Watch app to change weeks and Tasks
- Ability to customize the number of weeks between 1-4 and auto-switch weeks
- Ability to customize reminder ringtone
- Save timetable as image in photos. Tap the full screen button on top right and there you will see the button to save as image.
- Export timetable
- Search classes, tasks, professor, room, notes etc. Search screen can also be used to edit reminders of all classes and tasks at a common place.
- App detects emails, sites, phone numbers and addresses in the notes and opens them in respective apps - multiple email and maps clients are supported
- iCloud Backup and Restore! Tap the hamburger menu button on top left and tap "Backup to iCloud" from side menu. On another device signed in with same iCloud account, tap the "Restore from iCloud" button.
Trial version lets you track up to 3 classes and 3 tasks. A one-time-only purchase lets you track unlimited classes and tasks. It also helps pay for yearly development fee and lets me keep supporting the app while keeping it ad-free. No subscriptions. Thank you for your support.

bluejetty:00119824:ios.description:
Tune your guitar, bass or other instruments with n-Track Tuner. 
Use this tuner in an easy, intuitive and free way with the integrated microphone of your smartphone.
Downloaded over 5 million times!
Just put your iPhone, iPod Touch or iPad next to your instrument and play each string.
High precision and sensitivity thanks to the advanced audio recognition algorithm also used for n-Track Studio 8.
n-Track Tuner works great as a guitar tuner, violin, viola, violoncello, bass, piano and wind instruments tuner.
NEW: 6 different views: 
•||| Spectrum Analyzer |||•
The spectrum analyzer provides a visual feedback of the notes played by the instrument and shows a small arrow to highlight the harmonic whose pitch the tuner is tracking. 
•||| Instruments |||•
Use the manual mode to select and tune each string according to the selected instrument tuning (guitar, bass, violin, viola, cello, double bass, banjo, ukulele, mandolin, harp, and piano) 
Get the pro version to unlock all instruments views.
•||| Tune Fork |||•
For those who prefer to manually tune their instrument the 'Diapason' view lets you play a reference tone, 'A' (440 hz) or any other note that you can select dragging the frequency slider.
•||| Needle |||•
A handy old style tuner to accurately detect the frequencies of your instrument.
•||| Sonogram |||• (PRO feature)
The "Sonogram" tab shows how the frequency spectrum evolves with time, and shows how the note that the tuner is following evolves by tracing a green line.
•||| 3D view |||• (PRO feature)
3D view lets you follow how the audio spectrum changes over time. 
ADVANCED FEATURES 
• adjust tuning sensitivity and precision up to 0.1 cents
• western and latin note namings, alternate temperaments
• calibrate the tuner for non-standard tunings: tune the reference note, tap on the display and select 'Calibrate' to set the note as the new reference
• adjust the spectrum analyzer visualization options, select thicker spectrum lines, smooth out or highlights peaks, increase or decrease spectrum accuracy, zoom into a specific area of the spectrum
Contact us: http://ntrack.com/support

bluejetty:00113603:ios.description:
Now, you can open Enjaz Digital membership & transfer internationally using Enjaz App without the need to visit Enjaz centers.
Enjoy the best international money transfer services at your fingertips!
Enjaz App enables Enjaz customers to transfer money internationally easily and directly through a wide network of international banks and money transfer operators using our unique service "Enjaz Easy" or through "Western Union" & “Transfast”.
Enjaz customers can transfer money internationally using Enjaz App through “Quick Access” and pay the amount securely by any mada card issued locally (without the need for enrollment).
Enjaz App also provides additional banking services, adding and activating new beneficiaries via Registration and Quick Access log on, issue digital Enjaz Card without the need to visit Enjaz centers.
Enjaz App also provides additional banking services such as adding and activating new beneficiaries for current customers via “Quick Access” and after registration for new customer without the need to visit Enjaz centers.

3. Adding, activating and managing beneficiaries
4. Instant Money Transfer via “Enjaz Easy” service
5. Instant Money Transfer via “Western Union” service
6.Instant Money Transfer via “Transfast” service
7. Pay utility bills via “SADAD”
8. Recharge prepaid mobile via "SADAD" 
9. View Enjaz Card account number “IBAN” to fund your card
10. View Enjaz Card balance & Transactions details
11. Change Enjaz Card PIN
12. Stop Enjaz Card
13. Enjaz Centers Locator
14. Currency converter
15- Remittance Calculator
Discover more features after downloading the App
How to use Enjaz App?
• For new customers, all you have to do is to complete the Enrollment process through the app and issue Enjaz digital Card and enjoy unique and safe digital experience in the remittance world.
• For Enjaz current customers, you can now register in Enjaz App to enjoy more banking features.
• Enjaz current customers can also access Enjaz App through “Quick Access” using their Saudi / Iqama ID number, then transfer money internationally and pay the amount using any mada card.

bluejetty:00077476:ios.summary: Solve mystical brainteasers in Twilight Land—the most captivating hidden object puzzle game. Uncover mysteries, unravel tricky match-3 puzzles, help restore a small town and unlock bonuses along the way. Join Rosemary Bell as she travels to
bluejetty:00077476:ios.description:
Solve mystical brainteasers in Twilight Land—the most captivating hidden object puzzle game. Uncover mysteries, unravel tricky match-3 puzzles, help restore a small town and unlock bonuses along the way. Join Rosemary Bell as she travels to Twilight Land to find her sister. 
A MYSTICAL STORYLINE 
The main character, Rosemary Bell, is having strange dreams where her missing older sister is trying to contact her. Two weeks prior, her sister got an invitation from a mysterious stranger and headed off to Twilight Land. Rosemary is determined to find out what happened to her. 
When Rosemary enters Twilight Land, she discovers that her sister is under a curse. Now she must solve the mystery of the strange town, save its inhabitants and help her sister. But be careful what you wish for... 
CAPTIVATING HIDDEN OBJECT SCENES 
Journey through a small 1930s town as you search for hidden objects and match items to progress through the story. Each level in this adventure puzzle game contains charming scenes full of hidden objects or unsolved levels full of match-3 puzzles. 
CITY RENOVATION AND DESIGN 
Unlock decorations and collections to rebuild the town. Influence its appearance and help bring back its elegance in this stimulating puzzle game. 
MEET FASCINATING CHARACTERS 
The town is full of exciting characters waiting for you! Solve mysteries and brainteasers as you work to save the townspeople. Enjoy engaging storylines in this unique puzzle game and find out what really happened here. 
PLAY PUZZLES ANYWHERE 
Now you can solve mysteries, enjoy search and find games and match items from anywhere. This mystery game is playable offline, so you can take this hidden objects adventure wherever you go! 
Help Rosemary save her sister and find out what unspoken secrets caused the town’s ruin. Download Twilight Land today and begin your mysterious journey! 
While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.
You can play this game whether you’re offline or online.

bluejetty:00065995:ios.description:
The year is 2060.
War has plunged the world into chaos and darkness, and the responsibility of restoring order falls onto those of us who have survived.
Now is the time to revisit your past. Make use of your gift in tactics and command your T-Dolls in the struggle to unveil the far-reaching conspiracy that permeates the world.
For the sake of mankind and our future, join us...
...at GRIFON & KRYUGER Private Military Contractor
【Game Features】
◎ Strategic mobilization and maneuvers
Gain the upper hand in battles through the use of operation strategies on maps that enable free deployment and withdrawal of multiple teams!
◎ Hands-on battles in real time
Have the frontline engage enemies and the backline deal damage. Turn the tables by changing your T-Dolls’ formation and position during battle!
◎ 100+ Anthropomorphic firearm characters
Over a hundred classic firearms in every era all the way from WWII to modern times await your orders, all designed by famous illustrators!
◎ Character cultivation and skill upgrade
Cultivate your T-Dolls by leveling up their skills, dummy-linking and calibrating their equipment to enhance their performance in battle!
◎ An illustrious cast of voice actors
Enjoy the magnificent performance brought by A-list Japanese voice actors such as Rie Kugimiya, Yui Horie, Ai Kayano, and Haruka Tomatsu!
◎ Dormitory and Costumes
Give your T-Dolls a funky, cozy home by furnishing their dormitory with décor of various styles!

Companies with mobile teams can manage their time, teams, and jobs from anywhere with any device.
Hear what customers have to say:
“We save so much time and it makes our job much easier.” Stephen M. CEO/Owner, Construction Company (saved 10+ hours/month)
“The system integrated perfectly to QuickBooks and it made payroll a breeze.” Adrian P., Owner (saved $1200/month and 10 hours/month)

Easy Time Tracking
● Track your team’s time in one place—no more messy paper timesheets

● Clock in and out of a new shift right from the scheduler
● Track time against each job or task for better job costing, payroll, and billing
● Review and approve your team’s time
● Allow a crew leader to track time for everyone on their crew with CrewClock™
● Turn a tablet or phone into a kiosk so multiple people can track their time using a single device
Accurate Timesheets
● Confirm your team’s exact clock in and clock out locations for more accurate timesheets
● Get GPS coordinates every time your team uses the mobile app to clock in, start a new job or task, and clock out
● Remind your crew to clock in and out when they’re near the jobsite with geofencing technology
● Receive notifications when employees clock in or out early, late, miss a shift, go into overtime, or clock in or out outside the geofence
See Who’s Working
● See your entire team on the map with Who’s Working Now
● Know when your crew is on the jobsite and how long they were there
● Use the GPSTrak™ feature to confirm your team’s location with a breadcrumb trail you can play back anytime
● When enabled, the GPSTrak feature updates your team’s location every 15 – 20 minutes
● Only see your team’s location when they’re clocked in—not when they’re clocked out or on a break

Enter text prompt, create your painting with AI technology! All you need to do is enter a prompt, pick an art style, AI will take care of the rest, bring your ideas into a wonderful painting in seconds!
Enter whatever is on your mind right now, such as Santa Claus riding a horse in universe, Futuristic City or whatever you are imagining. Then choose from a range of familiar art styles, such as Cyberpunk, Van Gogh and Oil painting, experiment with styles and see which style captures your idea best.
Main Features:
- Turn text into art painting
 Bring your ideas into a wonderful painting in seconds! Simply type in what you have on your mind, and the AI will generate wonderful painting that match your dream.
- Create art from images
 If you have an exact concept of your painting should look like, you can add an initial image to condition the generation of new images. Upload photo, provide expected text prompt that describes the painting. You will get an unique artwork that the world has never seen before.
- Generate magic avatar
 Create your Magic Avatar with AI technology! Just upload your photos and generate your outstanding avatar in various styles. We only give you photorealistic 4K renders, which is perfect to use for profile pictures, social media posts and even printing on paper, clothing or posters!
- Countless Avatar with different styles
 -Countless magic avatars, such as sci-fi style, astronaut style, queen style, art painting style, epic comic-style and so on. And many more! Create anything you can think of. It's time to unleash your creativity!

bluejetty:00024932:ios.name: Countdown: Event Timer & Days
bluejetty:00024932:ios.summary: Every great moment is worth the wait — and Countdown makes the waiting half the fun. Create a beautiful countdown to any event and watch the days, hours, minutes and seconds tick down to the moments that matter most, from birthdays and holi
bluejetty:00024932:ios.description:
Every great moment is worth the wait — and Countdown makes the waiting half the fun. Create a beautiful countdown to any event and watch the days, hours, minutes and seconds tick down to the moments that matter most, from birthdays and holidays to vacations, weddings, exams and the big game.
Whether you're counting down to Christmas, New Year, Halloween, an anniversary, a long-awaited trip, the World Cup, the Olympics or the release of your favorite movie, Countdown keeps every important date front and center, so you never lose track of what's coming next.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE COUNTDOWN
• Unlimited countdowns — create as many as you like, with no limits at all.
• Precise timing — set the exact date and time of every event.
• Two tabs — Upcoming counts down to the big day, Past counts up from it.
• Full breakdown — see the days, hours, minutes and seconds remaining at a glance.
• Day-of-the-week info — know which day your event lands on and plan ahead.
• Timely reminders — get a gentle alert as your big moments approach.
• Color customization — personalize each countdown with vibrant, eye-catching colors.
• Beautiful and simple — a clutter-free design that puts your moments first.
• Works offline — no internet connection needed to keep counting.
• Light & dark themes — easy on the eyes, day or night.

bluejetty:00177781:ios.description:
Hello, Creator. Welcome to the Cosmos!
You have four basic elements, an empty planet and plenty of time. Not that these are alone are enough to create the Universe. You will also have to use your intelligence and imagination as you combine air, water, fire and earth to create hundreds of new elements to make your planet come alive! 
BUILD THE WHOLE WORLD
Mix and match different combinations of elements to create an entire universe. As you create each new element, watch your 3D planet come alive in amazing animation.
HAVE FUN & LEARN
Every time you successfully create a new item you’ll be rewarded with the wit and wisdom of some of the greatest philosophers and comedians of all time.
And the Voice will encourage you to keep creating things.
CHALLENGES
Lost Halloween. All the Halloween essential items were gone! Well, it seems like you will have to recreate the holiday from what is available on hand.
Save the Princess. The King's daughter was taken away by the Dragon. Build the team of heroes and defeat the monster. Enjoy new elements and the world to explore.
Other quests, puzzles and missions are coming soon! 
EVOLUTION+ MODE
Complete the main game & open all the elements to unlock this NEW mode. New Game+ mode: Re-play the game from the beginning as a Pro. Find missing reactions & get up to 250,000 bonus points. Earn extra points for each new reaction you missed during the 1st gameplay. Be a Hero & become the Doodle God Universe Champion!
LEADERBOARD
Each new element, reaction or hint usage is rewarded with the points which can help you to increase your value as a creator in the Global Leaderboard.
Discord: discord.gg/ANwZ5GBEbb
Twitter: @Doodle_God
Facebook: fb.com/doodlegod
YouTube: youtube.com/JoyBitsTrailers

bluejetty:00120004:ios.name: CopticHymns
bluejetty:00120004:ios.summary: The Heritage of the Coptic Orthodox Church (HCOC) choir was founded in the summer of 2000, under the leadership of Deacon Albair Mikhail. Most choir members are from the church of the Prophet Daniel and the Three Saintly Youth in Mississaug
bluejetty:00120004:ios.description:
The Heritage of the Coptic Orthodox Church (HCOC) choir was founded in the summer of 2000, under the leadership of Deacon Albair Mikhail. Most choir members are from the church of the Prophet Daniel and the Three Saintly Youth in Mississauga, Canada. HCOC also has members from the churches in the Greater Toronto Area, Montreal, the USA, Australia, and Egypt. 
The aim of the HCOC is the preservation of the increasingly at-risk oral chant heritage of Coptic hymnology, through receiving and recording the most accurate renditions of the hymns. These academic recordings are intended to be references for the education, preservation and enrichment of Copts and those who are interested in the historical musical heritages of indigenous communities around the world. 
In handing down the hymns, we follow a rigorous study, research, and comparative analysis of Coptic hymnology from Cantor Mikhail El-Batanouny, who is our main source, and his disciples.
Mobile app version: 6.21.1

bluejetty:00032827:ios.description:
Whether you're casually browsing and researching or shopping for your next car, Edmunds is here to help. We make car buying easy. Tap into a huge selection of new and used vehicles near you. Unlock instant savings and find available incentives. Let our experts guide you. Read reviews and see what others nearby paid for your perfect car. Buy with confidence. Estimate monthly payments and know what dealers will offer for your trade-in.
Named one of the top 10 car-buying apps by Nerdwallet and Marketwatch! 
We draw on decades of automotive experience to leverage our extensive network of new car and used car dealers to help save you thousands. Browse our used cars for sale and new cars for sale today and let us know what you think.
With this app you can:
BROWSE THE LARGEST SELECTION OF NEW & USED CARS LISTINGS
Search our network of nationwide inventory. Narrow down your search with our extensive filters including: price range, new/used/cpo, exterior and interior colors, years, model type, body type, trim, options & packages, features, Edmunds deal ratings, Edmunds special offers, engine, transmission, drive train, fuel type, and vehicle history. We show you the best matches first!
VIEW PRICING, VEHICLE HISTORY, & INSTALLED FEATURES/OPTIONS ON INVENTORY LISTINGS
See a detailed price analysis including whether we think it's a great, good, or fair deal as well as the average price paid for new cars. We strengthen your negotiating power by letting you know how long a car has been on the lot and history of any price changes. For used and cpo cars, we let you know owner, accident and usage history as well as if buyback protection is provided (where available). View all installed options and corresponding prices on the listing details page.
GET SPECIAL OFFERS AND PRICE QUOTES
Text, call or connect with dealers to check availability or obtain an Edmunds special offer to save up to thousands off MSRP.
SAVE YOUR FAVORITES
Save your searches as well as your favorite cars for sale to quickly get back to them at any time.
CALCULATE PAYMENTS
Use our extensive loan and lease payment calculators to quickly determine your monthly payment before heading to the dealer.
RESEARCH
Read Edmunds' expert reviews on thousands of cars and check out our latest videos all in the app. See the latest incentives, consumer reviews, safety ratings, features and specs, True Cost to Own® and photo galleries all on the research tab. You can also write a review for a car right in the app!
APPRAISE YOUR CAR
Find out the trade-in, private party, and dealer retail prices for your car.
FIND A DEALER
Browse our massive dealer network to find the best dealer near you. Check out sales and service reviews. Call, text, or get directions to the dealership. Check out hours of operation as well as various amenities the dealer has to offer.
CAN IT FIT?
Before heading to the dealer, see if a car will fit in your space! Our AR garage experience lets you visualize most cars in your space and will let you know if it fits!
ON THE LOT
Get notified of unlocked special offers when you enter a dealer lot. Search vins, stock numbers, colors, models or years to locate your car on a dealer lot.
COMPARE
Quickly compare cars side-by-side on data points such as price, consumer reviews, Edmunds rating, engine, horsepower, torque, transmission, drive train, EPA mileage, range, fuel capacity, included features, warranty, cargo capacity, seating capacity, and vehicle dimensions.
Let us know what you think! If you need help or just have a suggestion or feedback, tap the help button on the settings screen.

bluejetty:00126966:ios.name: Road to Hana: Maui Audio Tours
bluejetty:00126966:ios.summary: Discover paradise with this self-guided driving tour of Maui’s number one attraction: The world-famous Road to Hana! This GPS-guided tour offers the ultimate Maui Road Trip experience for those looking to explore Hawaii's best scenic road t
bluejetty:00126966:ios.description:
Discover paradise with this self-guided driving tour of Maui’s number one attraction: The world-famous Road to Hana! This GPS-guided tour offers the ultimate Maui Road Trip experience for those looking to explore Hawaii's best scenic road trips.
Road to Hana in Maui, Hawaii
Experience the Hana Highway the way it was meant to be seen! Take in the astonishing jungle vistas, explore ancient volcanic tunnels, and get a healthy dose of the local Hawaiian culture.
Through it all, you’ll hear the riveting history and legends behind how Maui became the island it is today, from the demigod who raised it from the ocean with a mighty fishing hook to the bloody legacy of Captain Cook and beyond. So buckle up for a tale of clashing cultures, royal coups, and Hawaiian perseverance.
Oh, and you can’t forget the beaches! Soak up some sun at a jaw-dropping black sand beach, dive into Maui’s pristine waters at some of the best shorelines in the world, and capture once-in-a-lifetime snapshots of waves crashing against a rocky peninsula. Maui has almost too many wonders to name, but don’t worry—you won’t miss a single one.
Start in Kahului or Kipahulu and tour with total flexibility.
This self-guided tour includes all this and more:
■ Welcome to Road to Hana
■ The Demigod Maui
■ Paia Town
■ Ho'okipa Beach Park
■ Jaws Beach
■ Kapu Systems
■ Pi’ilani
■ Begin the Road to Hana
■ Twin Falls, Maui Waterfall
■ Captain James Cook
■ Rainbow Eucalyptus
■ East Maui Irrigation Co
■ Kamehameha IV and V
■ Hawaiian Unification
■ Waikamoi Ridge Trail
■ Garden of Eden Arboretum
■ Kaumahina State Park
■ Honomanū Bay
■ Nuaailua View Point 
■ Ke’Anae Arboretum
■ The 1946 Tsunami
■ Kauikeaouli
■ Ching's Pond
■ The Great Māhele
■ Wailua Valley Lookout
■ Upper Waikani Falls
■ Taro - Hawaii’s Purple Vegetable
■ Sugar Plantations
■ Pua'a Ka'a State Park
■ Nahiku & George Harrison
■ Plantation Labor
■ Nahiku Marketplace
■ Hana Lava Tube
■ Kahanu Garden
■ Waianapanapa State Park
■ Hana Tropicals
■ Maui Flora
■ Hāna Bay Beach Park
■ Koki Beach Park (Red Beach) & Alau Island
■ Hāmoa Beach
■ Venus Pool
■ Wailua Falls
■ Haleakalā National Park
■ Pipiwai Trail
■ Kīpahulu Visitor Center 
▶ HOW IT WORKS:
As you travel, audio stories play automatically based on your location. Simply go to the starting point and follow the given route. Each story begins playing on its own, usually just before you reach a point of interest.
■ TOUR FEATURES:
▶ Freedom of travel
No scheduled tour times, no crowded buses, and no rush to keep moving past stops that interest you. You have freedom to skip ahead, linger, and take as many photos as you want.
▶ Automatic play
No muss, no fuss. Just follow the app’s built-in route to all the must-visit spots — the audio stories about everything you see will play automatically!
▶ Works offline
Download the tour in advance and then use it seamlessly, even in areas with no service!
▶ Incredible stories
Immerse yourself in the history, culture, and secrets of this famous site with the help of a top-tier narrator and fascinating stories written by experts.
▶ Award-winning app
Featured on Thrillist and WBZ, this easy-to-use app won the Laurel Award for Technology from the Newport Mansions, who use the app for over a million tours per year.
■ Hawaii Bundle
This bundle includes tours of Hawaii’s most beautiful islands: O’ahu, Kauai, and Maui. Experience Honolulu’s rich culture, explore jungles so lush they appeared in Jurassic Park, and catch some sun on the best beaches in the world.
QUICK TIPS:
■ Download ahead of time, over data or WiFi.
■ Be sure the phone battery is fully charged, or take an external battery pack. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. This app uses your location service and GPS tracking feature to allow real-time tracking of your route.

MyTruckScales, Powered by TruckPay

bluejetty:00187427:ios.description:
MyTruckScales, Powered by TruckPay
The Heartbeat of your Business™
The first NTEP certified (NTEP CC: 19-140), patented, mobile and cloud based E-Ticket, truck scale management system that eliminates the need for expensive physical kiosks and scale house servers.
MyTruckScales is a game changer for drivers, scale owners and trucking companies.
For Company Driver and Independent Owner-Operators:
MyTruckScales will guide you to create a profile and establish your payment methods. When you are ready, search MyTruckScales to locate the scale closest to you. When you arrive, stay safely in your truck and fill in the requested information on the virtual kiosk created on your smartphone. You will be asked if you are positioned on the scale. Upon answering yes, the weighment record will appear on your phone, creating the paperless ticket. You may then drive off the
scale.
• Spend more time making money and less time on paperwork.
• Find scales with ease.
• Weigh in staying safely in your truck and avoid on the job injuries that may not.
only impact your business, but may impact your quality of life.
• Get axle weighments for over-the-road (OTR) compliance and get single platform weighments to learn your gross or tare weight.
• Store your tare weight and let MyTruckScales tell you when to get a new tare weight to comply with various state requirements.
• Stop disputes over lost tickets or the amount of materials carried. View tickets and full historical weighment reports by date, time, location or other ticket references, all stored on your phone and backed up in the cloud.
• Email weighments to customers as they occur or export data into EXCEL, PDF, or CSV files or into bookkeeping software like QuickBooks, FreshBooks and Quicken.
For Scale Owners or Trucking Companies:
• Drive more business to your scales;
• Eliminate the high cost of maintaining outdated equipment;
• Experience the power of virtual kiosks.
• Start by creating a virtual kiosk on www.MyTruckScales.com. 
When the driver weighs in, this virtual kiosk will appear on the driver’s smartphone. Sitting safely in the comfort of the truck, the driver will fill out the information you have requested and upon weighing out, the digital paperless weigh ticket will be sent to you automatically.
Gain the operational efficiencies of a paperless scale management system.
Learn more at MyTruckScales.com or email info@MyTruckScales.com.

bluejetty:00180727:ios.description:
Have you ever wanted to keep track of your friends and acquaintances who fly with DELTA AIRLINES? Are you curious about the destinations, aircraft models or the speed at which DELTA AIRLINES planes cross the skies? Well, your wish has just come true! Introducing the DELTA AIRLINES Air Sonar application - your gateway to the wonders of aviation.
With this application, you can immerse yourself in the world of aviation and even experience what it's like to be a DELTA AIRLINES pilot, all from the comfort of your smartphone. Think of your device as a handheld radar, and each DELTA AIRLINES flight as an adventure waiting to be explored.
Let's explore some of the incredible features that the DELTA AIRLINES Air Sonar application has to offer:
Global Flight Monitoring: Gain access to a bird's eye view of DELTA AIRLINES flights worldwide. Whether it's soaring over the Arctic or descending over the Amazon, you can track them all.
Aircraft Insights: Dive deep into the specifics of DELTA AIRLINES aircraft. You can discover details such as aircraft model, flight route, current speed, cruising altitude, and departure and arrival airports. It's like having an aviation encyclopedia in your pocket.
Real-time flight details: Stay up-to-date with estimated departure and arrival times for all DELTA AIRLINES flights. Curious about airport weather conditions? You'll find all the information you need right here in the app. No need to rush to the airport, it's all at your fingertips.
Tailored information: We understand that every traveler has a favorite DELTA AIRLINES aircraft. That's why we've made it easy for you to perform detailed searches. In real time, you can access and monitor the details of the DELTA AIRLINES aircraft that captures your imagination.
Doesn't it all sound fascinating? Download the DELTA AIRLINES Air Sonar application and you'll embark on a journey through the skies, gaining an insight into the world of aviation that you've never experienced before.
Prepare to be mesmerized by the sheer scale of DELTA AIRLINES' global operations. As you watch planes crisscross the globe, you'll be amazed at the information you can access about each flight. It's not just an app, it's your passport to the world of aviation.
Join the thousands of aviation enthusiasts who've already embarked on this exciting journey. Whether you're a frequent traveler, an aviation buff or just curious about DELTA AIRLINES, this app is your gateway to the wonders of aviation.
So what are you waiting for? Download DELTA AIRLINES Air Sonar now and start your aviation adventure. Your next travel experience will never be the same.

bluejetty:00136324:ios.description:
If you like word games and guessing games with pictures, you'll love Word Pics - Word Games! The idea is simple: guess the single word using just two pics as clues. The images will have some connection, all you have to do is enter the right words!
This simple, free, and addictive word game gives you two pics and challenges you to guess a word or phrase. The images in each puzzle have one word in common. Sometimes the words can be easy to guess, but other times you'll have to stop and think. The more picture puzzles you solve the more levels you will unlock, making this brain teaser game an endless source of fun!
There are 3 fun game modes to play:
1. Classic - Connect two pictures and guess the word, that's it!
2. Expert - Two pictures appear and then disappear after a few seconds. Guess the word quickly, but be ready to challenge your brain!
3. Multiplayer - Engage in a fun one-on-one PvP quiz battle against other people online and in real-time!
Along with all of the above word game modes, Word Pics also includes the features below.
- Hints and clues to help solve tough puzzles
- Zoom in to see picture details
- Online multiplayer with real-time puzzle solving
- Add more fun by customizing your theme's look and feel
- Guess the correct words in over 1000 puzzles!
- Use the speak to word option for added fun. 
Are you looking for fun games to challenge your brain? Play the best picture words game today, experience endless fun, while challenging your brain!
Word Pics - Word Games is super fun to play. There are exciting picture packs, challenging guessing games, incredible words, and tons more to enjoy, all in a free brain teaser format. Expect endless hours of quiz solving fun!
Play the game alone, play the game with friends, play it against strangers. No matter how you play word games, Word Pics is a fantastic twist on a familiar puzzle. Download this addictive new word game today!

Never Hunt for Your AC Remote Again
Tired of lost remotes, dead batteries, and getting up repeatedly to adjust your air conditioner? Your iPhone is always within reach — make it your universal AC remote.
Take control of your comfort with this user-friendly air conditioner remote. Designed for convenience and efficiency, this smart remote gives you complete control over your cooling experience — all from your smartphone. Whether you're lounging on the couch or getting ready for bed, you can easily adjust temperature or fan speed, without having to get up or search for a traditional remote.
CONTROL YOUR AC FROM ANYWHERE IN THE ROOM No more digging through couch cushions or replacing batteries. Adjust temperature and change fan speed straight from the phone that's already in your hand. Everything you reach for a remote to do, you can do in a couple of taps.
A SLEEK INTERFACE ANYONE CAN USE The sleek, intuitive interface makes navigation a breeze, even for first-time users. With just a few taps, you can create the perfect indoor climate tailored to your preferences. Choose from a range of modes to suit your daily routine — from rapid cooling after coming home on a hot day to quiet nighttime settings that help you sleep soundly.
SMART FUNCTIONALITY, NOT JUST BUTTONS What sets this remote apart is its blend of simplicity and smart functionality. It not only offers responsive controls but also includes features designed to help you reduce power consumption without sacrificing comfort.
BUILT FOR EVERYDAY COMFORT Compact, reliable, and easy to use, this remote is your perfect partner in creating a relaxing and personalized home environment. Stay cool, stay comfortable — exactly how you like it.
WHAT YOU CAN CONTROL 
- Power on and off 
- Temperature up and down
- Fan speed
- Temperature presets
Download now and turn your iPhone into the remote you'll never lose.

ニュースをもっと深く、もっとおもしろく。
【NewsPicks(ニューズピックス)の特徴｜経済ニュース・ビジネスニュースを厳選】
NewsPicks(ニューズピックス)は、100以上のメディアからニュースを厳選。
経済ニュース・ビジネスに関するニュースをお届けします。
新聞やテレビで気になっていたニュースの背景、経済の仕組み、ビジネストレンド、最新のニュースを、記事・動画・図解・コメントで理解しやすくしています。
NewsPicks(ニューズピックス)なら無料でもニュースが読める。記事や動画で経済やビジネスを学べて、仕事の情報収集や就活の準備にも活用できます。
【経済・ビジネス・投資・政治まで、ニュースと最新情報を網羅】
NewsPicks(ニューズピックス)では、経済ニュース・ビジネスのニュースを中心に、金融・投資・政治・社会・AI・キャリア・就活など幅広いニュースと最新情報をお届け。
国内のニュース、海外のニュース、国際経済のニュースも記事や動画でわかりやすく。
新聞のように毎朝のニュースを見たい方、新聞とあわせて経済ニュースを深く理解したい方、ビジネスの情報を仕事に活かしたい方にも役立ちます。
【就活・仕事にもおすすめ｜業界研究や企業研究に】
NewsPicks(ニューズピックス)は、就活の業界研究、企業研究、面接対策にも活用可能。
経済ニュースやビジネスに関するニュースを通じて、企業や業界の動き、社会の変化を理解しやすくなります。
就活準備中の方はもちろん、仕事で情報収集したい方にもおすすめです。
会議・商談・企画・資料作成など、仕事で必要な経済情報やビジネスの情報を記事や動画で確認できます。
NewsPicks(ニューズピックス)は、就活にも仕事にも役立つニュースを提供します。
【オリジナル記事と専門家解説で、経済ニュースの背景までわかる】
NewsPicks(ニューズピックス)では、経済ニュースやビジネスのニュースを深く理解するためのオリジナル記事・番組を多数配信。

bluejetty:00043627:ios.description:
GET PAID REAL CASH TO SHAPE THE PRODUCTS AND SERVICES YOU USE EVERY DAY.
Dscout connects thoughtful people with companies looking for real, in-depth feedback. Participate in paid studies where your voice helps improve apps, websites, and everyday products. Earn money through PayPal for your contributions.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Dscout goes beyond traditional surveys, inviting you to take part in in-depth paid experiences that give you a voice in shaping real products.
You might:
• Test new apps before they launch
• Share your shopping or streaming habits
• Record short video feedback about your experiences
• Join live interviews with researchers
• Try new products and give detailed input
Each study is different and your perspective genuinely helps teams make better decisions.
HOW IT WORKS
1. APPLY TO STUDIES that match your interests and background
2. GET SELECTED by research teams
3. PARTICIPATE THOUGHTFULLY - through videos, photos, or interviews
4. GET PAID VIA PAYPAL once the study is complete
Payments are clearly listed upfront, and you're always free to choose which studies to apply for.
STUDY TYPES
EXPRESS: Quick, on-the-go missions where you share immediate feedback through photos, videos, or short responses. Perfect for capturing real moments as they happen.
DIARY STUDIES: Multi-day projects where you document your experiences over time, giving researchers a deeper look into your daily life and habits.
LIVE INTERVIEWS: One-on-one video conversations with researchers where you can share detailed insights and discuss your experiences in real-time.
XT(DESKTOP ONLY): Download our XT chrome extension to get access to opportunities that pop up naturally while you browse and shop on desktop.
WHO IT'S FOR
Dscout is for people who:
• Enjoy sharing honest, detailed feedback
• Want to influence real products and services
• Prefer higher-quality opportunities over quick surveys
• Value getting paid real money for meaningful work
We're building a trusted community of reliable participants who are invested in providing thoughtful, quality feedback.
WHY DSCOUT IS DIFFERENT
• Real research, not click-through surveys
• Direct collaboration with product teams
• Flexible opportunities that fit your schedule
• Multiple ways to participate - mobile, desktop, or live video
• Fair pay delivered via PayPal for meaningful input
Your insights help shape products used by millions.
If you care about improving the apps, brands, and services you use and want to get paid real cash for contributing thoughtful feedback — Dscout is for you.

Dscout connects thoughtful people with companies looking for real, in-depth feedback. Participate in paid studies where your voice helps improve apps, websites, and everyday products. Earn money through PayPal for your contributions.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Dscout goes beyond traditional surveys, inviting you to take part in in-depth paid experiences that give you a voice in shaping real products.

You might:

• Test new apps before they launch
• Share your shopping or streaming habits
• Record short video feedback about your experiences
• Join live interviews with researchers
• Try new products and give detailed input

Each study is different and your perspective genuinely helps teams make better decisions.


HOW IT WORKS

1. APPLY TO STUDIES that match your interests and background
2. GET SELECTED by research teams
3. PARTICIPATE THOUGHTFULLY - through videos, photos, or interviews
4. GET PAID VIA PAYPAL once the study is complete

Payments are clearly listed upfront, and you're always free to choose which studies to apply for.


STUDY TYPES

EXPRESS: Quick, on-the-go missions where you share immediate feedback through photos, videos, or short responses. Perfect for capturing real moments as they happen.

DIARY STUDIES: Multi-day projects where you document your experiences over time, giving researchers a deeper look into your daily life and habits.

LIVE INTERVIEWS: One-on-one video conversations with researchers where you can share detailed insights and discuss your experiences in real-time.

XT(DESKTOP ONLY): Download our XT chrome extension to get access to opportunities that pop up naturally while you browse and shop on desktop.


WHO IT'S FOR

Dscout is for people who:

• Enjoy sharing honest, detailed feedback
• Want to influence real products and services
• Prefer higher-quality opportunities over quick surveys
• Value getting paid real money for meaningful work

We're building a trusted community of reliable participants who are invested in providing thoughtful, quality feedback.


WHY DSCOUT IS DIFFERENT

• Real research, not click-through surveys
• Direct collaboration with product teams
• Flexible opportunities that fit your schedule
• Multiple ways to participate - mobile, desktop, or live video
• Fair pay delivered via PayPal for meaningful input

Your insights help shape products used by millions.


If you care about improving the apps, brands, and services you use and want to get paid real cash for contributing thoughtful feedback — Dscout is for you.
