bluejetty:00078169:ios.description:
** AppStore 「新鲜 App」栏目推荐应用**
**「PriceTag」、「最美应用」、「少数派」、「极客公园」、「小众软件」推荐应用**
图图记账是一款简洁精美且功能强大的记账应用，拥有简单易用且不失美观的交互界面，极简的操作流程和自动记账、批量账单导入等快捷功能，让你可以轻松高效的记录自己的收支账单。同时，App 内强大的资产管理功能和统计图表，能帮助你对自己的财务状况和消费趋势一目了然，配合分类预算功能，就可以让你掌握自己的每一笔花销，科学的定制理性消费计划，搭配 App 内的存钱功能，助你更快完成自己的攒钱目标。
【产品主要功能】
- 简洁且强大：精美的 UI 界面和易用的交互体验，永久无广告、无理财、无社区、无需登录，简单操作即可快速完成记账；
- 多端支持：桌面级体验的 iPad 客户端，简单易用的 Apple Watch 客户端，数据自动无缝同步；
- 自动记账：消费完后截屏，app 自动读取截屏中的付款金额、付款方式等，一键记账！
- 存钱功能：支持创建定额存钱计划或灵活存钱计划助你更快达成攒钱目标；
- 多账本：支持设定应对不同场景的账本（如旅游账本、装修账本等），分别管理收支，并查看不同账本的收支统计情况；
- 桌面小组件：多种精心设计的桌面小组件，好看好用，快速记账、日常数据查看更方便；
- 图表统计：一目了然的美观图表，帮你快速了解消费情况，让你更加了解自己的消费习惯，从而减少不必要的支出；
- 账单导入：支持导入微信账单、支付宝账单及其他平台的记账数据，简单的几步操作就可以一次性记一周、一月的账；
- 到期还款提醒：信用卡、债务到期还款提醒，让你不再错过每一笔账单，避免逾期的烦恼；
- 多币种：可添加多币种账户及多币种账单，目前已支持百余种货币，汇率自动更新；
- 购物清单：用购物清单管理想要买的东西，买完后一键记账，方便快捷；
- 预算功能：可以设置每个支出类别的分类预算，监控消费，合理规划自己消费；
- 记账模板：常用收支可添加为记账模板，再次记录时只需一点，一步轻松记录；
- 资产管理：可添加现金、储蓄卡、信用卡、网上支付账户、投资理财、债务借出等多种类型的资产账户，方便你有效管理自己的资产，做到对自身财务状况的实时掌握；
- 快捷记账模式：开启后，通过桌面图标、应用通知或小组件进入应用，可直接到达记账页面，一步到位；
- 自动重复记账：支持设置周期性的账单（如每月扣款的软件订阅等），到设定时间系统会自动记账；
- 账单筛选：支持按照不同纬度筛选账单，查账、管理更方便；
- 标签功能：支持在记账的时候为账单添加标签，并可在统计页面中查看针对标签账单的统计数据；
- 账单退款功能：已添加的消费账单支持退款，满足多种类型的记账需求；
- 自定义收支类别：图图记账提供了非常全面的收支类型，同时也支持用户自己去创建个性化的收支类型；
- 账单日历视图：使用日历视图可以清晰的查看每天的收支账单，对自己的消费情况了如指掌；
- 自定义记账提醒：图图记账支持用户自己设定提醒内容和时间，满足用户的个性化需求，再也不会担心会忘记记账了~
- 数据备份：图图记账使用了 iCloud 来备份数据，所有数据自动实时上传至云端，并可在不同设备间进行同步；
- 隐私保护：可创建四位数字密码或使用 Face ID/Touch ID 来保护自己的隐私安全；
- 账单导出：支出导出 csv 格式的记账数据；
【联系我】
您的建议和反馈对我来说至关重要，在使用图图记账的过程中，您遇到的任何问题或者建议，都可以通过 AppStore 评论区留言或者邮箱、微博来联系我。
微博：@大导演张子恒
邮箱：zhang@ziheng.me
【关于图图记账高级版订阅服务说明】
图图记账提供月度订阅计划、年度订阅计划和一次性买断计划，订阅价格分别为: ￥68/年（连续包年）、￥128/终身使用权（一次性付费，永久可用）
- 您可以根据自己的实际使用情况，选择订阅月度计划、年度计划，或者一次性付费买断图图记账的永久使用权。
- 付款将在确认购买时向iTunes帐户收取。
- 除非至少在当前订阅期结束前 24 小时关闭自动续订，否则订阅将自动续订。
- 在当期结束前的24小时你的账户将被收取续订费用，并确定续费费用。
- 用户可以管理订阅，购买后在用户的“帐户设置”中也可以关闭自动续订。
- 如果提供的免费试用期的任何部分未使用，如果用户在试用的情况下购买该部分的订阅，那么未使用部分将失效。
- 如果您未购买自动续订订阅，您仍然可以正常使用我们的应用程序, 订阅到期后，任何未锁定的内容都可正常使用。
使用条款：[https://sites.google.com/view/totowallet-terms-of-use/home](https://sites.google.com/view/totowallet-terms-of-use/home)
隐私政策：[https://sites.google.com/view/totowallet-privacy-policy/首页](https://sites.google.com/view/totowallet-privacy-policy/%E9%A6%96%E9%A1%B5)

bluejetty:00094094:ios.description:
Your smart apartment, reimagined. Simply move in and enjoy!
Connected living has never been this easy. ADT-enabled smart apartments (formally IOTAS) offer the convenience, comfort, and joy of a smart home without the setup or installation hassle.
Your home is only a tap away. Left home in a rush? Lock your door in seconds. Easily control lights, outlets, thermostats, locks and more. Set a scene in seconds — your spontaneous movie night ready before you can turn on Netflix. Enjoy a home that automatically reacts to your routines. Routines are a great way to save energy when you're not home or turn on lights when you awake on the weekdays.
Feel safe with ADT by your side. Get 24/7 SOS support and talk to ADT whenever you feel unsafe. If needed, we'll notify emergency services and share your location to get you help fast.
Use popular voice services such as Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant to control your home. Asking your home to set a scene or turn on your lights has never been so easy. "Okay Google, turn on movie time."
You must be an ADT resident to enjoy.

bluejetty:00018531:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00018531:ios.description:
Free to use forever, with advanced features available through a Pro subscription.
Coins is the simple, smart expense tracker that makes personal finance effortless — on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Quickly log expenses and income, stay on top of your budget, and understand exactly where your money goes. Whether you want to save more, control daily spending, or track income, Coins is the budgeting app that fits into your life in just 30 seconds a day.
Key Features
• Fast & Easy Expense Tracking
Log expenses or income in seconds. Just enter an amount—no complicated setup. Built-in calculator makes it easy to add up receipts on the fly.
• Pull-to-Add Gesture
Pull down on the home screen of your iPhone to instantly add a transaction — keep holding and move your finger left or right to pick yesterday or tomorrow.
• Beautiful Home Screen Widgets
Stay on top of your finances at a glance with stunning widgets right on your home screen. See your budget progress and recent spending without opening the app.
• Beautiful Budget Reports
See your spending at a glance with clear, insightful charts. Set monthly budgets and get alerts before overspending.
• Financial Health Score
Get a monthly score across savings, essentials, budgeting, and stability, with a clear breakdown and a personalized tip each month to help you improve.
• Custom Month Start Day
Set which day your budgeting month begins so it matches your pay cycle.
• Smart Transaction Suggestions
Coins remembers your frequent transactions so you can add new ones with just two taps.
• iOS Shortcuts Integration
Automate your money tracking! Use the Shortcuts app to add expenses or income hands-free—perfect for quick logging with Siri or custom workflows.
• Sync with iCloud
Access your data seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Always private, always secure.
• Apple Watch App
Log expenses and income from your wrist in seconds, with one-tap suggestions and complications for your budget, spending, income and Financial Health.
• Native Mac App
Enjoy the full Coins experience on macOS with a beautiful three-column layout, keyboard shortcuts, and desktop-optimized interactions.
• Made for iPhone Duo
Enjoy Coins on both the folded and unfolded displays of iPhone Duo.
• Privacy First
Your data stays on your device and your iCloud. Add a PIN for extra protection.
Go Pro to Unlock More
• Financial Forecast – Predict your future spending and income based on your history.
• Retire Planner – Map out your retirement on an interactive timeline and instantly see how long your savings will last.
• Multi-Currency Support – Ideal for travel and international expenses.
• Receipt Scanning – Snap a photo or pick from your library and let AI auto-fill your transactions.
• Repeat Transactions – Automate recurring bills and income.
• Background Themes – Personalize your home screen with beautiful animated backgrounds.
Coins is your simple budgeting companion—helping you save money, track spending, and stay in control of your finances with ease.

bluejetty:00063270:ios.description:
See a dog, but don't know its breed? Just take a picture and find out!
The Dog Scanner app will identify your dog's breed reliably in just a few seconds! Besides taking a picture, you can also record a video or upload an image from your gallery.
Got a mixed breed?
No problem, the Dog Scanner app also recognizes mixed breeds! We provide you with detailed data and interesting facts about the different breeds of your mixed breed dog.
No dog around?
Doesn’t matter! The Dog Scanner app also recognizes humans: Simply scan yourself, your friends, your family or the people around you and find out which dogs you resemble the most!
------
NEW! Become a part of our Dog Scanner community!
Share your results and compare them to the results of the community! Upload pictures of your favorite dog to our Social Feed and share them with other dog lovers! Have a look at the profiles and photos of other users, like and comment on posts from our dog community and filter them by date or popularity!
Additionally, you can easily share your posts with your friends by simply sending a picture directly from the Dog Scanner app.
------
NEW! Catch all dog breeds and become an expert!
Catch all the dog breeds with our Gamification feature – just like in Pokémon Go! Master the challenges, earn virtual treats and become a true dog expert! Compete with your friends or users from the community and climb to the top of our ranking list!
------
All dog breeds in the Dog Scanner app!
The Dog Scanner app currently identifies more than 370 different dog breeds, including all breeds officially recognized by the Fédération Cynologique Internationale (FCI) and even some more! Our comprehensive database with information and pictures of all dog breeds (including the unofficial ones) can also be accessed completely without scanning!
Give us feedback on the Dog Scanner app!
Let us know if the dog’s breed has been correctly identified. If not, you will get useful tips to improve your own results. If you also indicate which dog breed is in the picture, you help us to enhance our software since the app automatically learns how to provide even more accurate outcomes. Also suggest or vote for (unofficial) dog breeds that you want us to add to the app in the future!
Get your premium upgrade!
With our premium version, the app will no longer show ads and your results will be available faster. Furthermore, you can now choose whether your dog breeds should be recognized rather quickly or with higher accuracy. With the premium version, scanning dogs is also possible in offline mode, so you no longer need an active internet connection to identify their breeds. With the optional in-app purchase of our premium version, you will also help to support this app.
------
Find us on social media!
On our social media channels we provide you with the most beautiful dog pictures from the community. You will also find many interesting facts about man's best friend. Furthermore, we will keep you updated on all new added features of the Dog Scanner app in the future.
* Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dogscanner_app
* Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DogScannerApp
* Twitter: https://twitter.com/dogscanner_app
------
Just give it a shot!
Dog recognition as easy as it gets! Despite the small app size you will get all features and be able to identify a dog’s breed or get access to our extensive database at any time! Before you consider getting an expensive DNA test, simply scan your dog with the app and the dog breed will automatically be determined within seconds! Download the Dog Scanner app now!

bluejetty:00185005:ios.description:
Phonto is a simple app that allows you to add text to pictures.
・ More than 400 fonts are available.
・ You can install other fonts.
・ Text size is changeable.
・ Text color is changeable.
・ Text gradient is changeable.
・ Text's stroke color is changeable.
・ Text's shadow color is changeable.
・ Text's background color is changeable.
・ Text is rotatable.
・ Text kerning is changeable.
・ Line spacing is changeable.
・ Curved text.
・ Perspective text.
・ Parts of text are erasable.
・ Image theme is changeable.
・ Items (Balloon, Rectangle, Star, Heart) are available.
・ Background image is changeable.
・ You can use not only pictures, but also plain images to write text.
・ You can share photos on Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram.
・ URL scheme: phonto://
Try Vont app, if you want to add text to videos. Vont is a free app that is available on the App Store.
--------------------------------
LANGUAGE
--------------------------------
Phonto supports only English (US), Chinese and Japanese, so when the priority of Chinese (or Japanese) in your setting was higher than English, Phonto would be launched as Chinese (or Japanese) mode.
To solve this problem…
1. Open the Settings app.
2. Choose 'English' in 'General' > 'Language & Region' > 'iPhone Language'.
3. Turn back your 'iPhone Language' to your favorite language.
--------------------------------
HOW TO INSTALL FONTS 
--------------------------------
Using iTunes, you can copy font files between your computer and Phonto on your iOS device.
1. Select your iOS device from the Devices section of iTunes.
2. Click the Apps tab and scroll down to the bottom of the page.
3. Select "Phonto" in the "File Sharing" section.
4. Drag and drop .ttf or .otf font files into "Documents".
5. Restart Phonto.
More detail about how to install fonts.
https://phon.to/install_fonts
Twitter: @phontograph
Tumblr: http://phontogra.ph
https://phon.to

bluejetty:00168164:ios.description:
Blidz – Social Shopping Super App for Daily Deals, Group Discounts & Big Savings
Looking for amazing deals online? Blidz is a social shopping app where you can discover trending products, unlock huge discounts, and shop smarter together with friends.
Browse millions of products across electronics, fashion, home goods and more — all at prices that are often far lower than traditional online stores.
WHY PRICES ON BLIDZ ARE SO LOW
Blidz works differently from typical online shops.
Instead of spending heavily on advertising, we focus on passing those savings directly to our users. By sharing deals with friends and shopping together, our community helps unlock better prices for everyone.
No middlemen. No unnecessary markups. Just better deals.
TEAM UP – SAVE MORE TOGETHER
When you Team Up, you can unlock massive group discounts by shopping together with friends.
When you find a product you like, simply Team Up and invite a friend to join. Once the purchase is completed, both of you unlock huge discounts — sometimes up to 90% off on popular products.
Shopping together makes every deal even better.
DISCOVER TRENDING PRODUCTS & DAILY DEALS
Explore millions of products across popular categories including electronics, fashion, home essentials and more.
From premium tech brands to everyday must-have items, Blidz helps you discover new deals and trending products every day.
MEET YOUR AI SHOPPING COMPANION
Blidz isn’t just shopping - it’s all about having fun!
Choose from 3 unique AI companions, each with their own personality, so you can find one that matches your vibe. Whether you want a savvy deal-hunter, a friendly guide, or a fun shopping buddy, there’s a companion for you.
Ask questions, explore new finds, or chat to a friendly face - your AI companion is here to help you shop better every day.
Even better? You can earn rewards just by chatting. The more you engage, the more perks you unlock - making shopping not only smarter, but more fun.
Shopping has never been this easy, rewarding, or entertaining.
SAFE & SECURE SHOPPING
Your shopping experience is fully protected with secure payment processing and reliable customer support.
Every purchase on Blidz includes:
• Secure encrypted payments
• PayPal and major credit cards supported
• Fast delivery options
• 30-day return policy
• Responsive customer support
Shop with confidence knowing your orders are protected.

• Millions of products available

• Secure checkout with PayPal and major credit cards
• Fast shipping options

• Dedicated customer support

Turn the excitement of football's biggest tournament into a playful and passionate experience for you and your partner.

Will your team win? Will you unlock the next position? Can your relationship climb to the top of the leaderboard?
The journey starts with your next prediction.
HOW SCRATCH LEAGUE WORKS
• Choose a team together before every World Cup match
• Watch the match unfold
• Each placed predictions unlocks a new position
• Earn points for correct predictions
• Build winning streaks throughout the tournament
• Compete against other couples on the global leaderboard
• Collect trophies and become World Cup champions
TURN EVERY MATCH INTO DATE NIGHT
Forget simply watching football.
Every match becomes an opportunity to connect, flirt, laugh, and celebrate together. Whether you're cheering for the favorites or betting on an underdog, every prediction adds excitement and anticipation to your relationship.
The World Cup isn't just happening on the field anymore.
DISCOVER NEW EXPERIENCES TOGETHER
Each successful prediction unlocks a new position waiting to be scratched and revealed.
From playful encounters to more adventurous experiences, Scratch League helps couples break routines, explore new desires, and create memorable moments throughout the tournament.
COMPETE AS A COUPLE
Think you and your partner know football better than everyone else?
Earn points with every successful prediction and climb the global leaderboard. Compare your performance with couples from around the world and prove that you're the ultimate football power couple.

Create winning streaks, collect trophies, and keep moving up the rankings as the World Cup progresses.
EXPERIENCE THE WORLD CUP LIKE NEVER BEFORE
Every goal matters.
Every prediction counts.
Every victory could unlock a new experience for you and your partner.
From the opening match to the final whistle, Scratch League transforms the world's biggest football tournament into a playful, romantic adventure for couples.

bluejetty:00019404:ios.description:
***Over 300,000 Downloads!*** Merry Christmas! Oh no! Santa & the holiday friends need your help with a makeover for Christmas time!! Play fun holiday levels with Santa, elf, snowman dentist and more!
Level 1: Help give Santa a haircut and clean up! Use the tools on the bench to clean him up for Christmas! Trim his beard and watch it magically regrow!! Comb hair, add Santa's glasses, hat and more!
Level 2: Clean the elf!! The elf was playing in the candy room and got messy! Help clean up, brush hair, put on elf hat, apply make-up and more!
Level 3: Dentist time! Take the snowman to the dentist! Brush teeth, use floss tool and don't forget to add the carrot nose & snow hat!
Level 4: Help the Gingerbread friend!! Use the fan to cool off, then decorate by adding frosting & bow tie, cook the gingerbread, use the magic sparkle wand and much more!

*Level 9: Oh no! The sleigh is stuck in the snow! Use the shovel to remove the snow, fix the sleigh, then get ready for Santa!

Making friends, talking to girls, speaking in front of the class, school dances, gym class…Life can be so embarrassing that sometimes you feel like you just want to
bluejetty:00158125:ios.description:
Solve puzzles to help a very Shy Boy face the challenges of everyday life!
Making friends, talking to girls, speaking in front of the class, school dances, gym class…Life can be so embarrassing that sometimes you feel like you just want to disappear…Do you run away and hide? Or do you stand up and face your fears?
Come help Shy Boy find the courage to overcome his fears in this escape room-inspired puzzle game.
■How to Play
・Tap the screen to see the many things you can do.
・Get and use items to solve puzzles.
・Simply drag and drop items to use them.
Want more puzzles? Come help the other fun characters in our Casual Escape Game Series! 
■Features
・Completely free and easy to play. Family-friendly fun for all ages! 
・Play with your friends and family - you’ll find plenty to talk about!
・Enjoy the many relatable everyday situations both inside school and out!
・The perfect mix of challenging and fun!
・Not good at puzzle games? No problem! This game is for everyone!
・Solve simple puzzles and relive the nostalgia of childhood!
・Shyness? Social anxiety? Awkwardness? We’ve all been there - so come lend a hand and help a Shy Boy overcome his fears!
■Stage List
01 Don’t Be Shy: Help Shy Boy on his first day at a new school.
02 First Friend: Help Shy Boy strike up a conversation with a classmate.
03 First Crush: Shy Boy has even more trouble talking to girls…
04 In Harmony: Something’s wrong with Shy Boy’s recorder!
05 Dare to Be Kind: When you’re shy, even just giving up your seat can be a challenge.
06 Shy Apology: Help Shy Boy apologize for breaking his neighbor’s window!
07 Parents’ Day: Help Shy Boy impress his mom on Parents’ Day.
08 A Phone Call: Help Shy Boy answer the phone in time!
09 Wedding Day: You can’t have a wedding without the ring bearer!
10 Portrait of You: Help Shy Boy finish a portrait of his classmate.
11 An Interview: Shy Boy does NOT want to appear on TV!
12 Warming Up: Gym class is always super awkward…
13 Moving House: Shy Boy is such a hermit…
14 Summer Fun: Sunglasses leave the worst tan lines.
15 Rain With You: Shy Boy would really like to share his umbrella with her…
16 Shall We Dance?: Asking girls to dance is…so…awkward…
17 Relay Legend: Can you help Shy Boy win the race?
18 What to Wear?: To dress up for Halloween or not? That is the question.
19 Book Report: Can Shy Boy survive reading his report in front of the class?
20 Holding Hands: Go on a field trip with Shy Boy.
21 Shy Delivery: Help Shy Boy say “Hi” to a neighbor.
22 Knock, Knock: ‘Twas the night before Christmas…
23 A Little Secret: A Valentine’s Day secret
24 A Great Honor: Shy Boy won an award! But can he get up on stage to accept it?
25 The Journey: An epic RPG adventure awaits!...on the other side of the gate.
26 Lots of Love: Shy Boy has a secret admirer!....how embarrassing.
27 Stop Staring: Poor Shy Boy! Everyone in the music room is staring at him.
28 Excuse Me!: Help a hungry Shy Boy get the server’s attention.
29 Choir Solo: Help Shy Boy nail his choir solo!
30 Group Photo: He may be shy, but he doesn’t want to feel left out.
31 Shy For Life: Can Shy Boy face his childhood memories?

Welcome to Ritual—a spiritual practice for the life you are living.
Ritual is where you tend to your spiritual life: a few minutes each day, guided by trusted voices, rooted in practices that have sustained people for centuries. Not a surf
bluejetty:00042090:ios.description:
Welcome to Ritual—a spiritual practice for the life you are living.
Ritual is where you tend to your spiritual life: a few minutes each day, guided by trusted voices, rooted in practices that have sustained people for centuries. Not a surface level meditation app, not a single tradition—a place to build a practice that is genuinely your own.
Inside Ritual:
• Guided spiritual practices across many traditions. Christian contemplative practices—like Lectio Divina and The Examen—live alongside practices such as poetry, gratitude, and guided reflection.
• Practice alongside theologians, poets, and contemplatives—guides like Kate Bowler, Cole Arthur Riley, Barbara Brown Taylor, Father James Martin, and Parker Palmer, each with decades of their own practice and lived experience.
• Go deeper than the moment. Sit with a word that means something to you, and let Ritual help you carry that into your day through written and photo reflections.
• Build your spiritual life, over time. A spiritual life isn’t found in one session—it’s built through faithful return. Ritual helps you see the long arc of your spiritual journey over time.
• Bring your faith, your doubt, and everything in between. Whether you’re rooted in a tradition or finding your own way, Ritual meets you there.
Subscription Pricing & Terms: 
Try Ritual with three practices, free. To practice without limits, Ritual offers an auto-renewing annual subscription for $69.99 (USD; pricing varies by country).
Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renew anytime in your Apple account settings. Payment is charged to your Apple account.
Terms and conditions: ritual.io/terms-of-service Privacy policy: ritual.io/privacy-policy

Вам повезло, Стаканчик найдётся для каждого. Выбирайте, что в Стаканчике, и поехали.
* Руссиано
Раздел «Психология» поможет понять загадочную русскую душу. Учим искать мотивацию и силы внутри себя. Рассказываем о приемах, теориях, исследованиях, психологических тестах. Помогаем найти выход из тяжелых жизненных ситуаций, улучшить взаимоотношения с близкими. 
* Американо 
Ешь, молись, люби и читай раздел «Путешествия». О странах, людях и городах. Полезные советы, лайфхаки и лента новостей для тех, кто любит открывать новые земли. 
* Эспрессо 
Никакой лишней воды, только выжимка из экспериментов и фактов в разделе «Наука». Окна Овертона, кротовые норы, и правило десяти тысяч часов — рассказываем простым языком о сложном. 
* Латте
«Красота и здоровье» — статьи и советы о правильном питании и здоровом образе жизни, полезные рецепты и секреты бабушки Агафьи. 
* Капучино 
Ароматный микс в «Искусстве» — кино, живопись, музыка, стихи, литература. Новинки и старая добрая классика.
* Фраппучино 
Холодный, как сердце твоего бывшего, раздел «Жизнь». Откровенные рассказы знаменитостей и тех, кто попадал в сложные жизненные ситуации. Порой реальная история человека научит большему, чем прием у психолога.
* Лювак
Нет в наличии. Возможно, найдётся только забавный факт в разделе «Интересности».
Если не нашли свой Стаканчик — попробуйте раздел «Саморазвитие». Подскажем, как найти призвание и мотивацию, организовать время и жизнь, приобрести полезные привычки. Попробуем пару медитативных практик. 
Авторы Стаканчика рассказывают о том, что любят. Среди них дипломированные психологии, коллекционеры стран, журналисты, фитоняшки, которые знают толк в полезном питании. Кто-то на себе почувствовал, что в некоторые истории лучше не влипать, и честно рассказывает об этом. 
Наполняйте Стаканчик и меняйте свою жизнь.

Turn your iPhone into a powerful Bluetooth microphone!

bluejetty:00147542:ios.summary: Learn guitar faster with guitar tabs, chords, a tuner, a metronome, a drum machine, backing tracks, AI music tools, and smart practice features. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced musician, Enya Music provides everything you need t
bluejetty:00147542:ios.description:
Learn guitar faster with guitar tabs, chords, a tuner, a metronome, a drum machine, backing tracks, AI music tools, and smart practice features. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced musician, Enya Music provides everything you need to practice, play, and create music in one app.
----- Everyone's a Musician -----
• Play Anywhere: Grab your guitar or ukulele and play anytime, anywhere.
• Smart Performance: Connect compatible instruments to unlock interactive learning.
• Customize Your Sound: Shape your tone with presets and creative music tools.
• Global Community: Share your performances and connect with fellow musicians.
----- Learn Your Favorite Songs -----
Explore a growing library of guitar tabs, ukulele tabs, chords, and song arrangements.
• Easy-to-follow guitar tabs and chords to help you learn songs faster.
• Auto-scroll tabs for hands-free practice and performance.
• Multi-track playback with guitar, bass, drums, piano, and vocals.
• Transpose songs instantly into your preferred key.
• Loop difficult sections for focused practice and repetition.
• Play along with built-in backing tracks and rhythm accompaniment.
• For Cyber-G users, unlock more powerful features like smart tabs for guided practice. 
- Upload your own creations and share them with the community!
- Customize your fretboard with ambient lighting to set the mood.
----- Essential Guitar Tools -----
Everything you need for daily guitar and ukulele practice.
• Drum machine - Create custom rhythms to back your practice sessions.
• Tuner - Fine-tune your instrument before playing! Our versatile guitar & ukulele tuner offers preset tuning patterns such as Standard Tuning, Chromatic, Drop-D, and E flat, ensuring you always sound your best.
• Metronome - Master your timing with our customizable metronome. Adjustable BPM allows you to tap tempo and stay perfectly on beat.
• Loop - Record and loop rhythms to build more complex musical arrangements and create your own vibe.
• Chord Dictionary - All chord variations solved with our visualized chord identifier and chord finder showing chord diagrams and finger placement. An ultimate chord dictionary for every beginner!
• Courses - New to playing guitar or ukulele? Our step-by-step lessons provide clear, beginner-friendly instructions, from basic sing&play to solo and songwriting, perfect for any new guitar or ukulele player.
----- AI-Powered Music Tools -----
Create, practice, and explore music with AI-powered tools.
• AI Tone Presets - Instantly discover iconic guitar tones or create personalized sounds tailored to your playing style. From clean and bluesy to high-gain rock and metal, find the perfect tone in seconds.
• AI Stem Splitter - Separate vocals, guitar, bass, drums, and other instruments from your favorite songs for practice and learning.
----- Connect Your Enya Smart Instrument -----
Unlock additional features when paired with compatible Enya instruments.
• Cyber-G - Our smart guitar makes playing effortless. No strings, no complicated bar chords—just follow the smart tabs and solo like a pro.
• E-Guitar - Jam out wherever you are with our guitars featuring built-in speakers. Check out our Inspire, Sonic, NEXG, and Nova Go series.
• Acoustic Guitar - Experience the rich, authentic tone of our high-quality acoustic guitars.
• Ukulele - Add a touch of sunshine to your music with our carbon fiber ukes.
----- Contact us for more -----
Need help on your music journey? Contact us directly:
Product Support: Service@enyamusicglobal.com 
App Support: devteam@enyamusicglobal.com
----- Stay tuned to Enya Music -----
Official Website: https://enyamusicglobal.com/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/enyamusicglobal/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/enyamusicglobal/
Tik Tok: https://www.tiktok.com/@enyamusicglobal
----- Privacy & Terms -----
• https://enyamusicglobal.com/pages/terms-of-service
• https://enyamusicglobal.com/pages/privacy

With the Waterkaarten app (for
bluejetty:00019548:ios.description:
The most comprehensive app for safe and prepared boating navigation. With route planner, water maps, AIS pairing, marinas, bridges and locks, offline use and more. Try it now for free and plan your next trip!
With the Waterkaarten app (formerly ANWB Waterkaarten) you have everything you need at hand:
• 12 countries, 1 price - covers the United Kingdom, Ireland, Netherlands, Germany, France, Belgium, Switzerland, Norway, Denmark, Sweden, Austria and Czechia.
• Almanac info for all information you need on the water with just a few taps in the app
• Current, always up-to-date information about marinas, bridges and locks including opening times

bluejetty:00031663:ios.description:
Use DailyCam to record wonderful moments of life stories, you can add any style effects you want, output high-quality photos, and use the easy editor to create video.
【AI Cartoon】
 Transform your photos into eye - catching cartoons in seconds. Our advanced AI detects facial features, body postures, and even expressions. Choose from multiple styles like classic Disney - esque cartoons, modern minimalist anime, or detailed comic - book renditions. It also supports dynamic cartoon effects for turning photos into videos.
【Time Booth】
 Want to see what your past or future looks like? All you need is a front face photo, and take the time shuttle to get your cute childhood photos or the appearance of you getting older.
【Hair Style & Color】
Explore a vast collection of hairstyles, from sleek pixies to flowing mermaid waves. Our AI precisely analyzes your facial features to suggest the most flattering cuts. Whether you're prepping for a virtual event or just daydreaming about a new you, this feature lets you try it all without the commitment.
【Picture-to-Video】
Watch your static photos come alive! 
You can simply select an image and upload it to our app. Then, enter the corresponding keywords, and you are free to edit as you like. No matter what actions you want the elements in the image to perform, our app will transform the picture into a video according to your textual requirements. It offers you even more creative freedom and possibilities to bring your ideas to life in the form of vivid videos.
Subscribe to get unlimited access to all features and contents including more 3D motion templates, effect filter, dynamic stickers and so on. And constantly update the wonderful creative contents.

bluejetty:00184934:ios.summary:

If you like to solve logic puzzles and play Patience, Spider, FreeCell and TriPeaks, you will be surprised how the c
bluejetty:00184934:ios.description:
Are you a fan of Solitaire games and searching for a new challenging card game? Look no further - try out Pyramid games! 
If you like to solve logic puzzles and play Patience, Spider, FreeCell and TriPeaks, you will be surprised how the challenge and the fun of Pyramid is much greater and more addictive than classic solitaire. Pyramid is a puzzle card game that requires strategy and logic to clear the table. Find pairs of cards that add up to 13, regardless of their suits. Kings equal to 13 and are discarded singly, Queens counted as 12, Jacks as 11, etc. Only cards that are completely uncovered are available for play. Once you remove all the cards from the pyramid you win! Also, you might like to try and solve an easier game, Seven Solitaire, or the completely open Giza Solitaire. Complete fun challenges, win golden crowns and win a unique trophy every month.
Game Features:
• Simple and classic design
• Tap or drag cards
• 3 Games in 1: Standard, Giza, Seven
• Daily Challenges
• 6 beautiful card faces to choose from
• 9 custom card backs
• 4 table types to play on
• Thousands of randomized deals
• HD graphics and animations
• Casino quality random shuffle
• Detailed Statistics
• Easy switch between landscape and portrait modes
• Right and left handed layouts
• Unlimited Undo
• Helpful Hints
• Challenging Achievements
• Global Leaderboards
• Share your score via Facebook, Twitter, Email and etc.
• Support 7 languages: English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian and Spanish
• Fair scoring system
Do you like to have fun while challenging your brain with fun logic puzzles?
Are you a fan of different mind training games?
Or you like to solve riddles, don’t you?
Just never played solitaire or any card games before?
Don’t worry, try this simple, fun and addictive casual game!
We designed this game to be added to your own list of best card games ever. Be among many happy Pyramid fans - enjoy the game and we would love to hear you feedback at contact@maplemedia.io.

bluejetty:00114531:ios.description:
Ozon Селект - это приложение для стильных и современных покупок!
Откройте мир тщательно подобранных брендов с неповторимым стилем и высоким качеством. В нашем приложении вы найдете всё, что делает шопинг вдохновляющим и удобным - от одежды и обуви до косметики, парфюмерии, бьюти-гаджетов и товаров для дома и интерьера. Здесь сочетаются премиум-товары с привычным сервисом Ozon, чтобы покупки оставались комфортными, быстрыми и приятными.
БРЕНДОВАЯ ОДЕЖДА И ОБУВЬ
Обновляйте гардероб вещами, которые хочется носить каждый день. Новые коллекции выходят регулярно, поэтому легко следить за трендами и создавать актуальные образы, не выходя из дома.
КОСМЕТИКА И ПАРФЮМЕРИЯ
Экспериментируйте с ароматами, ухаживайте за кожей и подбирайте макияж. У нас собраны бренды, которым можно доверять, и новинки, что вдохновляют на перемены. А бьюти-гаджеты для ухода помогут создать свежий и безупречный образ.
ТОВАРЫ ДЛЯ ДОМА И ИНТЕРЬЕРА
Наполняйте дом уютом и комфортом с помощью аксессуаров, декора и текстиля. Вазы, свечи, декоративные фигурки, пледы и картины добавят индивидуальности каждой комнате, подчеркнут ваш стиль и создадут атмосферу, в которой приятно отдыхать и принимать гостей.
ЮВЕЛИРНЫЕ УКРАШЕНИЯ И ПОДАРКИ
В Ozon Селект вы найдёте изящные украшения, бижутерию и подарочные сертификаты для близких. Это возможность подчеркнуть свой образ или порадовать друзей и родных уникальными вещами, которых нет в обычных магазинах.
ЗДОРОВЬЕ И АПТЕКА
Заботьтесь о себе легко: витамины, средства ухода и медицинские товары собраны в одном месте. Всё, что нужно для здоровья и красоты, всегда под рукой.
ЭКСКЛЮЗИВНЫЕ И МИРОВЫЕ БРЕНДЫ
Откройте для себя любимые бренды и редкие находки российских дизайнеров. Лимитированные коллекции, необычные аксессуары и эксклюзивные модели помогут создавать стильные и индивидуальные образы каждый день. Среди брендов в Ozon Селект вы найдёте: Mango, Guess, Baon, Incanto, IDOL, Charmstore, HENDERSON, Ekonika, Marc O'Polo, Hugo, Plein Sport, Maneken Brand, Emka, Dior, Byredo, Clarins, Estée Lauder, Togas, Sisley, Shiseido, DARLING* и многие другие. Процесс покупки продуман так, чтобы вы были уверены в качестве товаров и чувствовали удовольствие от шопинга.
ПОЧЕМУ OZON СЕЛЕКТ:
- Эксклюзивный ассортимент: редкие модели, лимитированные коллекции и модные новинки, которые сложно найти в других магазинах.
- Оригинальные товары: только от правообладателей брендов и их официальных представителей.
- Надёжные продавцы: каждый проходит строгую проверку, чтобы вы могли доверять покупкам.
- Более 5 млн товаров и более 2 500 брендов.
С Ozon Селект шопинг превращается в источник вдохновения. Вы открываете для себя новые тренды, находите вещи и аксессуары, которые отражают ваш вкус, и создаёте стильные образы, не выходя из дома. Каждая покупка продумана до мелочей, чтобы вы могли наслаждаться процессом и быть уверенными в качестве товаров. А привычный сервис Ozon делает процесс покупок ещё более комфортным.
ПРЕИМУЩЕСТВА OZON:
- Удобный поиск и навигация по категориям и брендам.
- Доставка и оплата - более 75 000 пунктов выдачи по всей стране, оплата при получении, доставка по России и за рубеж.
- Возможность сохранять любимые товары в «Избранное» и возвращаться к покупкам позже.
- Разнообразные фильтры, подробные фото и описания товаров для уверенного выбора.
- Регулярные акции, скидки, купоны и промокоды для постоянных клиентов.
- Быстрые возвраты и гарантия качества каждого заказа.

bluejetty:00146895:ios.description:
Elevate Your Pickleball Game with AIM7 - The #1 Pickleball Performance App
AIM7 is your AI-powered fitness coach designed specifically for Pickleball players.
Whether you're a competitive athlete or a passionate enthusiast, AIM7 provides personalized guidance to help you prevent injuries, win more, and recover faster. 
KEY FEATURES
+ (FREE) Connect your wearable to analyze and share match summaries
+ (FREE) Get daily Readiness scores so you know how hard to push yourself
+ (FREE) Personalized warmups to prepare for performance and prevent injury
+ (FREE) Personalized cooldowns to reduce soreness and recover faster
+ Guided mobility training to reduce pain and move freely on the court
+ Sleep, recovery, and stretching plans to recover faster after matches
+ Mental performance tools like breathwork, gratitude journaling, and mindfulness to master your mental game
+ Personalized workout plans that adapt to your equipment, experience level, and health data
+ Nutrition & hydration plans to fuel your body for performance during matches
YOUR PERFORMANCE TEAM
AIM7 was developed by a world-class team of performance coaches, sports scientists, psychologists, and medical practitioners with over 150 years of experience training professional, collegiate, and Olympic athletes.
With AIM7, you'll gain access to the same cutting-edge training techniques used by top athletes, all tailored to your unique health data. Our AI-powered coach analyzes your biometric data, including heart rate variability, resting heart rate, and sleep patterns, to create a hyper-personalized training plan that evolves with you.
Whether you're looking to increase your power and strength on the court, minimize your risk of common pickleball injuries, or simply maintain your competitive edge as you age, AIM7 has you covered.
Download the AIM7 app for free and experience the difference personalized, AI-powered coaching can make for your pickleball game.
AIM7 offers a 12-month free trial with the selection of a premium subscription - you won't be charged during the free trial period. A premium monthly or annual subscription provides full access to all features and future updates.
Payment for this premium plan will be charged to your iTunes Account after the 12-month Free Trial period. The membership will automatically renew at $9.99/mo or 95.99/yr unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. By completing your purchase, you certify that you are at least 18 years old and that you understand and agree to the Terms of Service (https://www.aim7.com/terms-of-use) and Privacy Policy (https://www.aim7.com/privacy-policy). Auto-renewal may be turned off in your Account Setting in iTunes after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period. A user that cancels during a subscription month will not be charged for the following month.

bluejetty:00015986:ios.description:
Color by number app that is completely unique - color with swipes instead of taps. You are unlocking more paintings while leveling up, and we’re not hiding any tiny spots to color from you (no magnifying glass needed!). It is all you would want out of a paint by number app and more!
Besides making your painting realistic, April Coloring provides you with top-notch handcrafted free content and overall premium app quality, to help you become a more relaxed and creative person. To make sure that April Coloring brings you realistic experience and relaxation, we focused on user experience, simplicity and great community around the app!
WHY USE APRIL
● We know you appreciate coloring activities and probably you are using plenty of other coloring apps. What we wanted to excite you with is a completely unique approach towards the way coloring feels. Just download the app and check it out yourself!
● We want to make things easier for you. Just tap on the palette and you will find the right spot instantly. You may also tap on any spot on the main coloring board and you will highlight all required fields to paint the color number needed.
● Almost all content is free - unlockable while gathering more coloring experience (stars) and leveling up or collecting coins. This makes the whole experience a lot more fun!
● There is a daily content posted within the app - make sure you claim it regularly - otherwise past dailies are available only for users which subscribed!
● If you subscribe you will receive plenty of goodies - exclusive content, access to past dailies and all ads will be removed. On top you will support our team as we’re not treating April Coloring as a one-off but a long term project to innovate the coloring evergreen! 
● April Coloring is highly optimized for Apple Pencil. Check all the features that you can benefit from - including pressure and angle sensitivity / double tapping and more!
People all over the world are already enjoying our unique way of coloring – with over 1 000 000 paintings painted each month! Join them!
If you see anything we can improve, please, let us know! New reviews and support emails are really helpful to make our app better and smarter! Contact us via april@crimsonpine.com
___________________
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
By subscribing, you get unlimited access to all premium (marked with diamond) and locked (marked with padlock) paintings.
GOOD TO KNOW
● You can subscribe to a monthly plan (starting at $9.99, billed once a month). Availability and pricing of subscription plans may vary.
● The payment will be charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm the purchase.
● The subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original plan unless canceled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
● Free trial automatically converts to a paid subscription unless canceled at least 24-hours before the end of the trial period. From that point onwards, subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
● You can cancel the subscription or the free trial anytime via the subscription setting through your iTunes account (go to your device settings and tap iTunes & App Store > Apple ID > View Apple ID > enter the password > Subscriptions > Assembly > Cancel Subscription button at the bottom). Do it at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. Learn more: http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098
● Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases an April subscription.
Terms of Service: http://www.aprilcoloringapp.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: http://www.aprilcoloringapp.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00084826:ios.description:
BirthdayAlarm makes it easy to remember every special day with free birthday reminders and a huge collection of online greeting cards for every style — funny, heartfelt, animated, and more.
Get reminders straight to your phone with push notifications and see upcoming celebrations right on your Home Screen with the reminder widget. Make greetings extra special with group cards where everyone can add their message, photos and gifs, message suggestions to find the right words, and delivery right on time.
Why Millions Use BirthdayAlarm:
Unlimited Free Reminders – Birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and more.
Reminder Widget – See upcoming birthdays at a glance on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.
Push Notifications – Never miss a moment with alerts delivered straight to your phone.
5,000+ Digital Cards – Ecards, animated greetings, and gifs.
Group Cards – Invite friends, family, or coworkers to sign together, with their own photos and gifs.
Message Generator – Helps craft the perfect message (Premium).
Gift Cards – Add an eGift card from top brands to your card (Premium).
Schedule in Advance – Have cards arrive right on time.
Flexible Delivery – Send by email, text, or social media.
Easy Contact Import – Add birthdays from your phone's contacts in seconds.
Celebrate Every Occasion
Birthdays (including milestone & zodiac), anniversaries, congratulations, thank you, get well, sympathy, graduation, baby, wedding, “I love you,” and more.
Holidays include Christmas, Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Easter, Thanksgiving, New Year’s, Hanukkah, Halloween, and beyond.
Free vs Premium
Free Membership:
- Unlimited reminders & contacts
- Send free cards from our selection
- At-a-glance widget
Premium Membership:
- Full access to all 5,000+ digital cards
- Instant message suggestions for any occasion
- Add eGift cards from top brands to your cards
- First month free on the annual plan for new subscribers
- Pricing: $29.99/year (first month free for new subscribers) or $4.99/month. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Never forget a special day again. Download BirthdayAlarm and start sending online greetings and group cards in seconds!

Privacy Policy: https://birthdayalarm.com/privacy

bluejetty:00078827:ios.description:
Introducing Traffic Master: A 3D Puzzle Adventure to Test Your Skills and Beat the Jam!
Are you ready to embark on a thrilling puzzle journey through the bustling streets? Look no further than Traffic Master, the ultimate 3D puzzle game that combines excitement, strategy, and addictive fun! 
In this brain-teasing challenge, your mission is clear: maneuver cars through a gridlocked world without causing chaos. Tap your way to success, but be cautious—mistakes could lead to a collision! 
NAVIGATING THE GRIDLOCKED ADVENTURE
Traffic Master 3D isn't just a game; it's an immersive driving experience that takes you to new heights! The roads are filled with obstacles, from challenging parking situations to unexpected dead ends. One wrong move, and your car could flip or collide with others. Your task? Free the cars and bid farewell to the frustration of traffic jams! 
As you progress, the levels become more challenging, testing your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. Free all the cars to unlock special rewards, solve intricate puzzles, earn unique skins, and conquer levels without getting stuck. The road to success is filled with twists and turns—navigate wisely! 
MASTERING THE TRAFFIC PUZZLE
How do you ensure a smooth flow on the congested roads of Traffic Master 3D? Here's your guide:
1. Tap and Drive: Tap the car with the arrow to guide it in the desired direction. Your goal is to get all vehicles out of the road safely.
2. Strategic Decision-Making: Cars can move horizontally, vertically, or take a detour. Make smart decisions to untangle the traffic jam when the way out is uncertain.
3. Call for Help: When the going gets tough, don't hesitate to call the Helicopter for assistance. The pilot will swiftly take your car to safety!

bluejetty:00086443:ios.name: GuitarTab - Tabs & chords Pro
bluejetty:00086443:ios.summary:
GuitarTab is a tab player with one of the largest catalogs for tabs, chords and sheet music, offering access to more than 1000000 free guitar tabs and music sheets.
It includes GuitarPro tabs and chords for guitar, bass, ukulele and drums
bluejetty:00086443:ios.description:
GuitarTab is a tab player with one of the largest catalogs for tabs, chords and sheet music, offering access to more than 1000000 free guitar tabs and music sheets.
It includes GuitarPro tabs and chords for guitar, bass, ukulele and drums which also can be accessed offline. In addition to the large selection, you also have the option of importing your own tab files. Sync your favorites and playlists across different devices. The app also includes a built-in chromatic tuner and metronome - everything you need for practice and performance in one place.
Features:
- Access more than 1000000 guitar tabs & chords in various formats
- Open and play Guitar Pro tabs (supported formats: .gp3, .gp4, .gp5, .gpx and .gp)
- Open and play MusicXML files
- Realistic sound engine with various adjustment options, import your own synthesizer to customize the sound to your taste
- Search YouTube for music videos and lessons
- Download, print and share your favorite tabs
- Access your favorites and playlists accross different devices and use them also offline
- Edit tabs and import your own library
- Access interesting information about artists and albums
- Large chords dictionary
- Chromatic tuner - tune your guitar, bass, or ukulele with real-time pitch detection and visual feedback
- Metronome - keep time with an adjustable BPM metronome featuring beat accents and visual indicators
- Many other features: fullscreen and autoscroll mode, various display options, left-hand chords and many more!
The following extensions are available:
- Remove ads
- Printing feature
- Transpose and edit feature for text tabs
- Fretboard view, tempo control, changing instruments and muting single tracks
- Looping
- Importing tabs from various sources
- AI Tab Assistant – ask questions about the tab you're playing: Which chords do I need? How do I play this part? What should I practice first? The assistant knows the tab you have open and gives specific answers.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Offline Pixel Games

Gangs Wars offers an array of action games like fast taxi driving, police simulator, and pizza simulator. You can explore all these sporting action games within the cool open world map. And, yes, have fun with a pixel gun and enjoy the best top-tier ragdoll physics.
Police Chases
Take part in mafia and gangster wars. Stay alert – committing crimes increases your wanted level. Police chases will add thrilling excitement to your joy. If you get arrested, simply pay the fine and continue enjoying the action. Be ready, gang wars are already here!
Key Features
- One of the best free open world blocky and ragdoll games
- FPS shooting gameplay with an offline mode 
- Theft & Mafia Wars
- Challenging shooting with ragdoll physics
- Amusing sandbox driving simulator with a lot of secrets to discover
- Electrifying mini games

bluejetty:00033145:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00033145:ios.description:
Your personal trainer is just one click away! With Fitonomy, you will have your own health & fitness plan that you can reach from anywhere you want.
Fitonomy offers fitness programs with personalized workouts and meal plans. Depending on your fitness goals, Fitonomy generates customized workouts that you can do at home or the gym, regardless of your fitness experience. With a proper meal plan and a customized ab, back, and chest workout, you can build muscle, tone, and sculpt your body. Fitonomy also offers exercises that will decrease overall body pain levels.
Why spend money on pricey instructors and gym memberships when you can exercise yourself for free with Fitonomy? With Fitonomy FREE plan you will get access to many features from Personal Fitness Plans to Monthly Challenges:
PERSONALIZED WORKOUTS
Our exercise programs are personalized based on your fitness goals. In Fitonomy, you can find workouts & exercises like:
-HIIT workouts,
-Biceps,
-Leg workouts,
-Glutes,
-Ab workouts,
-Cardio,
-Arm exercises,
-Back and shoulder workouts,
MONTHLY CHALLENGES & ACHIEVEMENTS
If you need some motivation to stay consistent with your workout plan, Fitonomy offers you Monthly Challenges to join! You can challenge yourself to be healthy & fit with 28 or 30-day challenges.
CUSTOMIZED MEAL PLANS
The personally-tailored meal plans are created so you can get all the nutrition you need to achieve your fitness goals. The calories on your meal plan match your health goals and help you eat the right amount of food. Tone and sculpt your body, and get fit with the proper diet for your purpose.
TRACK YOUR FITNESS JOURNEY
Daily workouts work best when you keep track of it. Getting fit requires seeing your progress and tracking your workouts, calories, water intake steps, etc. Fitonomy offers all that.
INSPIRING COMMUNITY
Fitonomy’s Community is a support system that will help you during your health journey, to stay motivated, inspired, and achieve your goals together. Community is created to keep things fun while connecting with others.
By working out with Fitonomy, you:
» Have a personalized fitplan
» Have a 24-hour fitness on your phone
» Can get fit at home or at the gym
DO’S AND DONT’S
Learn about common mistakes that you should avoid during the workout, and learn the proper way of performing the exercises.
HOW TO
A step-by-step guide on how to perform exercises correctly.
PAIN RELIEF
Exercises and stretches will help you decrease inflammation, increase mobility, and decrease overall pain levels.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Fitonomy is free to download. Accessing premium features requires an active subscription, available on a weekly or annual basis. Weekly subscriptions are billed every week. Yearly subscriptions are billed the total annual fee from the purchase date.
We integrate the Health Kit so we can display the steps within our app. We also calculate the approximate calories burned from walking which then we display users the approximate amount on how many calories they have burned.
Payment will be charged to your credit card through your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. There is no increase in price when renewing.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings in App Store after purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Read our full Terms and conditions & Privacy Policy:
- Terms and Condition: https://fitonomyapp.com/terms-and-conditions
- Privacy Policy: https://fitonomyapp.com/privacy-policy
Join the millions of people that are using Fitonomy!
Start Working Out Now

bluejetty:00116399:ios.description:
Trioplay: Piano - Learn & Game: Experience Music Like Never Before! 
Unlock your musical potential with piano keyboard, the ultimate app for learning, playing, and enjoying music in an interactive and entertaining way. Whether you're a beginner exploring how to learn piano or an experienced musician looking for a fun practice tool, this Trioplay: Piano - Learn & Game app has everything you need.
Play & Learn with Realistic Piano Simulation
Turn your device into a real piano and start playing immediatey! Whether you're practicing scales, composing melodies, or simply playing for fun, our piano simulation provides an authentic sound and feel. It’s a great way to develop your skills while enjoying the joy of piano music.
Enjoy the Fun of Piano Tap Game
Challenge yourself with the piano game, where you tap on tiles to match the rhythm of the music. It's not only entertaining but also helps improve finger coordination, timing, and musical sense. 
Choose Your Piano Theme
Express your personal style with piano themes! Choose from a variety of colors and themes to match your mood and aesthetic preferences. 
More Than Just Piano – Explore Other Instruments
Expand your musical journey beyond the piano! Our app offers realistic simulations of other popular instrument games:
Guitar – Strum and pluck your way through beautiful melodies.
Drum Set – Feel the beat with a full drum experience.

bluejetty:00114932:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00114932:ios.description:
Welcome to Double Tile! Start your brain puzzles journey in this relaxing mahjong match solitaire game.
Double Tile! is a classic mahjong matching puzzle game with large tiles which blends mindful strategy with calming, healing atmosphere. It transforms the classic Mahjong experience into a relax puzzle retreat, inviting players to unwind, refocus, and find peace every mahjong match they make.
How to Play Double Tile!
· Objective: Clear the board by matching identical tiles. A tile is matchable when free on one side, and not covered by another tile.
· Gameplay: Tap two matching tiles to remove them. As the obvious tiles disappear, mahjong match will become more challenging. Planning ahead is a good approach to avoid dead ends.
· Helpful Tools: Click limited power-ups like ‘Hints’. It helps to reveal available mahjong match or Shuffles to rearrange tiles. Block game can be both puzzle and relaxing.
Unique Features of Double Tile!
· Modern & Clear Design: Enjoy extra-large, high-contrast tiles that are easy to read and satisfying to pop. The free mahjong games create a soft, inviting mahjong solitaire world.
· Soothing Audio: Gentle melodies and nature sounds—rainfall, rustling leaves, or distant streams—accompanying you to achieve every mahjong match in this puzzle blast game—immerse players in tranquility with relaxing puzzles.
Ready to Relax?
Whether you’re seeking a mindful break or a moment of quiet focus, Double Tile! offers an uplifting way to relax and recharge through the mahjong solitaire journey.
Download now to discover the joy of unwinding with Double Tile! We hope every puzzle lover enjoys this Zen mahjong experience.

bluejetty:00187638:ios.description:
قلک – مدیریت مالی شخصی و کسبوکار
قلک یک اپلیکیشن ساده، سریع و کاربردی برای مدیریت مالی شخصی و کسبوکار شماست. با قلک میتوانید حسابها، تراکنشها، چکها و تعهدات مالی خود وحتی فروشگاه خود را بهآسانی ثبت، پیگیری و تحلیل کنید. قلک به سه زبان فارسی، انگلیسی و عربی ارائه شده و ازهر سه تقویم شمسی، میلادی و هجری قمری پشتیبانی میکند.
امکانات اصلی:
مدیریت حساب و تراکنش
• ایجاد و مدیریت حسابهای متعدد با ارزهای مختلف
• ثبت سریع تراکنشهای درآمد و هزینه
• انتقال وجه بین حسابها
• تعیین هدف پسانداز برای هر حساب و پیگیری میزان پیشرفت آن
• ثبت خودکار تراکنشهای تکرارشونده (روزانه، هفتگی، ماهانه و...)
• یادآوری و اعلان برای تراکنشهای تکرارشونده و سررسیدها
مدیریت بدهکاری و طلبکاری
• تعریف اشخاص و مدیریت آن ها
• ثبت و مدیریت طلبکاری و بدهکاری و تسویه حساب
• خروجی و به اشتراک گذاری خروجی از وضعیت طلبکاری و بدهکاری
مدیریت کامل یک فروشگاه
• تعریف کالا ها، مدیریت کالا ها و انبار داری. 
• بارکد خوان از طریق دوربین گوشی
• صدور فاکتور فروش، خرید، مرجوعی 
• محاسبات فروش، سود، وضعیت دارایی فروشگاه
• خروجی های مختلف از انبار، فاکتور، سود و گزارشات و اشتراک گذاری آن ها
مدیریت چک
• ثبت و پیگیری چکهای دریافتنی و پرداختنی
• یادآوری و اعلان قابل شخصیسازی برای سررسید چکها
• آرشیو چکهای پاسشده یا لغوشده
گزارشگیری و تحلیل مالی
• گزارشهای پیشرفته همراه با نمودارهای متنوع برای بررسی وضعیت مالی
• حالت اختصاصی کسبوکار (Business Mode) با فیلتر دستهبندی و نمودارهای تخصصیتر
• خروجی گرفتن از گزارشها بهصورت PDF و اکسل
• شخصیسازی گسترده خروجیها (لوگو، عنوان، رنگی یا سیاهوسفید، ستونهای دلخواه و...) مناسب برای استفاده شخصی و حرفهای
• محاسبه و نمایش درصد (کمیسیون) روی تراکنشها، مناسب کسبوکارهایی که بهصورت درصدی کار میکنند
• آرشیو و مدیریت خروجیهای قبلی
پشتیبانگیری و همگامسازی
• پشتیبان گیری و همگامسازی خودکار اطلاعات بین دستگاهها از طریق iCloud
• پشتیبانگیری و بازیابی دستی اطلاعات
سازماندهی
• گروهبندی حسابها در پوشههای دلخواه، مناسب برای مدیریت راحتتر کسبوکارهای چندحسابه
امکانات جانبی
• ویجتهای متنوع برای نمایش سریع وضعیت مالی روی صفحه اصلی
• نمایش قیمت لحظهای دلار و طلا
• قفلگذاری روی برنامه با Face ID / Touch ID
• تمهای رنگی متنوع همراه با حالت روشن و تاریک
• جستوجوی سریع در تراکنشها و چکها
با قلک، همیشه تصویری روشن و دقیق از وضعیت مالی شخصی و کسبوکار خود خواهید داشت.

Ghollak – Personal & Business Finance Manager
Ghollak is a simple, fast, and practical app for managing your personal and business finances. With Ghollak, you can easily record, track, and analyze your accounts, transactions, checks, and financial commitments. Ghollak is free to use, with more advanced tools available for professional users and businesses. The app is multi language (Persian/English/Arabic) and supports the Persian (Jalali), Gregorian and Hijri calendars.
Key Features:
Accounts & Transactions
• Create and manage multiple accounts in different currencies
• Quickly record income and expense transactions
• Set a savings goal for any account and track your progress
• Automatically record recurring transactions (daily, weekly, monthly, and more)
• Reminders and notifications for recurring transactions and upcoming due dates
Management of payables and receivables with multi-currency support
• Defining and managing contacts/parties
• Recording and managing receivables, payables, and settlements
• Exporting and sharing status reports on receivables and payables
Comprehensive store management
• Defining and managing products and inventory
• Barcode scanner via phone camera
• Issuing sales, purchase, and return invoices
• Calculating sales, profit, and store asset status
• Generating and sharing various reports on inventory, invoices, and profits
Reporting & Financial Analysis
• Advanced reports with a variety of charts to review your financial status
• Export reports as PDF or Excel
• Extensive export customization (logo, title, color or grayscale, custom columns, and more) suited to both personal and professional use
Backup & Sync
• Automatic sync across devices via iCloud
• Manual backup and restore

bluejetty:00174846:ios.description:
Designed by a mom to track her own newborn’s activity, Nara Baby Tracker has an intuitive, calming design that allows you to easily track naps, diaper changes, feeding schedules, wake windows, and more. Discover patterns and create routines while tracking your baby’s progress.
Easily coordinate and share information across parents, caregivers, and devices with complete privacy. The app is also built to track and compare multiple children or twins.
For parents, Nara allows you to support your own well-being. Track physical and mental health while pregnant and postpartum, set reminders for doctor’s appointments, write journal notes, and create self-care routines. 
1.5 million+ parents have used Nara to track, learn, and grow alongside their babies.
BABY
Track breastfeeding & bottle feeding
- Tap the breastfeeding timer to track left/right feeding; Nara notes which side ended the last feed
- Track bottle feeding (formula or breastmilk) by time and amount
- Use the pumping timer on each side for easy tracking
- Not breastfeeding? Turn off any activity you don’t want to track
- Record solids — dozens of first foods are already preloaded
- Identify feeding patterns and create a schedule
- Upload photos and notes for any feeding session
Track diaper changes
- Quickly record wet, dirty or dry diapers
- Record diaper rashes with one tap
- Accurately track bowel habits and share with your pediatrician
- Hand off childcare with the most recent diaper change recorded
Track sleep patterns & naps
- Use the sleep timer to record naps & nighttime sleep
- Add sleep sessions with start/end times
- See sleep patterns with automatic graphs and comparisons by day or week
- Create a nap routine based on wake windows
- Accurately record when baby starts sleeping through the night
Track your baby’s growth & health
- Record weight, height, and head size by date
- Accurately track newborn weight gain
- Track developmental milestones by age
- Log medical records and medications
- Record vaccines by date and add notes post-doctor appointment
Share across caregivers & multiple children
- Invite partners, grandparents, and caregivers to your Nara account
- View baby’s recent activities when caregivers switch roles
- Access the app from multiple devices, including your Apple Watch

- Track routines like tummy time, baths, story time and more
- Quickly see the day’s routine when switching caregivers
- Add notes & photos for baby’s first smile, steps, teeth and more
Live Activities, Siri + Apple Watch 
- Get real time updates
- Stop and start tracking without unlocking your phone
PARENTS

Watch kid safe,
bluejetty:00015563:ios.description:
Watch live TV, stream, and download educational episodes and songs with PBS KIDS Video! Safely stream videos from shows like Daniel Tiger’s Neighborhood, Wild Kratts, Sesame Street, Phoebe & Jay, Weather Hunters, and more!
Watch kid safe, educational videos and songs anytime, anywhere! Download free episodes and learn alongside PBS KIDS favorites in your home or on the go. Watch educational shows to encourage early learning for toddlers and grade school children.
PBS KIDS Video is a safe, kid-friendly streaming video app where your kids can watch episodes, movies, and songs of select shows with English or Spanish audio and captioning!
Stream videos that are child safe or download episodes. You can also watch live TV from your local PBS KIDS channel on the app with no subscription!
*2025 Finalist for Apple TV App of the Year
*2025 - 2026 Apps, Software & Immersive, Kids & Family, Webby Winner, People’s Voice Winner
PBS KIDS VIDEO FEATURES:
STREAM EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS & SONGS
- Watch 700+ free full episodes of over 50+ PBS KIDS shows
- Stream live TV or watch and listen to songs from children shows
- Listen to songs from PBS KIDS shows or watch fun sing-alongs
WATCH KID SHOWS OFFLINE
- Download shows to watch offline
- Get educational videos, movies, and songs anytime
NEW VIDEOS & EPISODES EVERY MONTH
- Watch new episodes from your favorite, award-winning PBS KIDS shows:
- Daniel Tiger’s Neighborhood
- Wild Kratts
- Sesame Street
- Phoebe & Jay
- Count on June Bug
- Weather Hunters
- Lyla in the Loop
- Carl the Collector
- Odd Squad
- Work It Out Wombats!
- Alma’s Way
- Arthur
- Super Why’s Comic Book Adventures
- Curious George
- And more!
WATCH IN ENGLISH, SPANISH, OR WITH AMERICAN SIGN LANGUAGE
- Bilingual kids will love watching episodes in English or Spanish
- Stream and watch with English or Spanish captioning
- Watch with descriptive audio and Spanish descriptive audio
- Enjoy 15 PBS KIDS series with American Sign Language (ASL) support
This app update is only compatible with iOS 15 or higher.
GEOGRAPHIC RESTRICTIONS
The PBS KIDS videos may only be viewed from within the United States. This is due to restrictions on PBS's license to offer this service.
DOWNLOAD RESTRICTIONS
Currently, select shows can be downloaded: Daniel Tiger’s Neighborhood, Alma’s Way, City Island, Carl the Collector, Count on June Bug, Donkey Hodie, Dinosaur Train, Elinor Wonders Why, Jelly Ben & Pogo, Let’s Go Luna, Lyla in the Loop, Nature Cat, Peg + Cat, Phoebe & Jay, Odd Squad, Rosie’s Rules, Sesame Street, SUPER WHY!, Tiny Time Travel, Weather Hunters, Wild Kratts, Word World, Work It Out Wombats!, and Xavier Riddle & the Secret Museum. Additional shows will become available for download in the near future.
SPONSORSHIP
PBS KIDS Video is a key part of PBS KIDS’ commitment to making a positive impact on the lives of children through curriculum-based entertainment—wherever kids are. More PBS KIDS videos may also be found online at pbskids.org/video.
Funding from corporate sponsors supports PBS KIDS’ mission to use the power of media to open worlds of possibilities for all children. To acknowledge the vital support that PBS KIDS receives, brief messages from corporate sponsors are included at the start of select full-length episodes on the PBS KIDS Video App. You can support PBS KIDS through the selection of other apps and TV shows available in the App Store and Apple TV app.
ABOUT THIS APP
The PBS KIDS Video app gives kids and parents access to thousands of videos, including full episodes and clips from top PBS KIDS series. With this app, kids can watch their favorite PBS KIDS shows anytime, anywhere! PBS KIDS, the #1 educational media brand for kids, helps children ages 2-8 learn lessons that last a lifetime.
This app was designed by PBS KIDS.

Get behind the wheel in Traffic Master – Jam Buster, the ultimate traffic puzzle game where your mission is to tap, think, and outsmart chaos on jam-packed highways! Can you guide every car to safety without causing a pileup?
Gameplay that Puts You in Control
Tap on vehicles to clear a path through tightly packed traffic. Each car follows a specific route — it's up to you to plan the perfect sequence and avoid crashes! Every level is a new challenge that tests your timing, logic, and quick decision-making.

- Strategic Thinking Required – Think ahead and tap cars in the right order to avoid collisions and solve each puzzle.
- Special Scenarios – Guide emergency vehicles, handle one-way chaos, and more unique gameplay twists.
- Unlock Special Vehicles – Earn rewards and collect cool cars with fun designs and special abilities.
- Stunning Visuals – Bright, clean graphics and smooth animations bring the traffic chaos to life.
- Easy to Play, Hard to Master – Perfect for quick breaks or long puzzle-solving sessions. The challenge grows as you go!
Whether you're a casual gamer or a puzzle pro, Traffic Master – Jam Buster delivers satisfying gameplay that keeps you coming back for more. Ready to clear the gridlock and become the ultimate jam buster?
Download now and take control of the traffic!

WHAT IS HALLOW
Hallow is a Christian prayer app that offers audio-guided meditation sessions to help us grow in our faith & spiritual lives and find peace in God. Explore over 10,000 different sessions on contemplative prayer, meditation, Catholic Bible readings, music, and more.
In today’s world, we’re stressed, anxious, distracted, & can’t sleep. At the same time, we’re searching for deeper meaning, purpose, & relationships. We believe these two challenges can be addressed with the same solution: peace in Jesus. In the end, after all, a halo in heaven is the goal :)
WHAT YOU GET
* Daily prayers: Pray daily across methods including 3 of our most popular - Lectio Divina (on the Daily Readings), the Rosary, & the Divine Mercy Chaplet
* Christian Meditation: This can seem similar to mindfulness meditation in learning to be comfortable in silence, but the difference is the goal is never to remain in ourselves, but always to lift our hearts & minds to God, to talk with Him, listen to Him, & recognize His presence with us
* Sleep Bible Stories: Try Night Prayer from Liturgy of the Hours / Daily Office, and Catholic Bible stories read by folks like Jonathan Roumie from the Chosen or Fr. Mike Schmitz from the New American Bible
* Rosary: Meditate with Mary through the mysteries of the Catholic Rosary and other devotionals
* Ignatian Examen: Reflect on your day & discover an awareness of God, Jesus Christ, & the Holy Spirit
* Lectio Divina: Enter into a conversation with God through Bible passages / Scripture
* Taizé & Traditional Chant: Meditative chant & music
* Community: Match your prayers to the season with the Pray40 Lent Challenge, starting Ash Wednesday, or our Pray25 Advent Challenge for Christmas
* Homilies & Guests: From Father Mike Schmitz, and on topics on being a Catholic Dad, St. Augustine & more!
* Praylists: Sessions on joy, humility, discernment, or stress / anxiety / calm
* Challenges: Re-discover the Our Father, Stations of the Cross, Psalms, and Saints - or start with the Intro 9 Day Novena
* Litanies & Novenas: Try out the Litany of Humility, the 54 Day Novena, and more!
* Pray like a Champion today: Athlete Prayers
* Minute Meditations: Jesus, I Trust in You, Angelus, Rosary Decade, St. Michael the Archangel prayer and more!
Additional features to help customize your prayer experience:
* Journal after every prayer
* Choice of 50+ guides
* Options for 3 different lengths for every prayer (typically 5, 10, or 15 minutes)
* Ability to set prayer reminders
* Option to include calming background music like Gregorian Chant
* Ability to download sessions for offline listening
* Join a Hallow Family to share prayer intentions and prayer reflections with one another
As Hallow is a Catholic App (#1 among Catholic Apps), the content is developed by experienced Catholic theology and spirituality guides and reviewed by senior leaders within the Church (e.g., PhD’s, professors, Bishops, authors) and based on content from the approved Catholic Bible. We were also featured on EWTN. While it can be a beautiful app for Catholic men and women, it is meant as a resource for people of all faiths & religions.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Users can access our daily prayers (including the rosary) and the 9-day Intro Prayer Challenge for free.
To access the full suite of Hallow, Hallow offers two auto-renewing subscription options:
$9.99 per month
$69.99 per year
These prices are for United States customers.
Your Hallow subscription will renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Apple account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. Hallow also integrates with the Apple Health app to sync mindfulness minutes.
Terms and conditions: https://hallow.com/terms-of-service
Privacy policy: https://hallow.com/privacy-policy

Embarking on the journey to obtain a driver's license is an exciting yet challenging task. The Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) test is a crucial step in this process, and proper preparation is essential to ensure success. 
Features:
1. **Comprehensive Content Coverage:
 DMV Practice Test 2025 boasts an extensive database of up-to-date and accurate information covering all aspects of the DMV test. From traffic signs and regulations to essential driving skills, our app ensures you are well-prepared for every question that may come your way.
2. **Interactive Learning Modules:** 
Say goodbye to monotonous study materials. DMV Practice Test 2025 engages users with interactive learning modules, making the process enjoyable and effective. Our carefully crafted quizzes and simulations simulate real exam conditions, allowing you to familiarize yourself with the format and pace of the DMV test.
3. **Realistic Practice Tests:** 
 To boost your confidence and assess your readiness, DMV Practice Test 2025 offers realistic practice tests modeled after the DMV exams. Track your progress, identify areas that need improvement, and fine-tune your knowledge for success on the actual test day.
4. **Personalized Study Plans:** 
Recognizing that each learner has unique needs, DMV Practice Test 2025 features personalized study plans. Tailor your preparation based on your strengths and weaknesses, ensuring a targeted approach to conquering the DMV test.
5. **Detailed Explanations and Feedback:** 
Understand the reasoning behind correct and incorrect answers with detailed explanations provided by DMV Practice Test 2025 . This invaluable feedback enhances your understanding of the material, turning mistakes into learning opportunities.
6. **Offline Access:** 
No internet? No problem. DMV Practice Test 2024 allows you to access study materials and practice tests offline, providing flexibility and convenience for learners on the go
7. **User-Friendly Interface:
**DMV Practice Test 2025 prioritizes user experience with an intuitive interface designed for easy navigation. Whether you're a tech-savvy individual or not, our app ensures a seamless and hassle-free learning experience.
8. **Progress Tracking and Analytics:**
 Keep tabs on your progress with DMV Practice Test 2025s comprehensive tracking and analytics features. Monitor your performance over time, celebrate achievements, and identify areas that require additional attention.
9. **Regular Updates:** 
The rules of the road are constantly evolving, and DMV Practice Test 2025 understands the importance of staying current. Our team ensures that the app is regularly updated with the latest information, ensuring you are well-prepared for any changes in the DMV test content.
IMPORTANT
All content, practice tests, study materials, questions, explanations, and features shown in the screenshots are available exclusively through a weekly auto-renewable subscription.

PC Pilot Magazine
Brought to you by Key Publishing Ltd, the World’s Leading Aviation Publisher. 
Published bi-monthly, PC Pilot magazine is the biggest-selling flight simulation magazine in the world. From the most detailed instrument-only simulator to fast-paced combat sims and everything in between, it’s your one-stop shop for Flight Simulation! Each issue features reviews of the latest simulation software, new stand-alone programmes, add-on aircraft, plus scenery and utility software for Microsoft’s Flight Simulator series and other commercial simulations. 
Each issue* also includes free access to the download content, supplied with the print edition.
Regular features include:
• Sim News: The latest flight simulation news from around the world
• Product Reviews: Reviews of the latest simulation software – who will achieve the coveted PC Pilot Platinum award?
• Industry Profiles: Interviews with publishers and developers within the industry 
• Tutorials: Advanced flight tutorials and training, from expert virtual pilots
• Beginner’s Guides: Tips and technical advice for the novice flight simmer
And much more!
