bluejetty:00174579:ios.name: Polar Scope Align
bluejetty:00174579:ios.summary:
Polar Scope Align is a free, ad-supported polar alignment app for iPhone and iPad.
It calculates the position of Polaris or σ Octantis in your polar scope reticle for your location, date and time, helping you get a quick and accurate polar
bluejetty:00174579:ios.description:
Polar Scope Align is a free, ad-supported polar alignment app for iPhone and iPad.
It calculates the position of Polaris or σ Octantis in your polar scope reticle for your location, date and time, helping you get a quick and accurate polar alignment with an equatorial mount.
POLAR SCOPE ALIGNMENT
• Accurate Polaris and Sigma Octantis position for your date and location
• Atmospheric refraction correction for better accuracy, especially at lower latitudes - readings may differ slightly from simpler apps that skip this correction, but will agree with precise sources (USNO, scientific software)
• Automatic time and location
• Manual location support
• Reticle centering-error measurement and correction
• Zero-position help for common Celestron / Sky-Watcher / Orion style reticles
• Full red night-mode interface
SUPPORTED RETICLES
Polar Scope Align supports 35+ polar scope and finder reticle types, including:
iOptron, Astro-Physics RAPAS & PASILL, Takahashi (EM-10/11/200/400/500, NJP, PM-1, P2-Z), Sky-Watcher / Orion (including EQ6/AZ-EQ and Star Adventurer), Celestron, Meade, EXOS2, Bresser, Vixen (Atlux/SX/SXD/SXP/AXD/GP/GP-DX, Polarie), Astrotrac, Losmandy, Kenko, Avalon, Konus, Telrad, Rigel QuikFinder, and several older polar finders (Tuthill, Explore Scientific, Meade 9x60, Vixen Polaris, Celestron 7x50, Carton Optical).
OBSERVING TOOLS
The free version also includes:
• Moon phase
• Messier, Caldwell and bright-star database
• DSS image downloads for included database objects
• Saved, editable and printable DSO lists
• 8 astronomy calculators for observing and imaging
• Sample Pro tools available from Settings, including aurora forecast
• iOptron WiFi Connect - report mount status, set mount Time/Date/Location
LOOKING FOR ALIGNMENT WITHOUT A POLAR SCOPE?
Polar Scope Align Pro adds the advanced tools many users search for:
• Daytime / No Polar Scope Alignment
• Camera Azimuth Calibration using the Sun, Moon, planets or bright stars
• Laser / Hop Align for night alignment when Polaris is blocked
• Push To / manual GoTo for non-GoTo telescopes
• Live sky maps for Daytime Alignment, Laser / Hop Align, Push To and Hop To
• Full 22,000+ object DSO database
• Xasteria astro weather, aurora, satellite passes and widgets
• 30+ calculators
• Bubble level, compass and iOptron WiFi mount control
• Apple Watch companion app
• No ads
If you only need accurate polar-scope alignment, this free version is a capable tool. If you want alignment without a polar scope, observing planning, weather and field tools, Pro is the complete version.

The free version also includes:
• Moon phase
• Messier, Caldwell and bright-star database
• DSS image downloads for included database objects
• Saved, editable and printable DSO lists
• 8 astronomy calculators for observing and imaging
• Sample Pro tools available from Settings, including aurora forecast
• iOptron WiFi Connect - report mount status, set mount Time/Date/Location

Polar Scope Align Pro adds the advanced tools many users search for:

• Daytime / No Polar Scope Alignment
• Camera Azimuth Calibration using the Sun, Moon, planets or bright stars
• Laser / Hop Align for night alignment when Polaris is blocked
• Push To / manual GoTo for non-GoTo telescopes
• Live sky maps for Daytime Alignment, Laser / Hop Align, Push To and Hop To
• Full 22,000+ object DSO database
• Xasteria astro weather, aurora, satellite passes and widgets
• 30+ calculators
• Bubble level, compass and iOptron WiFi mount control
• Apple Watch companion app
• No ads

If you only need accurate polar-scope alignment, this free version is a capable tool. If you want alignment without a polar scope, observing planning, weather and field tools, Pro is the complete version.

bluejetty:00076897:ios.summary:

Escape a limitless castle with an undead twist in this roguevania action platformer. Find secrets, take down bosses, and if you die? Start from the bottom and reignite the fight.

bluejetty:00076897:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
Escape a limitless castle with an undead twist in this roguevania action platformer. Find secrets, take down bosses, and if you die? Start from the bottom and reignite the fight.
You’re what’s left after a botched experiment in an abandoned castle made you a pile of undead sludge. All you need to escape is someone else’s less-than-alive body and the sheer will to battle your way through a constantly changing, pixel art castle full of rogue enemies and terrifying bosses. Learn the ropes of action-packed 2D combat and platform exploration, master a variety of weapons and develop your strengths as you unravel the secrets of the dungeon, the castle and whatever lies beyond. 
Also: don’t worry about dying. That’s what the giant pile of corpses in the dungeon is for. Fight, learn, die, start over and keep getting better.
The Netflix edition includes all of the free and paid downloadable content created for the original game, so members can experience the full scope of their escape from the first awakening. Battle through the secret Arboretum in "The Bad Seed" expansion, hone your combat skills in "Rise of the Giant," rise from the dungeon to the shore with "Fatal Falls," fight the castle’s baddest boss in "The Queen and the Sea" and enlist the help of iconic Castlevania characters Alucard and Richter Belmont to take on Dracula in the ultra-retro "Return to Castlevania" DLC. 
Features:
• Fight unique enemies in each castle biome and learn how to evade their special abilities. 
• Loot and level up new weapons, advantages, genetic enhancements and more to customize your hero on every new escape attempt.
• Awaken into a new challenge every time you resurrect; with the castle’s magically shifting layout, no two runs will ever be the same. 
• Explore secret areas within and around the castle to unlock big rewards (or even bigger bosses).
- From Motion Twin, Evil Empire and Playdigious.

bluejetty:00144665:ios.name: Boligsiden
bluejetty:00144665:ios.summary:
Boligsiden hjælper dig igang, med et boligkøb eller et boligsalg, eller hvis du er nysgerrig efter at se boliger til salg for at undersøge, om det er nu, du skal sælge og flytte til en ny bolig?
Uanset, hvor du befinder dig på din boligrejs
bluejetty:00144665:ios.description:
Boligsiden hjælper dig igang, med et boligkøb eller et boligsalg, eller hvis du er nysgerrig efter at se boliger til salg for at undersøge, om det er nu, du skal sælge og flytte til en ny bolig?
Uanset, hvor du befinder dig på din boligrejse, har Boligsiden det rette værktøj til dig. Boligsiden har sørget for, at appen er gratis og uden annoncer, så du til enhver tid kan se alle boliger til salg. Hent den nu, og giv os en anmeldelse herunder.
HER FINDER DU HJEM
Find bolig, når du er på farten eller hjemme i sofaen. Med appen er Boligsiden altid lige ved hånden og hjælper dig, uanset om du er på jagt efter et nyt hus, en ny lejlighed, et sommerhus eller vil give et bud på en ejendom på tvangsauktion. Boligsiden hjælper dig til at finde hjem.
Appen holdes hele tiden opdateret, så du altid kan se det aktuelle udvalg af boliger til salg på Boligsiden. Der er forskellige måder, du kan søge ny bolig på. Det er blandt andet:
• Find bolig ved at skrive landsdel, kommune, by eller vejnavn, eller skriv en specifik adresse i søgefeltet.
• Søg bolig ved at tegne et søgeområde på kortet med din finger.
• Tryk på ”Nær dig” og find den villa, det sommerhus eller den lejlighed, som du står ved lige nu og som har et ”Til-salg-skilt” i forhaven. Måske er det dit nye hjem.
Uanset hvad, kan du via Boligsiden nemt finde det rigtige hus, lejlighed eller sommerhus med den ønskede beliggenhed, så du kan komme godt i gang med dit boligkøb.
DIT BOLIGKØB STARTER HER
Husk, at du kan indsnævre din søgning ved at justere pris, boligtype, størrelse og meget mere. Og er du på jagt efter en helt ny bolig, der lige er sat til salg, skal du blot sortere din søgning efter liggetid. Du kan også finde informationer om energimærke, antal værelser, tidligere salgspriser og meget mere.
Du kan gemme op til fem søgninger og boliger uden at være logget ind. Opretter du en profil, kan du gemme helt op til 30 søgninger og lige så mange favoritboliger, som du ønsker. Du kan overvåge dine boliger, både via push-beskeder og via e-mail. Så får du besked, så snart der er nye boliger til salg i dine gemte søgninger.
Du kan også læse nyt om boligmarkedet i appens nyhedssektion, og tilmelde dig push-beskeder inden for nyheder. Vi udgiver dagligt nyheder om udbud, boligpriser, antallet af handler og meget mere. Du kan også læse artikler, hvor vi præsenterer den flotte villa, den naturskønne landejendom, det helt særlige sommerhus eller den elegante lejlighed.
Kort sagt: Find bolig, søg bolig og start dit boligkøb eller boligsalg med Boligsidens app. Som et ekstra plus er appen gratis, og der er ingen annoncer. Find din næste bolig med Boligsidens app.
God fornøjelse med dit boligkøb.
FIND HJEM MED BOLIGSIDEN SIDEN 2009
Boligsiden har været et selvstændigt aktieselskab siden 2009. Boligsiden er ejet af stort set alle ejendomsmæglere og Dansk Ejendomsmæglerforening. Det sikrer, at alle oplysninger altid er opdaterede.
Boligsiden får alle boliger til salg direkte fra ejendomsmægler, og derfor kan du med Boligsidens app finde din næste bolig hurtigere end alle andre steder. Så når du skal have nyt hjem, finder du den lækre villa, den flotte lejlighed eller det charmerende sommerhus lige her.

bluejetty:00019146:ios.name: Ice Fishing Derby
bluejetty:00019146:ios.summary: The free version of Ice Fishing Derby: It's a five day fishing derby with a twist. The forecast for the first day is pretty nice, but it's going to get much, much colder as the days go by. Start each day at the bait shop to get the tackle
bluejetty:00019146:ios.description:
The free version of Ice Fishing Derby: It's a five day fishing derby with a twist. The forecast for the first day is pretty nice, but it's going to get much, much colder as the days go by. Start each day at the bait shop to get the tackle you need. Catch bluegills, crappie, perch, walleyes and northern pike. At the end of each day you'll collect cash at the weigh-in for the fish you've caught. Be sure to earn enough to pay for a portable shelter and heater or you're not likely to survive. Start with some basic gear and catch some panfish, then work your way up to catching the bigger fish. Once you have the necessities you might get yourself a sonar flasher or even an underwater camera system so you can see what's happening under the ice. Your goal is simple: Survive the tournament, and earn as much money as possible. Other fishermen may offer you some interesting trades out on the lake, but be careful what deals you accept!
The game is free but in-app purchases unlock a few items in the bait shop and give you the option of starting each tournament with more money.
Note: Some people have had problems running the previous version of the game due to a bug in iOS 8.0. Either updating your device to iOS 8.1 or updating the game to 1.06 should fix it. If you have any trouble with the game, please email us at support@pishtech.com and we'll be happy to help.

bluejetty:00022236:ios.description:
Planimeter – Area & Distance Measurement on Map
Planimeter is a powerful map measurement tool that helps you accurately measure distance, area, and perimeter directly on satellite maps. It is an essential app for land measurement, outdoor planning, and professional mapping tasks.
Whether you are a homeowner, builder, surveyor, or outdoor enthusiast, this GPS map measurement tool gives you fast and precise results anytime, anywhere.
Key Features:
1. Accurate Area & Distance Measurement
Measure land area, field size, property boundaries, routes, and perimeters with high precision using satellite map data.
2. Outdoor & Home Projects
Perfect for lawn planning, garden design, fencing, roofing, and any DIY outdoor project that requires reliable land measurement.
3. Sports & Recreation Tracking
Measure biking routes, running paths, golf distances, and racing tracks. Track how far you go with real-world accuracy.
4. Construction & Land Survey Tool
Ideal for builders, engineers, and surveyors to measure plots, building footprints, roof areas, and road lengths quickly.
5. Flexible Units Support
Switch between metric and imperial units (meters, feet, kilometers, miles, acres, hectares) based on your needs.
6. Elevation & Altitude Data
Check altitude information at any selected point on the map for more advanced terrain analysis.
7. Google Earth & KML Support
Import and export KML files, fully compatible with Google Earth and other GIS tools for professional workflows.
Why Choose Planimeter?
• Fast & accurate GPS-based measurements
• Easy-to-use map interface
• Supports professional land surveying tasks
• Works for both personal and commercial use
We are constantly improving Planimeter to provide a better experience.
For feedback or suggestions, contact us at: miaozhi.ai@gmail.com

bluejetty:00077582:ios.description:
◆ Stay focused and develop habits.
Focusing makes us more efficient and good habits make our lives happier.
Whether at work or at school, when you want to improve efficiency, focus can often get half the result with twice the effort. Focusing on what you expect will certainly make a difference.
The reason why a person is excellent is because there are excellent habits behind it. Many times, we can't see how powerful the habits are, but at the critical moment we will understand the power of habits.
FocusFlow is carefully designed with focus, habit, and to-do modes, so you can see at a glance the daily focus, habit, and to-do situation, allowing you to develop focus and good habits in a more targeted way.
◆ What are the features of FocusFlow?
- Widgets: Support iOS 14 to add widgets to your desktop
- Focus: Create a focus plan with a frequency of daily, weekly, weekly x days, monthly x days
- Focus statistics: study, work, exercise, reading, different categories of clear focus time
- Focus countdown: choose a focus duration of 5-180 minutes and choose different sound scenes to start focusing
- Habits: create good habits to be cultivated with a frequency of daily, weekly, x days per week, x days per month cycles
- Habit statistics: the number of days each habit has been completed and the percentage of pie charts for each habit at a glance
- Habit log: you can choose different Emoji emoji and support uploading pictures
- Today's to-do list: You can create a to-do list with repeating frequency
- Customized bottom bar: Focus, Habits, and To Do bottom bar can be swapped
- Data backup: automatic data backup in the cloud, multi-device synchronization
- Focus/habit reminder: Timed reminder according to the created reminder time
- Privacy protection: Password lock to protect your private data

Temperature App – your go-to solution for checking ambient temperatures and daily weather forecasts. Transform your device into a versatile weather companion that provides essential insights into your environment.

Application Highlights :
Temperature Estimation:
Monitor temperature trends in your surroundings with our intuitive app, offering reliable estimates to help keep you comfortable throughout the day.
Temperature and Humidity Checker:
Stay informed about temperature and humidity levels with our comprehensive checker feature, using real-time weather data for both indoor-like and outdoor contexts.
Thermometer App :
Enjoy the convenience of a thermometer-style interface that displays live temperature estimates, designed for ease and clarity.
Weather Temperature Check:
Quickly view the current weather temperature at any location, keeping you prepared for whatever the day may bring.
Hygrometer for Humidity:
Track humidity levels with our built-in hygrometer feature, giving you deeper insights into your surrounding environment.
Free and Accessible:
Download and use the app at no cost, with access to all essential tools for monitoring local temperature and climate conditions.
Ambient Weather Insights:
Get updates on wind speed, atmospheric pressure, and other environmental data for a complete overview of weather around you.
Location-Based Estimates:
Temperature and humidity values adapt to your current location, delivering localized weather insights whenever you need them.
User-Friendly Experience:
Designed for simplicity and ease of use, the app offers a smooth and intuitive interface for tracking temperature and weather data.
Multiple Measurement Units:

* Today's weather conditions
* 7-day weather forecast
* Humidity level overview
* Air quality information
* Wind strength
* Daily weather checking
* Travel planning
* Outdoor activities
* Temperature monitoring anytime
* Thermometer-style temperature display
Note: This app provides temperature and humidity estimates based on external weather data and device conditions. It does not measure ambient temperature directly.
Take control of your environment with the Temperature App – a smart, user-friendly solution for weather awareness. Download now and enjoy seamless tracking that goes beyond the basics.

bluejetty:00143900:ios.summary: TeamHub is the all-in-one sports team management app for youth, reacreational and competitive sports teams. TeamHub provides simple, yet powerful solutions for communicating with members, scheduling events, scorekeeping games and generating
bluejetty:00143900:ios.description:
TeamHub is the all-in-one sports team management app for youth, reacreational and competitive sports teams. TeamHub provides simple, yet powerful solutions for communicating with members, scheduling events, scorekeeping games and generating stats.
Our app makes your life easier to manage any sports team of all ages and skill levels. We currently support 100 different sports for scorekeeping such as baseball, football, basketball, hockey, rugby, volleyball, tennis, badminton and so on. You can use our app without scorekeeping even if your team's sport is not supported yet.
KEY FEATURES
* FEED - Feed is the hub for all team communication. Quickly view upcoming events and latest posts to keep yourself updated with what's going on with your team. Create surveys and questionnaires to collect members opinions and event availabilities.
* PRACTICE AND GAME SCHEDULING - Calendar view makes it easy to access up-to-date practice and game schedules. List view is a little more detailed and lets you see the number of comments and attendees for each event.
* EVENT RSVP - Notify your members of the event through push notifications and emails. Track who’s coming, not coming or not responded to each game or practice with the list of attendees, absentees and nonrespondents.
* MEMBER MANAGEMENT - Maintain members and contact info all in one place. Mailing list is created for members of each team so that you can easily make announcements to members even without the app installed on their smartphone.
* SIMPLE SCOREKEEPING - Anyone can add scores to games in a sport specific way. For soccer, it is as simple as adding who scored when, and for baseball, capture the play-by-play with our advanced scorekeeping tool.
* AUTOMATIC STATS GENERATION - Your team and individual stats for each season and tournament are automatically generated everytime you scorekeep a game. View stats to back up your decisions on rosters and tactics for upcoming games.
HOW TO GET STARTED
1. Download TeamHub and create your account
2. Create your team in the app
3. Invite all members of your team
4. Schedule a game, practice, or other team events
5. Notify team members to mark their availability so you know who can make events
6. Scorekeep a game and write recap
7. View generated stats to analyze your team's performance
HOW CAN TEAMHUB HELP YOUR TEAM?
ADMINISTRATORS: Keep your team organized, informed, and connected.
PLAYERS: Spend less time on scheduling, communicating, scorekeeping, and more time on analyzing team's performance and discussing tactics for next game. 
OTHER MEMBERS: Easily access up-to-date practice and game schedules. Communicate with other members. View stats of the players you follow.
HOW MUCH DOES TEAMHUB COST?
TeamHub is totally free to download from the App Store. Unlocking our best time-saving features requires one of our premium pricing levels. We also offer a limited-feature free plan.
Sign up, schedule, communicate and coordinate everything with TeamHub in a few simple clicks. You’ll save hours on team administration.
TeamHub Basic/Plus
Want even more? Subscribe to TeamHub Basic/Plus and see your entire stats and leaderboard for your team. Try it free for 30 days. After the trial period, you will automatically be charged and your subscription will continue month-to-month until you cancel, which you can do online, at any time, with no fees or hassles. Subscribe to get started!
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions can be managed in Account Settings on your device. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Get all your questions answered at support@tmhub.jp. Even questions about the app!
https://tmhub.jp/terms.html

bluejetty:00088829:ios.summary:

STORIES, ON YOUR TERMS
- Watch stories, highlights
bluejetty:00088829:ios.description:
Instory is the beautifully simple way to keep up with the accounts you love. Watch stories at your own pace, keep the moments that matter, and see exactly who followed and unfollowed you.
STORIES, ON YOUR TERMS
- Watch stories, highlights and lives whenever you like, quietly.
- Pin your favorite accounts so they always come first.
- Filter by close friends, verified or muted accounts, and choose the order.
- Lives sit at the top of the list, so you never miss one.
KEEP WHAT YOU LOVE
- Save stories, posts and reels to your Photos in full quality.
- Save a whole set of stories at once, or pick just the ones you want.
- Follow every save as it happens, and cancel or retry any time.
- Open profile pictures and highlight covers in full size.
FOLLOWER INSIGHTS
- See who started following you and who unfollowed you since your last scan.
- Find the accounts that don't follow you back, your mutuals and more.
- Every scan is kept on your device, so you can look back and compare.
POST AND COMMENT INSIGHTS
- See which posts perform best on any profile you can view.
- Discover the most active commenters and the most-liked comments.
- Export your results as a spreadsheet.
MESSAGES, AT YOUR OWN PACE
- Catch up on your chats quietly, whenever it suits you.
THOUGHTFUL EXTRAS
- Find the song playing in any video with Shazam.
- Copy or translate captions, and copy names and bios in a tap.
- Tips & Features walks you through every trick in seconds.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Insights run on your device and nothing is uploaded. Your scans stay on your phone, and you can delete them whenever you like.
INSTORY PRO
Unlock the full experience with Instory Pro:
- No ads
- Full Insights: every account in every list, complete post and comment scans, search, sort, filters and export
- Multiple accounts, one tap apart
- Instants: watch and keep the instants your friends share
- InShare: save posts and reels right from the share sheet
Instory Pro is available as a weekly, monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within the 24 hours before that period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription any time in your Apple Account settings. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe and may vary by country or region.
Please respect creators: only save and share content you have the owner's permission to use.
Instory is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Instagram or Meta.
Terms of Use: https://mhn.onl/apps/instory/tou
Privacy Policy: https://mhn.onl/pap
Manage your subscription: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039

bluejetty:00024611:ios.description:
No subscription. No monthly fees.
Buy Baby Monitor 3G once — use it whenever you need it.
Turn two iPhones/iPads into a reliable video + audio baby monitor that works over Wi-Fi or cellular. Set it up in minutes and keep an eye (and ear) on your baby from anywhere.
Why parents choose Baby Monitor 3G
 • Pay once, use forever – no recurring payments
 • Works anywhere – Wi-Fi, 3G/LTE/5G cellular, unlimited range
 • Private & secure – encrypted connection
 • Quick setup – simple pairing and easy controls
 • Reliable alerts – hear every sound, get notified when you need it
Perfect for real life
At home
Use an old iPhone/iPad as the Baby unit and keep your current phone as Parent.
On the go
Travel, visit family, or stay at a hotel — Baby Monitor 3G works over cellular when Wi-Fi is weak.
Peace of mind
Live video + audio, night mode, and smart notifications help you relax when your baby sleeps.
Key features
 • Live HD video and clear audio
 • Night mode and screen dimming
 • Push notifications and vibration alerts
 • Two-way talk (comfort your baby remotely)
 • Background audio (keep listening while using other apps)
 • Multiple Parent devices (share with a partner)
 • Adjustable sensitivity and alert settings
Privacy & security
 • Encrypted connection between your devices
 • No public streaming
 • No account required
Compatibility
Baby Monitor 3G works on iPhone and iPad.
Please note: the iOS and macOS versions are sold separately.

bluejetty:00192688:android.description:
🚆 **All Aboard Embark on an Epic Railway Adventure**
Get ready for an epic railway adventure in 'Train Traveller'! Step into the shoes of a passenger on the bustling Indian railway network, where every journey is a unique experience. Your goal? To traverse the vast and diverse landscape of India, from your current station to your dream destination.
🍔💧🚽 **Survive and Thrive: Balance Your Basic Needs**
But here's the twist: this isn't just your typical train ride. In 'Train Traveller,' you'll need to master the art of balancing your basic needs, just like a real traveler. Keep a keen eye on your hunger, thirst, and bladder levels as you embark on this thrilling journey. Make strategic choices when to buy food and when to visit the washroom, all while ensuring you don't run out of precious time or money.
🎫🛤️ **Ticket to Adventure: Navigating the Railway Network**
To make it to your desired destination, you'll have to navigate the intricate world of Indian railways. Head to the ticket counter and purchase the right tickets for your route. Be sure to board the correct train, as each one will take you on a unique adventure through India's stunning landscapes and bustling cities.
🌴🏙️🏜️ **Scenic Splendors: Explore India's Diverse Landscapes**
Whether you're passing through the lush greenery of Kerala, the vibrant streets of Delhi, or the serene beauty of Rajasthan's deserts, 'Train Traveller' offers a diverse and immersive experience like no other. Explore India's rich culture, traditions, and scenic beauty, all from the comfort of your virtual train seat.
🚀🌟 **Are You Up for the Challenge?**
Are you up for the challenge? Can you manage your needs, your budget, and your journey to become the ultimate 'Train Traveller'? Get ready to embark on this captivating adventure and prove your mettle in the world of Indian railways. Start your journey today!

bluejetty:00128352:ios.name: Myths Of Orion: Books of Power
bluejetty:00128352:ios.summary: Long time ago, in the Realm of Orion, a powerful, but greedy wizard collected knowledge from all around the world. And thus came to write the Three Books: books of Knowledge, Law and Magic. The Books eventually gave him ultimate powers. Bli
bluejetty:00128352:ios.description:
Long time ago, in the Realm of Orion, a powerful, but greedy wizard collected knowledge from all around the world. And thus came to write the Three Books: books of Knowledge, Law and Magic. The Books eventually gave him ultimate powers. Blinded by his powers, he used them not to prosper, but for chaos!
Use your sharp eye and brave heart to stop a dark wizard in Myths of Orion — a richly illustrated hidden object puzzle adventure (HOPA). 
Search detailed scenes, collect magical items, solve clever puzzles and unravel the Realm’s mysteries as Meredith, the brave enchantress’s daughter.
WHAT AWAITS YOU:
• Puzzle & mystery adventure — dozens of unique riddles and mini-games.
• Intriguing narrative — a dramatic plot with twists and memorable characters.
• Atmospheric visuals & soundtrack — moody scenes that pull you deep into the mystery.
• Full voiceovers & HD visuals — immerse yourself in the story.
• Difficulty levels — from relaxed exploration to true challenge.
PERFECT FOR PLAYERS WHO WANT:
• Fully optimized for iPad and iPad Pro — play on a big screen with stunning HD graphics and detail!
• Play completely offline — Desktop, Phone & Tablet support — anytime, anywhere
• No data collection — your privacy is safe
• Try free, unlock full game once — no ads, no micro-transactions
Gameplay
Search scenes, collect clues, combine items, and complete mini-games to progress the story. Use hints if you get stuck — but the reward is uncovering more of the mystery.
Play your way
Explore, investigate, find hidden objects and items, and solve puzzles and mini-games and reveal the mystery in your own way: adjustable challenge: Casual, Adventure, and Challenging difficulty modes. Win Achievements & Collectibles.
Atmospheric adventure
A gripping mystery adventure: narrative-driven game-play with a strong detective lead. Immersive locations waiting to be explored; seek, search and solve puzzles.
Why players love it
The combination of art and atmosphere and blend of story-driven adventure and classic puzzles and minigames. Whether you love relaxing hunts or challenge-driven puzzles, this game offers both.
Free to try
Try for free, then unlock the full game for the entire mystery — no distractions, just mystery to solve.
• TRACK down the missing Books of Power and stop the evil
• EXPLORE over 70 stunning locations
• INVESTIGATE kingdoms of Elves, Humans and Orcs
• USE the magic flowing through your veins
• SOLVE dozens of brain-teasing mini-games
• SEARCH for clues and FIND HIDDEN OBJECTS
• MEET unforgettable characters on your journey
• READ the Diary as you DISCOVER new worlds
• EARN achievements and COLLECT special items
• ENJOY beautiful HD graphics and full motion videos
• 4 DIFFICULTY MODES: custom, novice, adventure, challenge

bluejetty:00168158:ios.description:
Start out on a journey in "Merge Millionaire" game that combines thrilling merge mechanics with an enriching success story. Start from poor to go to rich and work your way up to prosperity by mastering the art of merging!
In "Merge Millionaire" game, the main goal is to combine identical items to enhance your level. Each merge brings you closer to completing core tasks that are integral to progressing in the game. Achieve the required item levels to unlock currency, propelling your rich story and unlocking new chapters in your character's life.
Game features:
As you delve deeper into the game, the narrative unfolds, reflecting your progress from a modest beginning to a life of luxury and achievements:
- Upgrade from a humble abode to luxurious residences, including penthouses and mansions;
- Unlock stylish, high-end clothing as you advance from basic outfits;
- Purchase sleek cars to reflect your rising status;
- Meet and mingle with people, each interaction paving the way to relationships.
"Merge Millionaire" isn’t just about solving merge puzzles, it’s about living a life you build through each merge. Every level up brings you closer to luxury, relationships, and personal growth. Experience the thrill of transformation, both in-game and in the life of your character.
Perfect for players who love a blend of casual gaming with a story-driven approach, "Merge Millionaire" offers endless hours of entertainment. Join now and start your journey from the ground up, experiencing the highs and lows of your character’s life story while enjoying the addictive mechanics of merging.
Ready to shape your merge billionaire story? Get a "Merge Millionaire" game and start your ascent to the top today!

 Easily share access to your storage unit with family, friends, or movers without giving out your access code or keys (participating facilities)
 Easy access to help
 Leave feedback via the app – we love hearing from our customers!

bluejetty:00096068:ios.description:
Simplify your mobile printing and scanning experience with this versatile application designed to handle all your documents and photos effortlessly. Whether you need to print a quick note, scan a receipt, or manage work files on the go, this tool offers a smooth and reliable workflow from your iPhone or iPad. With support for thousands of wireless printer models, printing and scanning has never been more convenient.
Send files to your printer directly from your device or cloud storage with just a few taps. Customize each print job by selecting paper size, orientation, margins, and color mode. Save resources by printing multiple pages on a single sheet or creating multiple copies in one session. Turn your device into a portable scanner to digitize contracts, receipts, notes, or any physical document. Enhance scans with editing tools before saving them as high-quality PDFs or sharing instantly.
Keep your files organized and accessible with integration for popular cloud services, while local storage ensures your data remains private and secure. Advanced features like text recognition (OCR) allow you to extract and edit text from images in several languages, streamlining your document workflow.

-Access enhanced tools to fully optimize your printing and scanning capabilities;
-Convert documents and images into various formats for easy sharing;
-Compress files while maintaining high quality;
-Extract and edit text from photos and scanned documents;
-Advanced print controls including paper type, color settings, borders, and double-sided printing;
-Priority updates and support for ongoing improvements.

bluejetty:00114267:ios.description:
Step into a world of calm darkness and moonlit beauty with Dark Night Color — a gothic paint by number coloring book filled with mysterious night scenes, elegant shadows, Halloween-inspired artwork, and spooky seasonal charm.
This isn't just a coloring app — it's your quiet escape into midnight skies, haunted elegance, pumpkin-lit porches, and peaceful dark fantasy moments.
Tap your way through moonlit castles, silent forests, foggy streets, glowing candles, ravens on rooftops, jack-o'-lanterns, trick-or-treat night scenes, and gothic portraits wrapped in soft shadows. Every page is designed to help you slow down, breathe deeply, and relax — even when the world feels too loud.
Whether you love shadowy witches, vintage gothic girls, skull symbols, vampire romance, spooky Halloween nights, or misty moonlit landscapes, Dark Night Color turns every image into a calming, immersive paint by number experience.
Why choose Dark Night Color?
- Hundreds of gothic paint by number pages
- Moon scenes, haunted mansions, dark flowers, ravens, candles & pumpkins
- Calm, relaxing coloring for unwinding at night
- Atmospheric night palettes — black, purple, deep blue, crimson glow, silver moonlight
- Simple paint by number gameplay — just tap to color
- Daily new pictures to keep the night fresh
- Beautiful themed packs: Midnight Castle, Raven Moon, Gothic Rose, Witch Hour, Vampire Night, Haunted Manor, Silent Graveyard, Halloween Night, Pumpkin Moon, Spooky October
Every artwork is crafted to feel mysterious yet comforting — perfect for unwinding on autumn nights and throughout spooky season.
What's inside?
- Gothic characters: witches, vampires, dark princesses, masked figures
- Halloween favorites: pumpkins, jack-o'-lanterns, ghosts, bats, trick-or-treat streets, haunted houses
- Night scenery: full moons, fog, forests, ruins, cathedrals, graveyards
- Symbols & aesthetics: skulls, roses, crosses, candles, crystals, tarot vibes
- Dark fantasy compositions with soft glow and shadow contrast
- A mix of simple and detailed pages for every mood
- Smooth gradients and dramatic lighting to enhance the atmosphere
Dark Night Color focuses on mood, atmosphere, and gothic elegance — blending dark themes, Halloween aesthetics, and relaxing color-by-number flow so the experience feels soothing, not stressful.
Perfect for fans of:
- Gothic & dark fantasy coloring
- Halloween, spooky season & October night art
- Night sky, moonlight, and haunted aesthetics
- Creepy-cute art, skull & rose symbols
- Relaxing paint by number games
- Bedtime calm and quiet creative moments
Whether you're coloring a raven under a full moon, a glowing pumpkin porch, or a quiet candlelit room in an old mansion, Dark Night Color transforms each moment into a peaceful, shadowy escape.
Color the dark. Calm your mind. Enter the night.
Download Dark Night Color today and bring gothic beauty to life, one tap at a time.

bluejetty:00100111:ios.description:
Tummi is the #1 app for learning your baby’s first foods — powered by trusted information and AI.
Tummi is an educational app that helps parents learn about baby feeding, track new foods, and explore expert-backed guidance. Whether you’re following baby-led weaning (BLW) or starting with purées, Tummi makes it simple to know what foods to offer and how to prepare them confidently.
// BUILT FOR MODERN PARENTS
Tummi combines expert-sourced feeding information, playful design, and personalized AI support to make your baby’s first bites feel easy — not overwhelming.
// EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO START SOLIDS
• Explore 400+ foods with prep instructions, allergen info, and photos for every stage.
• Learn about introducing textures and flavors, backed by pediatric feeding research.
• Follow curated Lists like 'Iron-Rich Foods' or 'Gentle on Tummies' to plan meals with confidence.
• Log foods, reactions, and milestones — and watch your baby’s Food Passport grow.
// FEEDING SUPPORT
Ask anything, anytime.
Tummi’s AI chat helps you learn about feeding topics — from “Can I serve eggs yet?” to “What texture should broccoli be at 7 months?”
No more endless Googling or second-guessing — just clear, educational information at your fingertips.
// DESIGNED TO GROW WITH YOUR BABY
Tummi adapts as your baby learns to eat. From first tastes to family meals, you’ll get personalized suggestions and confidence-boosting reminders every step of the way.
// WHY PARENTS LOVE TUMMI
1. “Tummi's AI chat makes me feel like I have a feeding coach in my pocket.”
2. “Finally, a baby app that’s beautiful AND actually helpful.”
3. “Tummi made starting solids and BLW so much less overwhelming.”
// SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Tummi is free to download and includes a free trial to our premium membership, Tummi Full. After your trial ends, continued access to Tummi Full requires a paid subscription. Some basic features remain available for free with limited functionality. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store settings.
---
Disclaimer: Tummi provides educational information only and does not offer medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your pediatrician for questions about your child’s health or feeding.
Terms: https://tummiapp.com/terms

bluejetty:00132294:ios.description:
Dwell is the leading magazine for modern architecture and home design. We feature forward-looking homes by telling the stories of the people who live in them.
We champion design that improves people’s lives, promote new ideas about what a home can and should be, offer expert advice for making your space a better place to live, and highlight the best-designed products available.
The Dwell app is free to download and allows you to buy digital issues of Dwell Magazine. You can purchase single issues for USD 9.99 or subscribe for 1 year to get 6 digital issues for USD 19.99.
NOTE: Customers who subscribe to Dwell+ or Dwell All Access on dwell.com receive complimentary access to the Dwell app, in addition to all subscriber-only content on our website.
If you choose to subscribe in the Dwell app, please note the following:
• App subscriptions do not include access to subscriber-only content on our website.
• Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
• You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, for the same duration, and at the current subscription rate for that product.
• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
• Your subscription will begin with the current issue, even if that issue has been purchased separately.
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://www.ziffdavis.com/privacy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.ziffdavis.com/legal

bluejetty:00081190:ios.description:
Know what your bourbon is worth. Track your collection. Trade with confidence.
Bourboneur puts bottle values, collection tracking, and trade comparisons in one app—so you can make more informed decisions before you buy, sell, or trade.
KNOW THE VALUE BEFORE YOU BUY
Search thousands of bottles in the Bourbon Blue Book®, with market values informed by real secondary-market transactions and updated daily. Explore price ranges and recent trends to put an asking price in perspective.
YOUR COLLECTION. ALL ACCOUNTED FOR.
Keep your bottles organized in one place. Track quantities, purchase prices, and fill levels. See your collection’s estimated market value, monitor changes over time, and keep track of what’s opened and unopened.
SEE HOW YOUR COLLECTION STACKS UP
Compare your collection’s performance with the Bourboneur Secondary Market Index and the S&P 500. Get a clearer view of how your bottles are moving alongside the broader bourbon market.
MAKE A SMARTER TRADE
Use the Trade Analyzer to compare the estimated market values of what you’re giving and what you’re getting. Understand both sides before you make the deal.
ENJOY WHAT YOU OWN
Save bottles to your wishlist, record tasting notes in your Tasting Journal, and let the Wheel of Destiny help choose your next pour.
From your next bottle to your entire collection, make smarter bourbon decisions with Bourboneur.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Bourboneur offers auto-renewing subscriptions to unlock premium features:
• Monthly Subscription: $3/month
• Yearly Subscription: $25/year
Terms & Conditions:
https://www.bourboneur.com/terms-disclosures-privacy-policy/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy:
https://www.bourboneur.com/terms-disclosures-privacy-policy/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00121292:ios.description:
DISCOVER THE BEST EXPERIENCES IN YOUR CITY
With Fever, the wealth of events happening in your city is at your fingertips. Discover what to do, where to go, and what to visit. Find local events, secret places, and trendy pop-ups, some of which are available exclusively on Fever. 
DISCOVER EXCLUSIVE EVENTS THAT YOU CAN ONLY FIND ON FEVER:
Jurassic World: The Exhibition
Stranger Things: The Experience
The Queen's Ball: A Bridgerton Experience
Van Gogh: The Immersive Experience
And many more!
UNIQUE FEVER FEATURES:
- Exclusive events: Access to exclusive events that you can only find on the Fever platform.
- Fever Club: A reward system on all ticket purchases thanks to your Fever wallet.
- Fever filters: Handy filters that allow you to search by date & time.
- Favorite events: A list of your favorite experiences for easy access to the events that you like the most.
- Ticket transfers: An easy ticket transfer system that allows you to send friends and family tickets with no fuss.
- Map of event locations: An up-to-date map that shows you the events near you and in your city.
- User-based recommendations: Personalized recommendations for events and experiences based on your likes.
- Fully mobile, paper-free tickets: No printer required as tickets are scanned from your mobile device.
- Customer Support: 24/7 chat service with our Customer Support team, available in 8 languages.
ALL TYPES OF EVENTS AND EXPERIENCES
- Tours, trips, adventure: Discover new places and experiences in your city that you've never even heard of! 
- Arts & museums: Visit your city’s cultural havens for a tranquil day out.
- Concerts & festivals: Watch your favorite musicians and artists as they perform at some of the most exclusive venues in your city.
- Theater, comedy, shows, & AMC cinemas: Laugh, cry, sing and shout at the best shows and latest movie screenings.
- Food experiences: Taste the world at a wide variety of gastronomic experiences.
- Drinks & after-work activities, nightlife, parties: Dance the night away at some of the city’s hottest nighttime spots.
- And much more!
AVAILABLE CITIES IN THE US: New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Miami, Boston, Chicago, San Diego, Washington DC, Atlanta, Philadelphia, Seattle and many more!
To check out the Fever platform and for any other information, you can take a look at our website https://feverup.com/en or contact our 24/7 support service via chat, phone and email at hi@feverup.com.

bluejetty:00135536:ios.description:
This is a secure application that scans local network cameras, connects to them, and plays live camera feeds in real-time.
Are you concerned about personal privacy and want to ensure the security of your personal space? Introducing our advanced Hidden Camera Detection application, a reliable solution designed to protect your privacy and detect concealed cameras. With advanced technology and user-friendly features, this application empowers you to monitor your surroundings and safeguard sensitive information.
Explore the outstanding features of our Hidden Camera Detection application:
◆ Comprehensive Network Scanning ◆
Detect hidden cameras, covert devices, GPS trackers, and unauthorized devices connected to WiFi, networks, and Bluetooth. Our application provides a comprehensive scanning solution, ensuring no potential threats are overlooked.
◆ Detailed Device Analysis ◆
Gain detailed analysis of detected devices, including model information and manufacturer details.
◆ Live Camera Feeds ◆
Embark on a virtual journey through our live camera feature. Browse real-time feeds from public cameras worldwide, allowing you to uniquely observe iconic landmarks, bustling streets, and breathtaking scenery.
◆ Secure Camera Connections ◆
Supports connections to RTSP protocol cameras, with options for automatic scanning or manual addition of multiple cameras for customizable home monitoring.
◆ High-Quality Real-Time Videos ◆
Watch clear live video feeds in full-screen mode to fully inspect your surroundings.
◆ User Guide ◆
Detailed connection and privacy protection guides are provided to ensure you use the application correctly.
* Our Commitment:
- Our application is dedicated to ensuring privacy and security. If unable to connect to your camera, it may not support the RTSP protocol. Through regular application updates and database expansions, we aim to support cameras using more protocols.
- Feel confident in experiencing these features. If at any time you feel the application doesn't meet your needs, you can request a refund under specified conditions.
About Subscription:
-Unlock all features with a subscription;
-Subscription fees will be charged from your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase;
-You can turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period; otherwise, it will renew automatically;
-The Apple ID for an auto-renewal subscription will be charged automatically 24 hours before the end of each billing cycle from the iTunes account and extend the -validity accordingly;
-You can manage your subscription service, i.e., after purchasing, you can go to your account settings to turn off auto-renewal.

Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. This App reads / writes data from Apple’s Health App with your permission. Earn Vitality points for your workouts from the Health App.

bluejetty:00156649:ios.name: InComm Benefits
bluejetty:00156649:ios.summary:
Automated and AI-powered spending accounts - including HSA, FSA, HRA and Commuter. 
Simplified user experience with a mobile app that handles all the details for you. Manage multiple accounts together on one card and easily track expenses
bluejetty:00156649:ios.description:
Automated and AI-powered spending accounts - including HSA, FSA, HRA and Commuter. 
Simplified user experience with a mobile app that handles all the details for you. Manage multiple accounts together on one card and easily track expenses and store receipts.
New technology allows the debit card to find which products are eligible and which are not - right when you swipe the card. From there it easily pulls eligible costs from the HSA and ineligible costs from a backup account like your checking account. You don't even have to know what was eligible beforehand - no more missed expenses! 
Plus, with Incomm’s AI-driven platform, you can uncover HSA eligible expenses you would have missed! 
Don’t have the funds up front? No problem. Spend first and contribute to your account later. 
The InComm Benefits mobile app features include: 
- Secure access to all your benefit spending account balances and transaction history.
- Receive notifications and view details of all your debit card transactions. 
- Safely link your external bank account for simplified expense reimbursements. 
- Create and manage your claims for out-of-pocket expenses, including uploading supporting documents using your device’s camera or gallery. 
- Manage your debit card, including requesting additional cards for family members. 
- Open and manage an HSA investment account.
- Access to fast and friendly customer support. 
InComm Benefits supports benefit spending accounts through employer sponsored benefits programs. 
InComm Benefits is a financial technology company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services are provided by Coastal Community Bank, Member FDIC. The InComm Visa ® Debit Card is issued by Coastal Community Bank pursuant to a license from Visa U.S.A. Inc. InComm spending accounts are FDIC insured up to $250,000 per depositor through Coastal Community Bank, Member FDIC. FDIC insurance only covers the failure of an FDIC-insured bank. FDIC insurance is available through pass-through insurance at Coastal Community Bank, Member FDIC, if certain conditions have been met. 
Investment products are provided by Devenir Group LLC. Investment products are not insured by Coastal Community Bank, the FDIC, or any Federal Government Agency, are not a deposit, and may lose value.

bluejetty:00185344:ios.description:
Build an epic roster of DC super heroes and villains and get ready for battle! INJUSTICE: GODS AMONG US is a free-to-play collectible card game where you build a roster of characters, moves, powers, and gear and enter the arena in touch-based 3-on-3 action combat.
THE FANS HAVE SPOKEN:
5/5: “This game is awesome you will not be disappointed.”
5/5: “This game is amazing it's got everything. It makes you think. It's got action mixed with a nice collectable card game. It's a game I just can't put down.”
5/5: “This game keeps getting better! - Every character, every new card, the gears, the new booster packs and online battles! Everything is so fresh, so cool!”
5/5: “Love the game, can’t believe I waited this long to download it”
5/5: “Best game ever.... Even better then Clash of Clans”
FIGHT
Use the touch screen mechanics of your mobile device to battle your enemies in 3-on-3 action combat. Swipe and tap to perform combos and build your power to pull off special attacks and super moves taken straight from the console version of the game.
LEVEL UP
Build your move set, increase your powers, upgrade your characters and gear, and beat your competition. Constantly evolve your card collection to fit your style of play and put your best team forward as you take on a series of DC super hero and villian combatants.
ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Take on real opponents in Online Multiplayer Battles. Compete against players worldwide on the leaderboards, and in tournaments filled with awesome rewards. Lead your team to victory!
MASSIVE ROSTER
Collect and play as your favorite DC Comics icons: Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman, The Joker, Green Arrow, Flash, Bane, Green Lantern, Doomsday, and many others. With each alternate version of these iconic characters you get a new set of powers and moves, and a whole new fight!
AMAZING GRAPHICS
Delivers best-in-class graphics on your phone or tablet, with custom animations for every single super hero and villain. Take the battle to Arkham Asylum, the Batcave, The Watchtower, and other iconic locales from DC Comics, fully rendered in 3D.
Please Note: INJUSTICE: GODS AMONG US is free to play, but it contains items that can be purchased for real money.

bluejetty:00129445:ios.name: Focus Dog: Study Pet Pomodoro
bluejetty:00129445:ios.summary:
Your phone was built to eat your focus. Focus Dog feeds it back.
Feed your focus. Starve distractions. Start a focus session and your donut machine starts producing donuts. Stay in the app, the machine keeps running. Open Instagram "for a
bluejetty:00129445:ios.description:
Your phone was built to eat your focus. Focus Dog feeds it back.
Feed your focus. Starve distractions. Start a focus session and your donut machine starts producing donuts. Stay in the app, the machine keeps running. Open Instagram "for a second"? The machine stops. Your dog — his name is Focus — is hungry and counting on you. That's the whole loop. It works because it's stupid simple and because you care about the dog.
If you open your phone to check one thing and look up 40 minutes later, you're not broken. Your apps were designed to do that to you. Focus Dog gives you a reason to put the phone down: a cute dog who eats what you earn, levels up when you show up, and gets sad when you ghost him.
STAY FOCUSED
• Pomodoro-style focus sessions that produce rewards as you work
• Hourly challenges for a dopamine hit when you hit your time goals
• Your session timer stays visible on the Lock Screen — iOS Live Activities, Android live notifications
• Siri Shortcuts to start sessions hands-free (5 to 120 minutes)
• Open-ended mode when you just want to lock in and go
GET MOTIVATED
• Collect over 120 donut recipes across normal, rare, and epic tiers
• Level up donuts, unlock new dog skins, machines, and backgrounds
• Seasonal events with exclusive donuts (Halloween, Christmas, New Year, Valentine's, Easter)
• Climb weekly leagues against people at your level, from Bronze to Legend
• Compete with friends and climb the global Top 100 leaderboard
• Gift your gems — we turn them into real meals for real shelter dogs
TRACK YOUR FOCUS
• Tag sessions (Work, Study, Deep Work — whatever fits your life) and see the breakdown
• Calendar heatmap, weekly/monthly/yearly stats, streak tracking
• Per-tag time distribution so you know where your focus actually goes
• CSV export of your focus time for your own analysis (Pro)
BUILT FOR
• Students fighting homework procrastination
• ADHD brains that need external scaffolding, not willpower
• Remote workers drowning in tab-switching
• Anyone who's tired of their weekly screen time report
FOCUS DOG PRO
Install Focus Dog for free and use its core features as long as you want. Subscribe any time to Focus Dog Pro via in-app purchase — available as a monthly subscription or a one-time purchase. Payment will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. Focus Dog will automatically charge your App Store account at the end of each subscription period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can turn off auto-renew at any time in your App Store Account Settings after purchase and still receive full functionality until the end of your current period, but we can't refund unused portions of the subscription. In-app purchases and subscriptions cannot be shared via Family Sharing.
Terms of use: https://focusdog.app/terms/
Privacy policy: https://focusdog.app/privacy/
CONNECT WITH US
• Twitter: https://twitter.com/FocusDogApp
• Support: https://focusdog.app/help/

bluejetty:00160323:ios.description:
Discover the New American Standard Bible (NASB), one of the most accurate and trusted English Bible translations available today.
Looking for a Bible known for exceptional word-for-word accuracy? The NASB Bible is highly respected by pastors, scholars, students, and believers who value faithful Scripture for study, teaching, worship, and daily devotion.
Recognized for its close adherence to the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek texts, the New American Standard Bible provides precise translation while remaining clear and readable. It is widely trusted for in-depth Bible study and personal spiritual growth.
With the NASB Bible, study God's Word with accuracy, confidence, and a deeper understanding of Scripture.
Features:
- Daily Verse : Set reminders to receive daily notifications to read Bible verses.
- MY LIBRARY : Your personal space containing highlights, notes, and bookmarked favorite verses.
- Old & New Testaments : The app includes both the Old and New Testaments.
- Verse Editor : Pair Bible verses with beautiful backgrounds, create posts, and share on social media.
- Nearby Churches : Get information about nearby churches based on your location.
- Books : Access a wide collection of Christian eBooks.
- Wallpapers : Explore a variety of beautiful wallpapers.
- Videos : Watch videos on topics like Jesus, Hope, Wisdom, Motivation, Gratitude, Healing, and more.
- Festive Calendar : View all Christian festivals and feast days.
- Popular Verse : Bible verses organized by topics like love, fear, peace, and more, including church etiquette and respectful conduct guidance.
- Customise Your Bible : Change font style and text color for a comfortable reading experience.
- 1000 Praises : A devotional recitation honoring God through a thousand titles and attributes.
- Bible Quotes : Shareable Bible quotes available in image and text formats.
- Bible Quiz : Test your Bible knowledge through quizzes.
- Bible Stories : Read timeless stories filled with wisdom and inspiration for all ages.
- Bible FAQ : Quick answers to common questions about the Bible and Christian living.
- Verses Comment : Share reflections and engage in discussions with the community.
- Help Desk : Raise support issues with photo attachments for faster assistance.
- Dictionary : Bible-based dictionary with cleaner layout and faster search for Biblical terms.
- Dreams Meanings : Understand dreams through Christian teachings and Biblical perspectives.
- Word Highlights : Highlight specific words or letters for deeper study and meditation.
- App Activity : Track streaks, reading time, refresh count, and overall usage.
- Products : Browse Bible-related products directly inside the app.
- VerseBot : AI-powered verse explanation bot for meanings, copying, and sharing.
- Common Notification History : View all past notifications in one place.
- Did You Know? : Daily bite-sized facts about the Bible and Christian faith.
- Bible Verse Clips : Continuous feed of short Bible-based inspirational clips shared by the community.
- Prayer Request : Submit prayer requests and receive community support through prayers and interactions.
- Nearby Events : Discover Christian gatherings, services, and celebrations near you.
- Chapter-Wise Video Learning : Watch scripture videos linked to each Bible chapter for deeper learning.
- Interactive Bible Games : Play scripture-based games like SlideScript and VerseHunt.
- Bible Clips : Watch short, inspiring biblical clips from the faith community.
- Bible Streaks : Keep your daily Bible reading streak going strong every day.
- Background Music : Enjoy peaceful background music while reading the Bible.
- Alarm : Set reminders and get alerts for activities scheduled within the app.
- Mark as Read Quiz : Explore quizzes designed around the verses you have finished reading.
- Audio Bible Speed Control : Adjust the audio pace to listen at your preferred speed.

bluejetty:00089615:ios.summary: Welcome to the LendingPoint app, a comprehensive mobile application created to empower individuals in effectively managing their finances. By utilizing the app's capabilities, users can pave the way toward financial well-being and confident
bluejetty:00089615:ios.description:
Welcome to the LendingPoint app, a comprehensive mobile application created to empower individuals in effectively managing their finances. By utilizing the app's capabilities, users can pave the way toward financial well-being and confidently achieve their long-term financial goals. Whether you're interested in checking rates for a personal loan or already have a loan with LendingPoint, the app covers you. Experience a hassle-free way to manage your account, make payments, and update your personal information all in one place. The LendingPoint app is designed to be your comprehensive solution for all your financial needs.
Applications submitted on this website may be funded by one of several lenders, including: FinWise Bank, a Utah-chartered bank, Member FDIC; Coastal Community Bank, Member FDIC; and LendingPoint, a licensed lender in certain states. Loan approval is not guaranteed. Actual loan offers and loan amounts, terms, and annual percentage rates ("APR") may vary based upon LendingPoint's proprietary scoring and underwriting system's review of your credit, financial condition, other factors, and supporting documents or information you provide. Origination or other fees up to 10% may apply depending upon your state of residence. Upon final underwriting approval to fund a loan, said funds are often sent via ACH the next non-holiday business day. Loans are offered from $1,000 to $50,000, at rates ranging from 7.99% to 35.99% APR, with terms from 24 to 72 months. Minimum loan amounts apply in Georgia, $3,500; Colorado, $3,001; and Hawaii, $2,000. For a well-qualified customer, a requested loan of $10,000 by LendingPoint over a period of 48 months that has an APR of 24.99% with an origination fee of 10% may have a payment of $331.52 per month. (Actual terms and rate depend on credit history, income, and other factors.) Customers may have the option to deduct the origination fee from the disbursed loan amount if desired. If the origination fee is added to the financed amount, interest is charged on the full principal amount. The total amount due is the total amount of the loan you will have paid after you have made all payments as scheduled.

신규가입 회원 누구나 총 20,000원의 쿠폰 할인팩을 받아볼 수 있어요.

bluejetty:00127140:ios.summary:

Performance Graphs:
Spike Stats allows players to see their own profile, match histo
bluejetty:00127140:ios.description:
Spike Stats for Valorant is a free app that specializes on analyzing players’ performance statistics and displaying them in an easy to understand fashion.
Performance Graphs:
Spike Stats allows players to see their own profile, match history and statistics. It utilizes and interprets the data in the official Valorant API to create insightful new information such as performance averages and trends. This data is then displayed to players in the form of beautiful graphs that are simple to digest.
Detailed Match Results:
Spike Stats provides detailed information for each individual match players has completed. This includes map info, names & number of medals accumulated during the match, KDA info as well as its breakdowns (such as kills per weapon type), KAST, round details, shot percentages and many other data points.
Valorant Coach:
Review your matches with your personal Valorant Coach. Analyze your stats, get personalized tips and elevate your skills effortlessly.
Overview:
Spike Stats creates a summary of players’ progress from their recent matches. This summary includes an overall win rate per game mode, win rate per map, win rate when the user starts the match as an attacker or defender, average performance metrics such as KDA, KAST and shot percentages.
Agent Stats:
Spike Stats tracks players’ performance for every agent and creates a list. It includes data such as win rate, KDA info for each agent the player selects. This list can also be sorted by the mentioned metrics and be filtered by agent roles.
Weapon Stats:
Spike Stats records players’ accuracy and effectiveness for every weapon and prepares a list. This list includes kills, kills per round, damage per round, shot percentages and other info for each weapon the player uses. It can also be sorted by the mentioned stats and filtered by weapon type.
Player Search:
Spike Stats lets you search for other Valorant players and see their stats effortlessly. All you need is the game name and tag line of the player and you are good to go.
Leaderboards:
Spike Stats lists the leaderboards for current and previous acts of all regions.
Minimalistic UI:
Spike Stats is inspired by the minimalistic UI of Valorant and takes design cues from it to recreate the look and feel of the game while adding some characteristic elements of its own.

Download "Knowledge is Power: Quiz" and you won't regret it!

Boundless Knowledge: Global Quiz

Transfer Money and Pay Bills
Move money when and where you need it.

• Transfer funds between your United Community accounts
• Transfer money to accounts at other financial institutions
• Schedule and manage one-time or recurring transfers

See Your Complete Financial Picture
Take control of your financial wellness by viewing all your accounts in one place.
• Link external accounts from other financial institutions
• Monitor balances across multiple accounts
• Track spending patterns
• Access budgeting and financial management tools
• Gain insights into your overall financial health
Whether you're planning for today or preparing for tomorrow, you can make informed financial decisions with greater confidence.
Securely Connect Your Financial Apps
Through Plaid, you can securely connect your United Community accounts to more than 18,000 financial institutions and 4,500 financial applications.
Our Account Connections feature allows you to:
• View connected financial apps and institutions
• Manage account permissions
• Monitor data-sharing access
• Remove connections whenever you choose
You stay in control of your account information.
Built-In Security and Debit Card Controls
Your security is important to us.
Use the app to:
• Temporarily freeze and unfreeze your debit card
• Manage debit card controls
• Receive real-time account and security alerts
• Monitor account activity
• Respond quickly to potential fraud concerns
Our security features help you bank with confidence wherever you are.
Powerful Business Banking Tools
Business customers can securely manage accounts and keep operations moving from anywhere.
Business banking features include:
• Account management and transaction monitoring
• ACH payments
• Wire transfers
• Real-time account and security alerts
• Positive Pay fraud prevention tools
• Mobile access to business banking services
Stay connected to your business finances wherever work takes you.
Getting Paid with Autobooks Invoices 
Autobooks helps small businesses streamline invoicing and payments.
• Create and send invoices
• Accept online payments
• Track customer payments
• Improve cash flow management
Additional Features
• Find nearby branches and ATMs
• View balances on Apple Watch
• Easily switch your direct deposit
• Access secure digital banking 24/7
Download the United Community mobile banking app today to experience secure and convenient banking designed around you.
Member FDIC
*Mobile Deposit is available to Mobile Banking customers with an active checking, savings or money market account in good standing. United Community reserves the right to restrict mobile deposit access for new online banking customers.

bluejetty:00095528:ios.description:
Start your aquarium journey with ease. Whether you're a complete beginner or rediscovering the joy of fishkeeping, OkayFish helps you create a thriving aquatic world—stress-free and beautiful.
Key Features:
- Fish & Plant Identification
 Snap a photo to instantly recognize fish and aquatic plants. Learn their traits, compatibility, and care tips to build a harmonious ecosystem.
- Step-by-Step Care Guides
 Not sure where to begin? OkayFish offers beginner-friendly guidance for both freshwater and saltwater aquariums. From choosing your first fish to setting up filters and lighting, we've got you covered.
- Fish Health Checker
 Worried your fish looks unwell? Use our AI-powered disease scanner to detect symptoms and get actionable suggestions—before it’s too late.
- Tank Compatibility Analysis
 Add a tank and see how well your fish and plants match. Prevent conflicts, overcrowding, or poor water quality with smarter planning.
- Aquascaping Ideas
 Explore layout inspirations and design tips to turn your tank into a living piece of art. From natural minimalism to lush jungle styles, discover what fits your vibe.
- Smart Reminders
 Never forget key routines again. Get custom reminders for feeding, water changes, tests, and new fish introductions—keeping your tank healthy and balanced.
Why OkayFish?
Fishkeeping should be rewarding, not frustrating. OkayFish removes the guesswork and brings peace of mind to your aquarium hobby. Watch your fish flourish, your tank come to life, and your daily stress gently fade away.
Build a tank that inspires calm, curiosity, and joy—start with OkayFish today.

This proven 14 week plan will allow users to slowly build strength and stamina by alternating between walking and running. The blend of walking and running together reduces the overall impact and risk of injury, keeps your body guessing, and prepares you to go the distance. By the end of the program, you will be stronger and healthier than you have ever been. You'll be a 10K runner!
Turn on our award winning music and just press start! Our audio coach will guide you through your run! It's that easy!

bluejetty:00062156:ios.summary: Start your child's artistic journey with Todli — the ultimate safe, ad-free, offline coloring app for toddlers aged 2 to 5! Perfect for preschoolers and kindergarteners, this easy-to-follow, step-by-step drawing app combines colorful animat
bluejetty:00062156:ios.description:
Start your child's artistic journey with Todli — the ultimate safe, ad-free, offline coloring app for toddlers aged 2 to 5! Perfect for preschoolers and kindergarteners, this easy-to-follow, step-by-step drawing app combines colorful animations with fun learning activities to create a magical educational experience. Designed for both girls and boys, it helps little artists develop creativity and explore essential early-learning skills through play.
Draw, Create & Watch Your Art Come to Life!
Every picture comes to life with vibrant animations, transforming each drawing into an interactive character your child can play with. Save their masterpieces to a personal Stickerbook to use in future artwork! It's the perfect mix of creativity, education, and entertainment — a true interactive coloring book for kids that makes learning fun.
Easy Step-by-Step Drawing Lessons
Learn to draw step by step with voice guidance designed for tiny hands. Simple instructions make every drawing a success while building fine motor skills and confidence with each lesson. These fun educational drawing games keep toddlers engaged as they discover how to draw simple pictures — from animals to vehicles.
A World of Fun & Learning
Explore themed drawing and coloring packs featuring cute animals and food, dinosaur coloring for kids, princess coloring book scenes, ocean animals, vehicles, toys, sweets, nature, and seasonal favorites like Halloween & Christmas. Plus, color by numbers for learning while creating art!
Interactive Storybooks & Challenges
Color enchanting tales, complete fun challenges, and help rescue beloved characters! These interactive stories combine tracing ABC and 123 with creative coloring to keep little ones entertained while learning.
Learn Letters, Numbers & More
This educational coloring book for kids combines art and learning! With letter and number tracing packs, logic games, puzzles, and memory activities, toddlers build essential early learning skills. Create and color art while learning numbers, letters, and shapes through engaging activities designed for preschoolers.
Your little one will develop fine motor skills, hand-eye coordination, color recognition, problem-solving abilities, creative expression, and focus.
Free Drawing Mode
In Free Drawing mode, little artists can draw anything they imagine — no guides, no limits! Each masterpiece can be saved to their sticker book, reused in new drawings, or shared with family.
Why Parents Love Todli:
• 100% safe and ad-free – no pop-ups or distractions
• Works offline – perfect for travel or airplanes
• Encourages creativity, focus, and imagination
• Boosts early learning and fine motor skills
• Suitable for boys and girls aged 2–5
Download Todli today and give your child a magical world of creativity and learning!
Please note: only part of the content in the screenshots is available in the free version of the app. To gain access to all app content, you need to make an in-app purchase.

listings.name: Todli: Drawing Games for Kids
listings.description:
Start your child's artistic journey with Todli — the ultimate safe, ad-free, offline coloring app for toddlers aged 2 to 5! Perfect for preschoolers and kindergarteners, this easy-to-follow, step-by-step drawing app combines colorful animations with fun learning activities to create a magical educational experience. Designed for both girls and boys, it helps little artists develop creativity and explore essential early-learning skills through play.

Draw, Create & Watch Your Art Come to Life!
Every picture comes to life with vibrant animations, transforming each drawing into an interactive character your child can play with. Save their masterpieces to a personal Stickerbook to use in future artwork! It's the perfect mix of creativity, education, and entertainment — a true interactive coloring book for kids that makes learning fun.

Easy Step-by-Step Drawing Lessons
Learn to draw step by step with voice guidance designed for tiny hands. Simple instructions make every drawing a success while building fine motor skills and confidence with each lesson. These fun educational drawing games keep toddlers engaged as they discover how to draw simple pictures — from animals to vehicles.

A World of Fun & Learning
Explore themed drawing and coloring packs featuring cute animals and food, dinosaur coloring for kids, princess coloring book scenes, ocean animals, vehicles, toys, sweets, nature, and seasonal favorites like Halloween & Christmas. Plus, color by numbers for learning while creating art!

Interactive Storybooks & Challenges
Color enchanting tales, complete fun challenges, and help rescue beloved characters! These interactive stories combine tracing ABC and 123 with creative coloring to keep little ones entertained while learning.

Learn Letters, Numbers & More
This educational coloring book for kids combines art and learning! With letter and number tracing packs, logic games, puzzles, and memory activities, toddlers build essential early learning skills. Create and color art while learning numbers, letters, and shapes through engaging activities designed for preschoolers.
Your little one will develop fine motor skills, hand-eye coordination, color recognition, problem-solving abilities, creative expression, and focus.

Free Drawing Mode
In Free Drawing mode, little artists can draw anything they imagine — no guides, no limits! Each masterpiece can be saved to their sticker book, reused in new drawings, or shared with family.

Why Parents Love Todli:
•        100% safe and ad-free – no pop-ups or distractions
•        Works offline – perfect for travel or airplanes
•        Encourages creativity, focus, and imagination
•        Boosts early learning and fine motor skills
•        Suitable for boys and girls aged 2–5
Download Todli today and give your child a magical world of creativity and learning!

bluejetty:00133468:ios.description:
Introducing Stone Age Survival, an addictive clicker and strategy game that will immerse you in the challenges of survival and progress! Prepare yourself for a relentless journey where every decision counts.
In this stone age survival simulator, you must build your strategy to thrive. There's no time to rest as you embark on a quest to master essential skills like mining, crafting, food extraction, and building. Each action plays a crucial role in your survival.
The game kicks off with a choice that sets your strategic path. Will you focus on crafting tools, mining for resources, building a shelter, or teaming up with fellow survivors? The choice is yours, and your decisions will shape the destiny of your tribe.
Key Features of this Survival Strategy Game:
Build Your Survival Strategy: Formulate a plan to conquer the stone age challenges. Explore new territories, unlock hidden areas, gather resources, and construct vital structures for your tribe's survival.
Upgrade Mining, Crafting, and Building Skills: Adapt and evolve as the stone age progresses. This clicker game offers the opportunity to learn new tools, create more complex resources, and build advanced objects. Unleash your creativity and make strategic choices to ensure the tribe's progress.
Expand Your Base: The stone age is full of surprises and dangers. Expand your base by venturing into unexplored areas, uncovering valuable resources, and fortifying your defenses. Strengthen your tribe's resilience and ensure their survival in this hostile world.
Exciting Clicker Gameplay: Engage in addictive clicker mechanics that keep you engaged and motivated. Tap, gather, and progress as you watch your tribe grow and flourish. Experience the satisfaction of seeing your efforts yield results.
Stone Age Survival is the ultimate test of your survival instincts and strategic thinking. Can you lead your tribe to thrive in a world filled with peril and uncertainty? Only the most resilient and resourceful will prevail. Embrace the stone age challenge and embark on an unforgettable journey of survival and progress.

Terms of service: https://geektales.games/tos.html
