bluejetty:00157026:ios.description:
The Village Medical app is the easiest and fastest way to stay connected with your Village Medical care team 24/7. With the app, you can:
• Live text chat with your Village Medical care team 24/7
• Schedule appointments
• Quickly access test results – sometimes in the same day
• Have fast, easy and secure video visits
• Get helpful support for managing chronic disease
Download the app before your next appointment to start using the app right away with your existing AthenaHealth Patient Portal login.
App highlights:
GET HELP WITH LIVE CHAT
Chat with your Village Medical care team 24/7 to get help with symptoms, medications, labs, appointments and more, at no extra cost.
BOOK A VISIT, VIDEO OR IN-OFFICE
Simply tap the "Book Visit" tile and follow the instructions to search for and book a video or in-office visit with your Village Medical provider.
SEND US A MESSAGE
Send and receive messages with your provider and care team via the "Inbox" tab.
ACCESS YOUR HEALTH RECORDS
Tap on “My Health” on the main navigation bar for quick access to your lab results, medications, post-visit summaries and care documents.
If you have any concerns about the information you see in the application, please consult with your Village Medical provider.

bluejetty:00045582:ios.name: LoneStar App
bluejetty:00045582:ios.summary:
LoneStar Adhesive™ is a family owned and operated business, working to leave the custom branding industry a little better than it was found.
As someone who began in this business as a hat maker himself, it didn’t take our owner (Josh) long
bluejetty:00045582:ios.description:
LoneStar Adhesive™ is a family owned and operated business, working to leave the custom branding industry a little better than it was found.
As someone who began in this business as a hat maker himself, it didn’t take our owner (Josh) long to see that the “industry standard” for thermal activated adhesive was sub-par, at best. A background in customer service drove him to seek a solution that didn’t leave him continually returning to troubleshoot work that could be done right the first time.
Growing weary of companies promising a solution, only to offer disappointing results, he sought after an adhesive that truly is, "Adhesive with Integrity." After testing the durability for a while in his own small business, “Brim Lines,” he knew it should be brought to other makers so the entire industry could see what should be the new standard.
Durra-Bull, the signature product and adhesive from LoneStar Adhesive Co., has taken the industry by the horns and left the rest in its dust. It has stood its ground while enduring all kinds of conditions from a truck left in the South Texas summer heat to the frigid temps endured by our Canadian friends to a well-meaning trip through the washing machine.
The years since bringing the adhesive to market have been a wild ride, and LoneStar Adhesive has grown into a distributor of top-grain leather, leatherette, wood veneer, and acrylic sheets, all backed by Durra-Bull adhesive. Staying true to his roots, Richardson hats are also stocked in some of the most popular color ways.
The solutions coming from LoneStar haven’t ended there, either. Now known for their customer service, they’ve brought a dual platen hat press with an extended warranty to market, the Branding Iron. And when an ongoing problem with leatherette peeling was identified, Josh approached a manufacturer about creating a premium leatherette. This product is now an exclusive offering of LoneStar Adhesive, and proving to be yet another solution the industry needed.
As of today, you can easily find makers proudly demonstrating the strength of the adhesive through “pull tests” for their own customers. The LoneStar Adhesive Team still helpfully, and joyfully, recommends the use of pliers.
We've added the new LoneStar app as an easily accessible option for browsing and purchasing our products. Whether it's patch hat supplies, heat presses, design files, or instructional information, our LoneStar mobile app has got you covered!
There has never been a better time to make professional-grade patch hats, patch beanies, and more using our premium laser supplies and heat-activated adhesive...
Download the LoneStar App to Get Started Today!

bluejetty:00042184:ios.name: Tumble 22 Hot Chicken
bluejetty:00042184:ios.summary:
Tumble 22 Nashville style hot chicken comin' in HOT at your fingertips! Get it, order it, deliver it, LOVE it!
From a single food trailer to five restaurants in less than four years, Tumble 22 is blazing a trail with their commitment to al
bluejetty:00042184:ios.description:
Tumble 22 Nashville style hot chicken comin' in HOT at your fingertips! Get it, order it, deliver it, LOVE it!
From a single food trailer to five restaurants in less than four years, Tumble 22 is blazing a trail with their commitment to all-natural, Texas-raised chicken that’s hand-breaded and tumbled precisely twenty two times for the perfect crunch. Inspired by Nashville hot chicken and guided by one of the best chefs in Texas, Tumble 22 is a funky chicken joint serving Cold Beer, Hot Chicken, and Cheap, Stiff Drinks — best enjoyed alongside a little Housemade Pie, available whole or by the slice!
The chicken is fried and coated in Chef Marmulstein’s own secret blend of spices, getting its heat from the cayenne and spice dip. The basic components of the dish are chicken, a combination of spices, and careful cooking in hot oil. MSG is not used in the preparation of any of Tumble 22 chicken
or products.
You’ll taste the difference in everything we do, and with six heat levels ranging from “Wimpy” to “Stupid Hot,” you’ll have a dang good time doing it! But, before you delve into this culinary adventure be forewarned, you’ve got to be ready to take a little heat. For those who don’t like it hot, the menu includes other flavor options and sauces like our Comeback Sauce.
Dine-in, carry out or delivery in Austin, Cedar Park, Round Rock, or Vintage Park Houston and come see what everyone’s cluckin’ about!

bluejetty:00167028:ios.description:
Everyone gets the camera. The whole party shoots. The morning after, you all wake up to one shared roll — film-grain, candid, untouched.
No edits. No previews. No curating. Just the night, exactly as it happened.
A disposable camera for the iPhone era. Built by Hipstamatic, the team that started mobile film photography in 2009.
→ How it works
1. Create a camera. Name it, set the dates, pick a film look.
2. Invite your guests. They join in ten seconds — no download, no account.
3. Everyone shoots. Photos stay hidden until the camera closes.
4. The next morning, the whole roll is revealed to everyone at once.
→ What's in the roll
The kiss you never saw. The stage dive from the back row. The 4am sunrise no one remembered. The flash-lit moment that somehow looks iconic.
All of it, captured by everyone. All of it, yours to keep or let vanish when the night ends.
→ What's inside
- Real film looks: 90s, rich color, vintage, black & white, instant
- Zero-install guest join via App Clip
- Custom camera names, themes, and durations
- No profiles. No follows. No feed.
- Photos tied to the event, not a permanent network
→ Made for
Concerts · Weddings · Birthdays · Bachelorettes · Festivals · Prom · Formals · Warehouse raves · Secret shows · Bestie birthdays · Anywhere a phone is the only camera in the room.
→ Public Parties (Los Angeles)
Find the show you're at. Join the camera other fans are shooting on. See the night from every angle in the venue. Pair it with the official Apple Music Set List to relive the show exactly as it happened — not just how you heard it, but how the entire room saw it.
→ Privacy by design
No account required to join a camera. Photos live with the event, not a permanent profile. When the camera closes, you decide what to keep.
The night starts when you open it.
End User License Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00014965:ios.description:
Afro Latin Percussion Machine is your virtual Latin percussionist. Practice, create, and perform authentic Afro-Latin rhythms like never before. Free to download and keep, with the features open for the first 7 days (some actions have a limited number of uses). Designed for musicians, producers, and anyone who loves the rhythms of Latin America and the Caribbean, now with AUv3 support.
Play hot Latin rhythms with the highest sound quality: son, son montuno, guaguancó, columbia, yambú, bembé, cha-cha-chá, mambo, merengue, bachata, salsa, bolero, songo and bomba, with over 100 rhythms in total. So easy to use, you can edit and create your own in seconds.
Key Features:
Song Mode: turn your Afro-Latin rhythms into complete arrangements in seconds. Set groove, jam and intensity per part, double-tap to edit, long-press to reorder. Fast and simple.

bluejetty:00021904:ios.summary:

CASIO MUSIC SPACE is a free app that provides new ways to enjoy music.Designed specifically for CASIO digital piano and keyboard users, the app s
bluejetty:00021904:ios.description:
Setup, practice and inspiration - all in one place.
A free app that takes your music further.
CASIO MUSIC SPACE is a free app that provides new ways to enjoy music.Designed specifically for CASIO digital piano and keyboard users, the app syncs with your instrument to offer a wealth of features for learning and enjoying music, including digital sheet music, alongside guided practice experiences and live-feel performance mode.
Easily adjust your instrument settings, view digital sheet music, learn songs through interactive play, and experience the excitement of virtual live performance. Designed to make your time at the keyboard smoother and more engaging, the app naturally invites you to keep playing and discovering something new.
Easily go back and forth between the joy of playing an instrument, and other ways to enjoy when not playing. Whether you’re a beginner, looking to give music another try, or just eager to experience new ways to play. Through watching, listening and playing, you’ll discover new ways to enjoy music and express yourself.
When you’re ready to explore CASIO instruments and the world of music, start with CASIO MUSIC SPACE.
Six Features 
1. Expand your music experience
From browsing curated social media content, relevant topics and new product information, and checking out the latest tips to help you improve – everything is just a tap away. 
Whether you play an instrument or not, CASIO MUSIC SPACE provides a wealth of support for a life filled with music.
2. Piano Remote Controller 
Change your digital piano’s settings quickly and easily. 
Connect your smart device to your digital piano and control various settings remotely without the need to operate the piano itself. 
3. Piano Roll 
The piano roll makes it easy to see which notes to play even if you don’t read music. It’s a great way to have fun learning while playing. 
The pitch and duration of each note is visualized in real time as the song plays, making it easy to find the correct notes of the chords or melody. 
4. Score Viewer 
“Musical Score + Sound” lets you see and listen to a wide range of music on your smart device. 
Zoom in and out and flip through pages of sheet music in the app. View a score while listening to the music —great for use on the go. 
5. Music Player 
Play along with Your Favorite Songs. 
Connect your smart device and playback songs through the instrument’s speakers. Perfect for creating a session-like atmosphere, accompanying songs, or practicing parts of songs for a band. 
*Note: This service does not support music stored in the cloud or songs protected by Digital Rights Management (DRM).
*Note: Some features may not be available for songs from music streaming services.
6. Live Concert Simulator 
Turn everyday playing into an extraordinary experience. Feel the excitement of live performance at home. 
The app analyzes the song stored on your smart device and automatically adds audience sounds depending on the structure of the song. Add a new dimension to your playing with this unique performance experience.

bluejetty:00169827:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00169827:ios.description:
Welcome to WhaleWatch – a global community powered Whale sightings platform. 
Originating in Australia over a decade ago, we've embarked on this journey once more in response to popular demand. However, this time, it extends beyond Australia's borders. It's no longer just for Australians to observe, post, and share their encounters with the majestic creatures of our remarkable planet; it's for the world to embrace.
Whale migration, one of nature's most awe-inspiring phenomena, is a remarkable journey undertaken by various species of whales across vast stretches of ocean. Spanning thousands of miles annually, these migrations serve essential purposes such as breeding, feeding, and avoiding harsh environmental conditions. Some species, like the humpback whale, travel from their feeding grounds in polar regions to warmer waters near the equator to give birth and mate, while others, like the gray whale, undertake epic journeys from Arctic waters to the warmer waters of the Pacific coast of Mexico. These migrations are not only crucial for the survival of whale populations but also play a significant role in maintaining the health and balance of marine ecosystems worldwide.
VIEW, POST AND SHARE – WHALE SIGHTINGS
View the interactive Whale sightings map. You can view and post your whale sightings on the WhaleWatch app for the wider whale watching enthusiasts. Note behaviours, characteristics, species and upload photos to get your sightings published. Note that we may restrict what appears on the app if there are too many. Welcome to WhaleWatch – a global community powered Whale sightings platform. 

Originating in Australia over a decade ago, we've embarked on this journey once more in response to popular demand. However, this time, it extends beyond Australia's borders. It's no longer just for Australians to observe, post, and share their encounters with the majestic creatures of our remarkable planet; it's for the world to embrace.

 

Whale migration, one of nature's most awe-inspiring phenomena, is a remarkable journey undertaken by various species of whales across vast stretches of ocean. Spanning thousands of miles annually, these migrations serve essential purposes such as breeding, feeding, and avoiding harsh environmental conditions. Some species, like the humpback whale, travel from their feeding grounds in polar regions to warmer waters near the equator to give birth and mate, while others, like the gray whale, undertake epic journeys from Arctic waters to the warmer waters of the Pacific coast of Mexico. These migrations are not only crucial for the survival of whale populations but also play a significant role in maintaining the health and balance of marine ecosystems worldwide.

 

VIEW, POST AND SHARE  – WHALE SIGHTINGS

View the interactive Whale sightings map. You can view and post your whale sightings on the WhaleWatch app for the wider whale watching enthusiasts. Note behaviours, characteristics, species and upload photos to get your sightings published. Note that we may restrict what appears on the app if there are too many. For example; one tour boat carrying 50+ can create a lot of sightings which are similar so we moderate the platform for a better user experience.

 

WHALE WATCH – GALLERY

RECEIVE NOTIFICATIONS

PARTNER WITH US?

bluejetty:00114250:ios.summary:
Protocol Zero is the first Active Sleep Improvement based on Research
It’s a system that gives you a clear, personalized daily plan so you know exactly what to do to sleep better starting tonight.
New: Protocol Zero now includes sleep soun
bluejetty:00114250:ios.description:
Protocol Zero is the first Active Sleep Improvement based on Research
It’s a system that gives you a clear, personalized daily plan so you know exactly what to do to sleep better starting tonight.
New: Protocol Zero now includes sleep sounds you can play at night, including white noise, brown noise, rain, and calming audio. Use them alongside your personalized nightly routine to unwind faster and fall asleep more easily.
YOUR PERSONAL SLEEP COACH
Unlike most apps that only track your sleep, Protocol Zero guides you through a daily schedule designed to reset your body clock and improve your sleep quality. Each day, you get specific actions that make a real difference:
- Set a consistent wake time and get morning light exposure to reset your internal clock and help you feel alert during the day
- Follow precise caffeine cutoffs so late-day coffee or tea never interferes with your deep sleep
- Activate wind-down mode in the evening, which blocks distracting apps and helps your mind and body relax before bed
- Practice science-backed techniques from Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I), proven to help you fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer
HOW IT WORKS
Your body depends on a 24-hour internal clock to regulate sleep. Protocol Zero anchors your day around two key signals: when you wake up and when you get morning light. The app then schedules your caffeine, meals, exercise, and wind-down activities into optimal time windows. This structure helps you build habits that make you naturally tired at bedtime, so you fall asleep more easily and wake up refreshed.
No more lying awake wondering what went wrong. No more generic sleep tips that never stick. Protocol Zero gives you a clear, automated plan that builds lasting habits for deep, restorative sleep.
SIMPLE, SCIENCE-BACKED, AND ACTIONABLE
Protocol Zero combines the most effective techniques from CBT-I the gold standard for sleep improvement with modern behavioral science. Research shows that tracking your habits and making targeted changes leads to real, lasting results. We make these techniques simple to follow, so you can start seeing improvements right away.
WHO IT’S FOR
Protocol Zero is designed for healthy adults who want to optimize their sleep. It is an educational tool, not a medical device, and is not intended to diagnose or treat sleep disorders. If you suspect you have insomnia, sleep apnea, or another medical condition, consult a physician.
Stop guessing about your sleep. Start following a clear plan and experience better rest tonight with Protocol Zero.
*in-app subscription is required to use the app

bluejetty:00129488:ios.description:
There are all kinds of funny, bizarre, and magical patients here. They are bizarre and will definitely subvert your cognition of medical knowledge! You will see diarrhea patients who fart 100 times a day, fever patients who burn themselves, food poisoning patients whose poisoning turns into mushrooms, invisible patients who never wear clothes, and star disease who walk with wind , An alcoholic who is allergic to alcohol; by the way, there is a gigantism bigger than an elephant, God! What is this! Hey Hey hey! Don't talk nonsense, our aim is no matter how strange the patient is, we must serve well! Come on!Don't talk nonsense, our aim is no matter how strange the patient is, we must serve well! Come on!
Construction of the department
 Buy and build high-end medical facilities and departments, you can dismantle and rebuild departments at any time according to the needs of patients, try to make every department function and improve the utilization rate of the department
strange patient
 Human or monster patients who challenge medical cognition, diseases that are close to real or magical existence, and those who are occasionally infected with mixed viruses in the residents of the town, all residents expect to be cured in your hospital
With the improvement of the hospital level, more and more patients from areas are willing to come to your hospital for treatment. You can go to these areas to recruit patients after meeting the conditions, and use the reputation of the hospital to recruit more of these patients. get paid handsomely
hospital administrator
 Boldly exercise the powers of administrators, appointing highly skilled and peculiarly gifted doctors to treat patients (speeding up patient visits with electric shocks, etc.), while firing poorly skilled doctors lest they treat patients from worsening
 Comprehensively consider the doctor's talent and ability, and reasonably arrange the doctor to go to different departments, which will greatly improve the healing effect of the department
take care of patient
 Learn to manage the patient's mood. When they are in a low mood, please find out the problems they have for the hospital as soon as possible, and try to meet their needs as soon as possible.
Medical solution development
 In your spare time, let's play a small game of drug research and development. As the dean, you can unlock more treatment options by developing precious drugs, improve the overall treatment level of the hospital, and help more patients have a healthy body Bar!

bluejetty:00149251:ios.description:
Pocket Kado — Your Cozy Companion for Better Sleep
Falling asleep shouldn’t be so complicated!
Winner of the National Sleep Foundation’s 2023 SleepTech® Award, Pocket Kado blends a routine of healthy sleep habits, mindful journaling, relaxing soundscapes, and CBT-I–to help you fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer.
Developed in collaboration with Stanford Medicine, Pocket Kado is here to help when your brain won’t shut off at night, anxiety creeps in after the lights go out, or your sleep feels unpredictable.
Pocket Kado is made for:
- Nighttime anxiety and overthinking
- Restless or inconsistent sleep
- Anyone tired of feeling tired
- Anyone who wants a softer, more human approach to sleep
What You’ll Find Inside Pocket Kado:
- Guided nighttime routines to help your mind slow down
- Mindful journaling to release racing thoughts before bed
- Soothing soundscapes and sleep audio for deep rest
- CBT-I–inspired tools to support healthier sleep habits
- Gentle encouragement focused on progress, not perfection
Download Pocket Kado and start winding down tonight!
Join Our Community:
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pocketkado
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@pocketkado
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/pocketkadosleepjourney/
Have thoughts or questions? Reach out to us at hello@mindlabmh.com.
Consult healthcare providers for medical advice alongside using Pocket Kado.
Privacy Policy: https://www.pocketkado.org/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.pocketkado.org/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00064242:ios.description:
War is coming!
DRAW YOUR BOW AND SAVE YOUR KINGDOM from hordes of goblins and trolls that siege your tower! Crush your enemies and become the greatest Tiny Archer in this challenging, fantasy, action game.
Discover fantastic characters, fight multiple enemies, unlock magic arrows and surprising abilities. Use your archery skills to survive! Defend your tower, defeat countless goblin and skeleton armies and save the day! Join the ultimate bow and arrow adventure of Tiny Archers!
FEATURES
▶ ATTACK your enemies with 4 amazing characters: human, dwarf, elf and beastmaster
▶ DISCOVER four surprising stories in this uniquely designed tower defence game
▶ FIGHT an army of goblins, trolls and skeletons with special arrows, abilities and different attack layers
▶ CHALLENGE yourself in 4 different stories with more than 130 unique tower defence levels!
▶ TRAIN your archery skills to precisely aim attacks that stun, slow down, or kill your enemies instantly!
▶ UPGRADE your characters and collect resources to discover new, magic arrows and skills
▶ DEVELOP your unique strategy and tactics to survive and defend your tower from an army of goblins and trolls!
▶ LAY TRAPS and use that strategic advantage against the attackers!
▶ SURVIVE longer in the new game mode and beat the Leaderboard!
▶ EXPERIENCE the challenge of the hard mode levels
▶ EXPLORE diverse locations: elf cities, dwarf mines, valleys, forests and haunted graveyards
▶ ENABLE the 18+ features for the full experiment: blood mode, exploding bodies, kill-cam
Become the greatest archery master and save the kingdom in this ultimate bow and arrow defence game!
The game contains rewarded videos as well which are optional to watch. 
Do you have any issues, questions or suggestions for improvement? Please send us your ideas and feedback!
Reach us at: info@1der-ent.com
Website: www.1der-ent.com 
Facebook: facebook.com/TinyArchers 
Twitter: twitter.com/1DerEnt 
Youtube: youtube.com/user/1DERentertainment

We do not store uploaded photos. All photos are deleted after recognition.

bluejetty:00039936:ios.description:
Flirtonic — AI Dating Assistant Keyboard
Flirtonic is the AI keyboard that helps you spark attraction, get replies, and move chats toward real dates. Paste the message you received or generate a fresh opener, pick your style (Flirting, Spicy, or Casual), and let Goal Mode drive the conversation to an outcome—like getting the number or planning a meet‑up.
WHAT YOU GET WITH FLIRTONIC
▶ AI Dating Assistant Keyboard that works inside your favorite apps  
▶ Get witty lines for flirting in seconds  
▶ One‑tap Flirty & Spicy replies tailored to your vibe  
▶ Set a goal—AI drives the chat so you don’t have to overthink  
▶ 12 goals with one‑tap lines (Get Number, Ask Out, Reignite, Meet Up, Video Call, Apologize, Turn Romantic, Platform Switch, Emotional Bond, Intimate, Keep Warm, and more)  ▶ Generate an opener fast & easy when you’re starting from scratch  
▶ Profile Screenshot Scanner for instant, AI‑powered insights and tailored suggestions  
▶ Unleash texting power in any app—Instagram, Hinge, Bumble, Tinder, iMessage, Telegram, WhatsApp, TikTok, and more
KEY FLIRTONIC FEATURES
▶ Start or Reply in one tap  Paste a message to get a smart reply—or generate a brand‑new opener to kick things off. Skip the typing, keep the chemistry.
▶ Choose your style  Pick Spicy, Flirting, or Casual to match the moment. Flirtonic tunes your rizz line to your desired energy.
▶ Goal Mode: set outcomes, not just lines  Tell Flirtonic what you want (e.g., get the number, set up a date, switch platforms). The AI steers the chat toward that goal with natural, confidence‑boosting messages.
▶ 12 Ready‑Made Goals, One‑Tap Lines  From Get Number and Ask Out to Reignite, Video Call, Turn Romantic, Meet Up, Apologize, Platform Switch, Emotional Bond, Intimate, Keep Warm, and more—tap a goal to get lines that fit.
▶ Profile Screenshot Scanner  Upload a profile screenshot and get instant analysis plus message ideas crafted for that person’s vibe.
▶ Works everywhere  Use Flirtonic inside any messaging app or dating platform for effortless, on‑point texting.
PAYMENT AND SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS
Choose one of the following to access Flirtonic features:  
• Monthly Subscription  
• Annual Subscription
You may cancel your subscription at any time. To do so, go to your Apple account to manage your subscription and turn auto‑renewal off.
Support: support@flirtonic.com
Terms of Use – https://flirtonic.com/terms-of-use  
Privacy Policy – https://flirtonic.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00089910:android.description:
Little Cash gives you instant personal loan to direct to your mobile wallet.
How to Get a little Cash loan:
Download the app from Google Play store
Register with our application
Get your loan approval on fly
Our secure system verifies your identity in a few
Your loan amount will be deposited in your Mobile Money account
Little Cash Loan Terms and Fees:
Loan Amounts: PHP 1,000 - PHP 50,000
Monthly facilitation fee: 9% - 25%
APR: 27% - 260%
For example, for a 65-days loan with a principal amount of PHP 1,000 the facilitation fee would be PHP 250 and the total payable amount would be PHP 1,250
Minimum repayment period is 65 days while the maximum repayment period is 120 days, with a minimum APR is 27% while the maximum APR is 260%
LittleCash does not charge more than the amount of the facilitation fee (plus a one-time late fee if you do not pay after the loan repayment grace period). The loan amount does not compound or accrue.
Sample Loan :
Loan Amount 1000 PHP
Interest Calculation - (1000 * 25 ) / 100 = 250 PHP
Expected Payback amount For 65 days - 1000 PHP + 250 PHP = 1250 PHP
Monthly Payment - 625 PHP
Little Cash is very flexible and charges affordable and low facilitation fee ranging from 9% to 25%
What You'll Love
● Avail instant loans from Little Cash through your smartphone
● Faster approval process with less documentation
● Get collateral-free loans without any bank visits or phone calls
● Attractive rate of interests
● Loan disbursement in 10 minutes
Documentation
The minimum documents required to avail loan is your identification number,mobile number, your email address etc. might be required. Once you apply for loans, we will check you in a few minutes.
Security
Your data is safe with us. It is transferred over a secure HTTPS connection to us, and we do not share it with anyone without your consent except the Lenders. All the transactions are secured via a 128-bit SSL encryption.
Customer service
If you have questions or complaints, please leave us a message through the Feedback page in our application or contact our customer service center. We are ready to serve you.

bluejetty:00120255:ios.description:
LadderTouchLite is an app to learn the basics of ladder logic, which is a graphical programming language.
This app has two functions.
You can learn about that mechanism by executing some of the prepared samples. And you can check your understanding with questions.
-------Difference from the full version-------
It doesn't show hints of questions.
You cannot make your own ladders.
---------------ELEMENTS---------------
Input(yellow)
Up to 5 elements.
You can control the input signal by tapping the buttons at the bottom of the display.
Virtual output(red)
Up to 5 elements.
Internal memory(gray)
Up to 20 elements.
Virtual output(red) and internal memory(gray) are the same for logical behavior.
But the difference is in usage. 
The virtual output is the last element in the ladder logic chain.
The Internal memory is for the processing element of the ladder logic chain.
These are an imitation of the actual ladder logic with the output devices.
Timer(blue)
Up to 5 elements.
The timer can be set from 0.1 seconds to 10.0 seconds. The setting unit is 0.1 second.
The timer works only 'on delay'. This app does not include 'off delay'.
On Delay.
 ---++++++++++ source
 -------++++++ destination
Off Delay.
 +++---------- source
 ++++++++----- destination
+ ON
- OFF
Time flows from left to right
Counter(green)
Up to 5 elements.
You can set from 1 to 50.
There is no counter reset element in this app. Many other ladder logic software has it.
The way to reset the counter is to stop running the ladder.
All elements can be inverse in the source area.
However, timers and counters cannot do it in the destination area.
It is difficult to understand the inverse logic of a timer and counter in the destination area.
--------------Other--------------
There is no function that connects to outer devices.

bluejetty:00123264:ios.description:
The UBank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact UBank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the UBank App, you must be enrolled as a UBank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00142601:ios.description:
SBI Card Mobile App is a one-stop solution to manage your credit card on the go! Trusted by over 10 million+ SBI Credit Cardholders, the app provides easy and secure access to your SBI Credit Card Account. It allows you to manage your finances efficiently. You can pay card bill, track spends and rewards, and avail 100+ servicing features.
Get started with SBI Credit Card App to enjoy a seamless experience:
• Register / signup with your SBI Credit Card details on our Mobile App in just a few simple steps.
• Stay protected with secured login and Mobile Number verification. Login through password, 4-digit MPIN or biometric details. 
Ease of Account Management on SBI Credit Card app:
• Credit Card Statement: View or download your monthly credit card statement and check transaction history, unbilled transactions, and payment history in just a few clicks.
• Credit Card Payment: Pay your monthly credit card bill (Total Amount Due or Minimum Amount Due) using host of payment options such debit card, internet banking or UPI.
• Pay in EMI: You can convert your recent transactions into flexible EMIs.
• Track Usage: Check your card usage with Spend Analyzer. 
• View Card: No need to carry your physical SBI Credit card everywhere when you can view your card details on our App. Access your credit card details like card number and date through OTP authentication. 
• Manage your SBI Credit Card: Change / reset your credit card PIN, check disputed transactions or raise your card block or reissue request in a few simple steps in case of physical damage, lost or stolen card.
Manage your card transaction usage:
• Set your transaction preference for Domestic & International usage 
• Set limits for Online, Contactless, ATM and POS transactions for Domestic & International card usage.
• Manage UPI transactions and set usage limit
• Manage your profile by updating your address, E-mail ID, or Mobile Number
• Set transaction limits for payments using Tokenized services like SBI Card Pay, Samsung Pay, etc.
Pay with ease using SBI Credit Card app
• Use ‘Scan to Pay’ feature to make payment at any Bharat QR-enabled merchant 
• Apply for an Add-on Card to share your card benefits with family
• Shop and Save on E-Store: Pay your utility bills such as electricity, insurance premiums, mobile recharges. Shop for Instant Vouchers of top brands, complete your travel bookings, buy personalized gifts, flowers and cakes and so much more.
• Transfer your outstanding balance from a non-SBI Credit Card to your SBI Credit Card. Simply enter your amount and repayment option, choose from the shown offers and enter your card details and pay back in lumpsum or easy credit card EMIs
• Raise a request for Credit Limit Increase in a few simple steps.
Want to apply for your new SBI Credit Card? 
Explore from a wide range of Credit Cards available as per your need and get instant approval. You can avail benefits such as free airport lounge access (domestic/international), welcome bonus, rewards, vouchers and so much more. Apply through our mobile app and get instant approval with minimal documentation.

bluejetty:00123781:ios.description:
In the war of fire, beasts and stone, will you be the Chief Almighty?
Rally ally tribes together in the primal stone ages! The epic prehistoric lands are rich with resources and ancient beasts ready for you to explore and dominate.Trust your instincts when deploying diplomacy with rival Chiefs, Lead your armies and tribes to smash the most dangerous of rivals, Hunt ancient creatures to become a fierce symbol of your power!
●●Strategy Mobile Game in the Stone Ages. Explore the continents with players Worldwide! ●●
▲Hunt ancient beasts, experience a primitive hunting frenzy!
▲Collect resources, ally with other Chiefs, build your tribe!
▲Ally, plunder, expand, occupy. Expand your power and influence with strong allies, ready to facehead-on the worthiest of Chiefs!
▲Diplomacy or Domination? Trust your instincts, only the brave and resourceful will dominate the continent!
▲Grand Opening of the one and only worldwide server.
●●Classic Features●●
◎◎Real Time Strategy Assembling◎◎
Organize clan mates, assemble ancient beast, awaken your leadership and lead warriors and ally Chiefs to be the Chief Almighty!
◎◎HD Unity3D Game Engine. Excellent Graphics◎◎
High scale panoramic map zooming. Players fully visualize each and every aspect of the map.
◎◎Global Server! Players of different nations compete intensively for ancient relics, in pursuit of the Arch-Chief’s honor! ◎◎
Arcane ancient relics, treasures of endless wealth. Whether you hail from the great eastern lands or the vast west, join a clan and you’ll be able to experience the most primitive, exciting battles!
◎◎Fierce collision between ancient creatures and primitive warriors. Dinosaurs, ancient and Warriors are waiting for your commands! ◎◎
▲Barbarians,the pride of the clan with bloodlust instincts, braves forward even against fierce Behemoths!
▲ Javelineers, essential in the battlefield, capable of dealing high damage with great precision and dexterity!
▲War Riders , riding vicious high-speed dinosaurs, rains death on your enemies with battleaxes and arrows!
▲Ancient Behemoths, from small wild boars, giant mammoths to triceratops and more beasts of prehistoric times all at your command!
▲Rule Description of subscription:
1:Valid For: 7 Days
2:Within the valid days after subscription, Collect (Daily): 1.5M Wood*1, 100 Diamond*3, 20K Chief EXP*1, 50 Energy*1
3:Fees will automatically be charged after the last Valid Day; cancelling of Subscription can only be done manually
4:Your iTunes account will commence with the charge once Subscription has been confirmed
5:Subscription will be continued unless the auto-subscription option is closed 24 hours before the current subscription is over
6:Your account will be subject to the Fees and confirmation of the next subscription, within the last 24 hours before the current subscription ends
7:After Subscription, you can close your subscription service at your account's setting
8. Subscription feature cannot be tried for free
▲Renewing Description Notice of Subscription:
1. Upon Subscribing, fees will be automatically deducted every 7 days to prolong the Subscription Benefit for 7 days
2. Your iPhone's Subscription Benefit Fees will be deducted from your Apple iTune account
3. If you want to cancel Subscription, please close the automatic subscribe feature at least 24 hours before the next fee deduction
4. Cancel Method: From Home page, enter [Setting]—>Tap on [iTune Store or App Store]—>Tap on [Apple ID] and select [View Apple ID]—>[Subscriptions], then select Cancel survival mobile Subscription Benefit

bluejetty:00119821:ios.description:
myBlee Math is the leading iPad app for learning mathematics in elementary school.
Mathematics teaching in myBlee is based on the most effective pedagogical approaches in the world: Singapore Method, JUMP Math, and Kumon. The myBlee pedagogy draws inspiration from the strengths of each, in order to get the best from them.
myBlee follows a Concrete–Representational–Abstract (CRA) progression that turns abstract math concepts into deep understanding. Each lesson combines explicit instruction, guided practice, and adaptive feedback to ensure every student achieves mastery before advancing.
myBlee aligns with major curricula — French Éducation Nationale, US Common Core, UK National, Swiss HarmoS, and IB PYP — making it the trusted math partner for international schools across Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and North America.
myBlee bridges technology and pedagogy to make math interactive, rigorous, and rewarding for every learner.
Available on the App Store : myBlee School for schools and myBlee Math for families 
Learn more at www.mybleemath.com

== CONTACT ==

bluejetty:00086952:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00086952:ios.description:
The fastest way to lower your scores in disc golf is to practice your putting - and dgputt is where that practice happens.
The app gives you structured disc golf putting drills, progress tracking, and head-to-head matches. Whether you're building a putting practice routine, training for competition, or running a putting league at your club, dgputt has the tools. Five drills free. Everything else with Pro.
PUTTING DRILLS
STORMPUTT
The signature dgputt drill. Start at 16ft (5m), step back every six putts, finish at 33ft /10m. Your score is how many you made — watch it climb over time.
JYLY
The most popular disc golf putting drill on dgputt. Putt from 33ft (10m), your next distance depends on how many you make. Hit all five and stay, miss all and step in to 16ft/5m. 
TWENTY AND FIFTY
Pick your distance from 13ft/4m to 50ft/15m and your volume - 20 or 50 putts in sets of five. A reliable putting practice drill for any level.
FRØYSA
Four distances, five putts each, 100 total. Aim for a perfect score of 100. A clean benchmark putting drill for any skill level.
HUNDRED (Pro)
Choose any distance and putt until you've sunk 100. Your score is your attempt count, obsess over lowering it.
SHUFFLE (Pro)
18 or 36 putts with a randomly assigned distance each throw. Trains you to reset between putts, just like on the disc golf course.
RUNSJØ (Pro)
A two-disc ladder game. Make both to advance, miss both to step back, make one to stay.
SURVIVAL (Pro)
Two or three lives. Every miss costs one. How far can you get?
STREAK (Pro)
Putt until you miss. How long can you keep it going?
AIM (Pro)
Register where each putt lands. Track your miss patterns and dial in your aim.
MATCHES (Pro)
Challenge a friend to a head-to-head disc golf putting match — JYLY, Cornhole, or Sevens. Settle it on the green with results counting toward your global putting rating.
ROUND (Pro)
Log putts during a round of disc golf. Get instant Circle 1 and Circle 2 stats plus a putting score.
EVENTS & PUTTING LEAGUES (Pro to create · Free to join)
Run a single putting event or a full disc golf putting league for your club or friends. Shared leaderboard, results everyone can follow.
STATS
Browse all your putting practice sessions — total putts, hit percentage, average score, and personal bests.
PROGRESS (Pro)
Track your Circle 1 score over months and years of disc golf training. The graph doesn't lie.
PUTTING ROUTINE
Document your pre-putt process — up to 5 steps — and stay consistent under pressure.
PRICING
Free to download. Pro unlocks all disc golf putting drills, matches, progress tracking, and more. Annual membership is about the price of a new disc.
PRIVACY POLICY
https://dgputt.app/#/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00154194:ios.description:
Turn paper into clean, signed, searchable PDFs, right on your iPhone. Scan a contract, fill in the blanks, sign on the line and send it back in a minute. No printer, no scanner, no laptop.
SCAN 
- Point the camera at a page: edges are found and the page is straightened for you 
- Scan many pages into one document
- Import PDFs and photos from Files or your photo library
- Turn a Word file into a PDF
FILL IN & SIGN
- Draw your signature once; next time it lands right on the signature line
- Add today's date, your name, initials, ticks and crosses in a tap
- Stamps such as Approved and Paid, with the date and your name
- Draw and highlight on any page
- Every signature and stamp is kept in the document's signing log
FIND & UNDERSTAND
- Extract the text from any scan, then copy it or save it as a text file
- Search your library by what documents say, not only by their names
- Ask questions about a document with on-device AI (iPhones with Apple Intelligence)
POLISH & SHARE
- Black & white mode that evens out shadows and uneven light, plus colour filters
- Rotate, crop, reorder, insert and remove pages
- Combine two documents into one
- Share as the original PDF, a smaller PDF or JPG images
- Lock a PDF with a password before you send it
STAY ON TOP
- Due-date reminders for bills, contracts and forms
- Home Screen widget, Control Center button and Siri: start a scan from anywhere 
- Long-press the app icon to scan, extract text, sign or import
- Made for foldable iPhone, with two panes when unfolded
Your documents stay on your iPhone. Text recognition and AI answers run on the device.

Sign in
bluejetty:00123639:ios.description:
New to Waitrose & Partners online?
Create an account in our app and you can start shopping straight away. You can also sign up to myWaitrose or link to an existing account via the app.
Already shop online with Waitrose & Partners?
Sign in using your waitrose.com details and you're good to go. With the app, you can book a delivery or Click & Collect slot, view existing orders, amend orders and search for products with ease.
On the move?
Start a shop in our app, and complete it at waitrose.com ‒ or vice versa. Your Trolley contents and account details will automatically sync.
Are you a myWaitrose member?
Leave your physical myWaitrose card at home and still benefit from the same great offers. Scan the digital card in the app at checkout or use it for ScanPayGo. You can also now add your myWaitrose card to your Apple Wallet.
Scan and pay in store using your mobile phone with ScanPayGo
Available in the Waitrose app, ScanPayGo allows you to scan product barcodes, see a running total, pack your bags as you go and check out fast. And to make shopping even simpler you can write your shopping list from the app home screen before you arrive in store. You will need to register for a waitrose.com account and myWaitrose card to use ScanPayGo.
Click & Collect now on the app
Why wait in? Pop to your local Waitrose & Partners store and collect your order – free of charge.
Waitrose Entertaining now on the app
If you’re feeding a crowd or planning a special celebration, our made to order range will make stress-free celebrations simple yet stylish.
Use Favourites
Easily find the items you regularly buy online and in-store. Any items you’ve previously bought online will be automatically added into your Favourites, and items you buy in-store using your myWaitrose card will also be listed. To add more items into your Favourites simply tap on the heart icons.
Speedily access your most used features (such as slot booking, search, trolley and offers) directly from your device home screen – simply press and hold the app icon.
iPad optimised
You can use the app on your iPad to complete a full shopping journey in landscape view.
Add upcoming orders to your calendar
After check out simply add your delivery or collection slot time to your phone’s calendar so you’ll never forget the date of your next order.
To help us improve our app, we would really appreciate your feedback. We’ve added a place for you to send us comments on the home screen, so if you think something doesn’t work as well as it could, or have any other suggestions, please tell us what you think.
Visit www.waitrose.com for more information.

bluejetty:00098676:ios.description:
Draw Calendar helps you plan with sketches instead of plain text. Every date can hold a quick drawing, handwritten note, or visual reminder. Your month stays readable because saved sketches appear right on each day.
Open any day to draw on a full-screen canvas, then return to the month view without breaking your flow. The app keeps planning flexible for personal routines, family schedules, and creative project timelines.
**Sketch on any day**
Tap a date to open a dedicated PencilKit editor and start drawing immediately. You can zoom for detail and keep writing naturally with touch or Apple Pencil.
**See context at a glance**
Saved drawings show up as thumbnails inside their day cells, so your notes stay anchored to real dates. This makes busy weeks easier to scan without opening each entry.
**Manage multiple calendars**
Create separate calendars for work, home, study, or side projects in a few taps. You can switch calendars quickly and keep each timeline clean and focused.
**Stay oriented across months**
Scroll smoothly through past and future months while keeping the same familiar grid layout. Use the Today button to jump back to the current month whenever you need a reset point.
**Edit with confidence**
Undo and redo actions help you refine sketches without restarting your page. If plans change, you can remove a day sketch and keep the rest of your calendar intact.
Download Draw Calendar and start turning daily plans into visual notes you can understand in seconds.

bluejetty:00178792:ios.name: MMA Manager 2: Boxing Training
bluejetty:00178792:ios.summary:
MMA Manager 2 is a high-performance mobile sports management simulator designed for fans of professional combat sports. As the successor to the hit original, this game allows players to step into the role of a professional MMA Manager.
You
bluejetty:00178792:ios.description:
MMA Manager 2 is a high-performance mobile sports management simulator designed for fans of professional combat sports. As the successor to the hit original, this game allows players to step into the role of a professional MMA Manager.
You are responsible for scouting athletes, building a world-class gym, and coaching your team to victory in the boxing ring and the MMA cage. Whether you are a fan of UFC™, mixed martial arts, wrestling, or boxing games, this simulator offers the most realistic combat sport experience on mobile. MMA Manager 2 is what every combat sports manager games fans were looking for!
Master the Art of Combat Sports Management
In the competitive world of MMA -mixed martial arts-, success is forged in the gym. To become a legend, you must manage every aspect of your fighters' careers.
* Build Your Dream Gym: Purchase state-of-the-art equipment to create the ultimate MMA training facility.
* Recruit the Best Talent: Scout for the next MMA boxing star or a martial arts prodigy.
* Train World-Class Athletes: Use your gym to master disciplines and fighting techniques like Muay Thai, BJJ, Kickboxing, Karate, and Sambo. 
* Strategy & Tactics: Develop a custom game plan for every realistic fight based on your opponent’s weaknesses.
How to Build an MMA Empire
1. Hire Expert Coaches: Pick trainers who specialize in specific techniques to give your MMA team the edge.
2. Navigate a UFC Career Mode: Lead your MMA fighters through branching progression paths in multiple weight classes.
3. Dominate the Fight Club: It’s fight night! Test your mettle against the global fighting community in high-stakes online battles.
4. Manage Your Business: As a gym manager, earn credits, prestige, and cash to upgrade your MMA training facility and unlock new moves.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I play MMA Manager 2 offline?
Yes, MMA Manager 2 features robust single-player campaigns, making it one of the top fighting games offline for sports management fans.
Is there a multiplayer mode?
Absolutely. You can join the Fight Club to engage in online MMA battles against rivals from around the world to climb the leaderboards.
Does the game include boxing?
Yes. While it is an MMA-focused game, it functions as a deep boxing simulator, allowing you to train your fighters specifically for striking and boxing matches, as well as different martial arts disciplines, like wrestling, karate, kickboxing and sambo.
How do I improve my fighter's rank?
By winning battles and consistently training in your gym, your MMA fighters gain experience, unlock improved offensive moves, and advance through the professional ranks.
Key Features at a Glance:
* Dynamic Action: Strategy-based fights that react to your tactical decisions.
* Vast Customization: Train your fighters with exciting new moves and customize their attributes.
* Premier League Experience: Compete in tournaments and rise to the top of the MMA combat organization.
* Realistic Combat: Experience the intensity of cage fighting with high-fidelity sports simulation mechanics.
Disclaimer: UFC™ is a registered trademark of TKO Group Holdings. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by TKO Group Holdings.

The QR Code Maker provides many kinds of well-designed templates. You can generate beautiful QR code in very simple steps. The template will constantly update to help you keep making beautiful and unique QR Codes.

You can customize the QR Code with different colors, eyes, patterns, and frames to make QR Code in your own style.

- Eyes: You can choose the QR code eyes to suit the overall style
- Patterns: Special patterns make special QR Codes
- Logo: You can also add your social portrait or company logos into your QR code to personalize it if you don’t like the logo we offer.

- Error Correction Level: Support 7%, 15%, 25%, 30%

bluejetty:00045012:ios.description:
Official 14ers.com app for Colorado's 14ers (mountains 14,000+ feet of elevation).
Take the trusted 14ers.com route descriptions with you into the backcountry! With this app, you'll have access to peak information, route descriptions, route maps, route photos, trailheads, plus real-time user-contributed peak condition reports. Many 14er routes are far from cell service, but you'll have the information you need even when you're off the grid. Additionally, you can record tracks and waypoints and export them to GPX or KML formats.
Mountaineering in Colorado can be very dangerous, and many people have lost their lives on the 14ers. Weather, terrain, and other hikers can put you in situations where your knowledge and experience will be critical. Always do your homework, bring the right gear, and hike with experienced partners to ensure a fun and safe journey.
Be safe out there!
Bill Middlebrook
Breckenridge, CO

bluejetty:00027035:ios.summary:
FIRST 90 DAYS FREE for new users.
APDL is the airline pilot logbook built by airline pilots, for airline pilots. Designed specifically for Part 117 scheduled operations, APDL combines your logbook with real-time legality, duty and rest tra
bluejetty:00027035:ios.description:
FIRST 90 DAYS FREE for new users.
APDL is the airline pilot logbook built by airline pilots, for airline pilots. Designed specifically for Part 117 scheduled operations, APDL combines your logbook with real-time legality, duty and rest tracking, payroll, and schedule importing in one app.
LEGALITY & DUTY
- Complete 14 CFR Part 117 coverage with up-to-the-minute legality calculations
- What-If legality calculations to see how changes affect you
- Color-coded legality and projected delay status
- Duty and rest charts with color-coded progress bars
- Latest Available Takeoff Time (LATT) using planned taxi-out, enroute, and taxi-in times
- Automatic duty adjustments based on your report/release settings
- Default rest facility support
- FAR 1.1 flight time and automatic night calculation
SCHEDULE IMPORT
- FREE schedule importer supporting 200+ airline formats with time zone support
- Direct Flight Crew View integration
- Safari share extension for quick importing
- Sync flights to the calendar of your choice
- Schedule and Calendar views for monthly duty review; tap to add duty
LOGGING & TRIP SHEET
- Familiar trip sheet format showing gates, turn times, aircraft changes, and projected delays
- Cloud data automatically fills in gates, aircraft, and OOOI times
- Gate and equipment change notifications
- CrossCheck validator flags incomplete or inaccurate entries
- Aircraft photos synced across devices
- Export flights on APDL.net for import into Logbook Pro
STATUS BOARD, WIDGETS & ALERTS
- Customizable Status Board with widgets for each duty phase, including LATT and EDCT
- Home Screen widgets, Dynamic Island, Live Activities, and CarPlay
- Alerts for legality changes, ready-to-fly status, and hotel van departures
COMMUTING & TRAVEL
- Advanced commute tools and deadhead flight search
- Tap a search result to view flight options in FlightAware
- Hotel management
- Leg resources for EDCT, airport diagrams, and more
WEATHER
- TAF, METAR, and decoded summaries
- Weather map with planned and actual overlays; tap endpoints for weather and FAA delay info
PAYROLL & REPORTS
- Detailed payroll tracking and calculator
- Pay period charts with trip and cumulative totals
- Payroll and summary views
- On-time performance reporting
- Exportable reports in the app and on APDL.net; use Handoff to open reports in your Mac browser
- Automatic résumé generation
DATA & SYNC
- Sync across all your devices with automatic online backup included
- Data organized by airline/employer, with archiving
- Extensive settings for complete customization
Share APDL with fellow crewmembers from the app menu.
Subscriptions do not auto-renew. Purchases are charged to your Apple Account. Subscription terms and pricing are available under My Account in the app.
Privacy Policy: https://nc-software.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://nc-software.com/tos
APDL is a registered trademark of NC Software, Inc.

This innovative app is a powerful face changer and aging app that allows you to see your potential future self with our advanced age filter.
FUTURE SELF FACE CHANGER AI 
Visualize how you will look as you age with future face. Our advanced AI face generator will provide you with a vivid image of yourself, realistic preview of how you might look in the years to come using the future self old age filter. Not only can you explore your future self, but our app also offers the ability to see yourself looking younger with the face old to young app. 
AI ART GENERATOR 
Create stunning art images with our AI art generator. If you love 3D drawings, this tool makes generating AI avatars easy and fun. 
Turn your photos into beautiful works of art with our high-quality AI art generator. If you want to create 3D cartoon image, vivid AI anime photos or customize your own avatar without restrictions, our tool will make it easy and fun. Explore endless creative possibilities with the ultimate AI art generator photo editor. 
AI SKETCH 
Sketch drawing photo editor in our app is designed to help your creative ideas come to life easily. By converting your photos into sketches, this tool adds a layer of artistic flair to your images, turning them into beautiful works of art. With each stroke, it brings life and adds depth with the AI sketch generator 
ENHANCE PICTURE 
Enhance your photos to Ultra HD quality with our high-quality image enhancer tool. Experience auto enhance photo quality that makes every detail stand out while ensuring your images look natural and vibrant. 
EFFECT SKY 
Elevate your photos with stunning photo editor effects by changing the sky. Our tool allows you to easily edit image background to create magical feel. With our advanced photo editor AI, you can enjoy seamless sky background change and explore a range of photo editor effects filters. 
REMOVE OBJECTS 
Effortlessly remove unwanted objects from photo and clean up your images with our intuitive tool. Featuring a powerful magic eraser photo function, our background eraser ensures a smooth editing experience and helps you get perfect photos. 
FACE SPOT REMOVER
Easily erase blemishes and imperfections for a smooth, radiant look. With our advanced photo face cleaner, your images will always showcase flawless skin in every shot.
REMOVE TEXT 
Effortlessly erase text from the image with our advanced tool. Enjoy a seamless editing experience with our intuitive photo editor. 
Join thousands of users who are already transforming their images and exploring their future selves with Future Self Face Aging Changer. Download now and start creating stunning photos and artworks with the power of AI. Whether you’re interested in seeing your future self, generating unique avatars, or enhancing your photos to Ultra HD, we’ve got you covered
SUBSCRIPTION TERM:
Users need to become our VIP members by paying a subscription fee to use all app’s outstanding features. You will have three days to explore all premium features for free or make an upfront payment for full access, with the option to cancel anytime during this period without any charge.
The subscription will automatically renew at the end of each subscription period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The subscription fee will be charged to the App Store account at confirmation of purchase.
Feel free to contact us if you have any questions; we are willing to help you as soon as possible.
Policy Link: https://sites.google.com/view/pp-future-self
EULA: https://sites.google.com/view/eula-future-self

bluejetty:00162224:ios.description:
------产品介绍------
界面财联社是中国新型的财经新闻与金融数据服务商，由上海报业集团主管主办，持有《互联网新闻信息服务许可证》。通过原创财经资讯和创新金融科技工具，为商务人群、投资机构和上市公司等提供新闻、数据、交易等服务。以“准确、快速、权威、专业”为新闻准则，为投资者提供专业的投资资讯。
财联社全球逾数百名记者编辑团队，持续关注4,000多家上市公司以及各个监管层动向。团队具有强大的投资资讯获取能力以及深度专业分析能力。
财联社不断发力布局金融科技领域，打造蓝鲸红岸风险挖掘系统、猫头鹰-智能信息检索系统、星矿智能数据平台、蓝鲸信鸽情报体系等一系列信息服务产品，致力于为投资者提供“媒体+资讯+数据+服务+交易”五位于一体的全方位金融服务。
电报
财联社主打核心功能——A股24小时电报。
财联社全面监控全球3000多家信息源，包括通讯社、政府网站、正规新闻机构、垂直媒体及自媒体，第一时间对信息进行监控、判断、整理、推送。
财联社对实时新闻进行智能抓取+专业人工筛选，确保了新闻发布的准确性和时效性。
要闻
作为宏观、产经、股市、公司、环球5大栏目的聚合，“要闻”频道是对电报内容的重要补充。电报追求时效性，要闻则追求确定性与深度。要闻频道通过对市场资讯的判断和梳理，清晰呈现市场新闻的重要层次，并对重大事件进行连续性、解释性宏观报道。要闻频道邀请全行业30万专家深度挖掘市场，一眼看穿市场陷阱，为投资者提供原创报道、深度解读、精华推荐和投资线索。
内参
涵盖有声早报、环球市场、涨停分析与预测、证监会发布以及新加入的互动平台等内容，内容上侧重对A股有一定影响的国内外宏观政策、资本市场政策及重大事件。内参将资料进行整理，并对股市新闻与数据精髓再加工，使其通俗易懂。
题材
题材专栏筛选出当前市场最热门的板块，第一时间捕捉市场题材性机会，并分析市场异动背后的原因；同时挖掘预判性题材，辅助短线投资者快速选股。
时间轴
时间轴专栏按时间排序，内容涵盖国内外高峰论坛、行业会议、交易展览、重大事件公告等。可供用户查阅近期重大事件，并对重要板块进行实时监控。
V说
V说专栏是连接用户和专业人士的互动交流平台。财联社汇聚业内知名的专业人士，通过V说平台分享新鲜事与个人观点，呈现给用户更全面的优质内容。
进阶付费服务
VIP
VIP专栏甄取券商研报精华、第一时间发布有价值的交易资讯，同时在每日盘前对当日可能的资金流向进行分析，辅助投资者建立每日交易计划。VIP专栏实时跟踪机构调研动向和企业公告内容，同时精选买卖双方及董高监观点，并结合技术面对个股进行深度分析。
名家
名家栏目汇聚众多顶级基金经理、机构分析师、投资大V 等业内专家，用视频课程形式讲解投资观念和投资模式，帮助投资者掌握系统化投资能力，提升投资者的风险意识和交易素养。

bluejetty:00174514:ios.name: Time’s Up! — Visual Timer
bluejetty:00174514:ios.summary:
Time’s Up! is a fun, visual timer that you’ll actually want to use. Whether it’s for you, your kids, or someone else, Time’s Up! will make counting down much more engaging.
Timers can be used at work and at home, whether you’re making sure
bluejetty:00174514:ios.description:
Time’s Up! is a fun, visual timer that you’ll actually want to use. Whether it’s for you, your kids, or someone else, Time’s Up! will make counting down much more engaging.
Timers can be used at work and at home, whether you’re making sure you take a break or telling kids it’s bedtime.  Timers exist everywhere, but none of them are fun and visually appealing — and that can be important when you’re dealing with kids big and small! Time’s Up! has the features you need to make time fun again — try it for free, NO ADS.
Time’s Up! isn’t just for kids and workaholics, though. The possibilities are endless:
• Adults who need to set timers to stop them from working for too long without a break.
• Kids who don’t want to do their homework but can be convinced to work in smaller chunks.
• Setting reading or other activity timers before bed time.
• Helping bigger kids focus on an activity for a set amount of time.
• Setting timers for exercises — put Time’s Up! on your TV screen using AirPlay and turn a timer into the focal point for your exercise group.
• Anything that’s based on a specific amount of time!
What makes a timer fun? Time’s Up! has 5 fun styles to choose from, including: 
• “Reveal” a photo from your Photo Library as the seconds tick down. 
• “Pixelate” makes a photo more clear as a timer gets closer to completion.
• “Puzzle” breaks a photo into jigsaw puzzle pieces and then puts the pieces into their places as time progresses.
Alternatively, there are more traditional clock faces if you just want a simple timer. Timers can be customized with their own alert sound and color, too.
Other key features include:
• Sync your timers between iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV using iCloud.
• See your timers on your Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, and Apple Watch with Live Activities (requires iOS 18).
• Guided Access to prevent kids from switching apps and changing timers, making sure only you have the power to control time.
• Airplay and tvOS support so you can put a timer up on a TV screen.
• Get audio updates each minute or countdown the last 10 seconds.
• On macOS, you can float the timer window above other apps so it’s always visible.
Time’s Up! is a free download with a trial limit of five countdowns. After that, there is a small one-time purchase that unlocks the app on all your devices, forever.
———————
What’s the difference between “Time’s Up! — Visual Timer” and “Time’s Up! Timer (VPP)”?
You are looking at the free-to-download version of Time’s Up! that lets you try the app five times before upgrading via in-app purchase. “Time’s Up! Timer (VPP)” is the same app but available paid-upfront with no limits in the app itself. “Time’s Up! Timer (VPP)” exists so educators can purchase the app through Apple’s Volume Purchase Program (VPP) for Education.
———————
Time’s Up! has no ads or data trackers. We believe your data is your own and we don’t collect any of it.

bluejetty:00028810:ios.description:
Pass your Accuplacer exam with flying colors using our Accuplacer Study App! Boost your confidence in passing first time with our mobile app and a personal study plan based on your current skill and requirements.
Accuplacer is a suite of computerized tests that determines your knowledge in math, reading and writing as you prepare to enroll in college-level courses. The results of the assessment, in conjunction with your academic background, goals and interests, are used by academic advisors and counselors to place you into a college course that meets your skill level.
Accuplacer Study App includes complete practice tests for various categories:
- Writing
- Reading
- Math
Accuplacer Study App's key features:
- Choose from different exams
- Practice with 550+ questions written by expert tutors
- Track your strengths and weaknesses within Stats section of the app
- Study detailed statistics of every test you take
- Compare your score to the community average for almost any type of exam
- - - -
Accuplacer Study App's purchases, subscriptions and terms
You need to buy a lifetime access or subscribe to get access to all features, courses and questions. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions are auto-renewable and are billed at the rate and period selected depending on the subscription plan. Users’ accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of use: https://mastrapi.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://mastrapi.com/policy

bluejetty:00063349:ios.description:
From the heart of the mystical realm to the world, Faladdin is your personal in-pocket fortune teller.
With over 25 million users, 5 million active users worldwide, and 1 million readings every day, Faladdin is taking the astrology world by storm! We combine in-depth ancient knowledge, with the motivation of constantly enlightening our users about their past, present, and future, to bring you incredibly unerring tarot card readings, horoscopes, and many more eye-opening in-app features such as Psychic Reading, Coffee Fortune Ritual, even your own Genie in a lamp!
Check out our features & why our users love Faladdin so much:
► DAILY HOROSCOPE
We present your daily horoscope through your zodiac sign and boundless insights of the stars. You can illuminate your experiences throughout life and recognize how the planet’s movements can trigger life-changing transformations. Taking into consideration the positions of the Sun, Moon, planets, astrological aspects, and sensitive angles at the time of an event, Faladdin provides you with great advice concerning your relationship, love, and compatibility with your partner, and use your astrology chart to do so.
► LIVE CHAT
Discover the future with Live Chat Fortune Telling! Chat with Faladdin the Visionary Reader, Cassandra the Astrologer Supreme, or the Genie! Ask about your dreams, daily horoscopes, and what the future holds, and get instant responses. Enjoy personalized readings and uncover the secrets of the universe through interactive chat sessions. Dive into astrology, tarot cards, dream interpretations, and palm readings—all in real-time.
► THE GENIE OF THE LAMP
Rub your lamp and let loose your genie! This incredible The Oracle feature provides you with your very own psychic fortune teller. Apart from cracking jokes and telling you outright common facts, your psychic genie can predict your future and provide a sense of comfort for your past.
► TAROT CARDS
Tarot & Astrology, two tools working from the same energy source in perfect harmony that can't be denied. We provide you with tarot card readings that are sure to be a beautiful and mystical experience, helping you to better understand your unique journey in this world. You can even choose your subjects of readings such as under the love, career, money or general title.
► PSYCHIC READING
All of the questions you’re longing to find answers to are now just a Psychic Reading away. Wondering when you’ll be in a happy relationship and find love? Where your career is heading, or what opportunities are around the corner? Select any of the Psychic Reading subjects and let Faladdin enlighten you.
► COFFEE FORTUNE RITUAL
What do the shapes in your coffee cup tell you? Coffee Fortune Ritual — an ancient art of fortune-telling. Interpreting patterns made by coffee grounds left in the cup, it is a fun and insightful way to understand yourself.
► DREAM INTERPRETATION
Faladdin's latest charm! Now featuring Dream Interpretation — your guide to understanding the hidden meanings and messages in your dreams.
► PALM READING
Simply scan your palm using the app, and unlock a world of insights into your life's journey. Explore the intricate patterns of your hand lines and uncover their hidden meanings. Experience the magic of palmistry today with Faladdin!
Faladdin is far beyond just any ordinary zodiac astrology app. It has the ability to help people understand and make complex choices in their lives, understand compatibility in romantic relationships, and most importantly; it gives you guidance along with awareness tools to enhance the power that you have within yourselves.
We’re so grateful to be a part of your journey.
For Privacy Policy & Terms of Use: https://www.faladdin.com/terms-and-conditions 
EULA: https://www.faladdin.com/eula

bluejetty:00134687:ios.description:
Bilt helps you transform your largest monthly expense—rent—into valuable rewards and unlock exclusive Neighborhood Benefits™. With Bilt, you can earn points on rent payments, build credit history, and unlock a world of rewards from travel to everyday redemptions.
EARN REWARDS ON RENT 
Earn rewards on your largest monthly expense–rent. With every on-time rent payment, you'll earn Bilt Points – the industry's most valuable and flexible points currency. Plus, build credit history by automatically reporting your rent payments to all three major credit bureaus for free.
ACCESS NEIGHBORHOOD BENEFITS™ 
Get even more at your favorite spots with exclusive Neighborhood Benefits™ at local restaurants, fitness studios, pharmacies, on Lyft rides, and more. Use any linked card with our neighborhood partners to stack Bilt Points, in addition to your usual card rewards. Unlock member benefits including complimentary items, member events, and more.
REDEEM YOUR REWARDS 
Transfer your points 1:1 to your favorite airline miles and hotel points, use them for future rent payments, redeem for everyday purchases, or save them for a down payment on a home. Bilt offers the industry's most flexible and valuable redemption options.
RENT DAY® REWARDS
On the 1st of each month, we drop limited-time member benefits like unparalleled transfer bonuses, unique neighborhood dining experiences, a chance to win free rent through our Rent Free™ game, and more.
Earn Points on Rent Payments:
- Earn points on rent at any home, no matter where you live
- Free credit building by reporting rent payments to all credit bureaus
- No transaction fees on rent payments
Unlock Neighborhood Benefits™:
- Dining: Earn points and enjoy complimentary items at 20,000+ local restaurants
- Fitness: Get complimentary add-ons at partner fitness studios like Barry's, SoulCycle, and more
- Pharmacy: Apply automatic HSA/FSA savings at Walgreens
- Lyft rides: Earn extra points on Lyft rides around your neighborhood
Redeem the most flexible points:
- Travel: Transfer points 1:1 to major airlines and hotels including United, American, Hyatt, and more, or use them in the Bilt Travel Portal
- Rent: Use points towards future rent payments
- Everyday Rewards: Redeem for Amazon purchases, gift cards, and more
- Buy a Home: Save points for a down payment on a future home
Earn Elite Status:
- Earn status through points or eligible spend
- Unlock increasingly valuable benefits across travel and everyday rewards
- Customize your experience with Milestone Rewards at 25,000-point intervals
Join over 4 million members who are transforming their largest monthly expense into their most rewarding one. Download the app today and start earning rewards on rent, in your neighborhood, and beyond.

bluejetty:00164824:ios.description:
► Who’s that suave handsome stranger in the suit?
Action’s his middle name. Actually, it’s his only name, and he’s the all-action star of this all-action shooter. Landing right in the heat of the action on his heli-umbrella, Agent Action’s a sharply dressed sharp-shooting spy with a license to do some absolute carnage and an awesome range of ballistic weapons. 
Race through exotic locations, chase down the bad guys on land and water, and bring down colorful supervillains in epic boss battles, all with dash of old Hollywood style.
► A fast-paced shooter with smooth retro stylings!
• Ready, aim, fire! Agent Action offers bite-size chunks of adrenaline in multiple action-packed levels of shooting mayhem. Dive straight into the action, pick a target and let rip against an endless stream of bad guys. 
• Hold to shoot! Neat game mechanics make Agent Action easy to play but endlessly entertaining, with enough tactical challenges in weapon selection, targeting and fire-rate to keep more experienced players engaged. Between levels, you’ll have the choice between health boosters, armor or more awesome firepower, and your choice could be the difference between victory and death.
• Classic spy-caper style! The game’s slick graphics and funky soundtrack recall a host of classic spy movies, as you blast your way across deserts and the decks of cargo ships, along railway platforms, through train carriages, and into the high-tech lairs of supervillains, all while retaining the ineffable cool of an international man of mystery. 
• Follow that boat! Car chases, boat chases, and a series of heavily-armed bosses keep Agent Action on his toes and ensure plenty of variation in the game.
• Nice arsenal! Complete levels to gain dozens of perks in the form of shotguns, sniper rifles, SMGs, RPGs and all the other deadly initials, as well as a host of pyrotechnical explosives that open up a variety of new gameplay options. You can also customize them to your own personal playing style.
• Make friends on your travels! Every action hero needs sidekicks, and Agent Action has an address book full of useful contacts. Get cash for completing levels and use it to unlock these colorful playable characters, all paying tribute to classic Hollywood heroes and heroines.
► A world of action at your fingertips!
Easy to play but as gripping as any classic spy movie, Agent Action’s a game that brings big-screen thrills right to your phone. Indulge your inner international man of mystery, download Agent Action now and start saving the world one dead villain at a time.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00044332:ios.description:
Morrow, the Global Phenomenon, started with Disrupting Divorce and Flipping Divorce Statistics with The “NEW” Marriage as the “NEW” Man and Woman.
Becoming the man, husband, father, mother, wife, woman and leader in life you were born to be and knock the wall down between you and your spouse.
Cass & Kathryn Morrow, authors of Disrupting Divorce: The New Man, Saving Struggling, Sexless And Toxic Marriages & Behind The White Picket Fence, delivers an in-app experience to connect and unite like-minded men & women from around the world.
You Are Not Alone.
Now, join as thousands of men and women work together to change the world. Finding and fulfilling their true purpose—because they know who they are.
Beyond your spouse, children and your job…
The world you leave behind, matters.
People come to Morrow to save their marriage.
But in the legacy they create, their NEW marriage is the byproduct.
Go Get Your Life.
INFORMATION ABOUT THE APP AND PURCHASE OPTIONS
Payment will be charged to your credit card through your Apple account. A subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. There is no increase in price when renewing. One Time Payments will only be charged one time initially.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings in your Apple ID after purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Read our full terms of service and our privacy policy: https://morrowmarriage.com/privacy
