bluejetty:00022698:ios.description:
Calories Counter:
Reach the weight goal you have, keep track of the food and beverages you take every day, set your personal goals to be as fit as you want, and boost your health in an intuitive yet powerful way, with the list of amazing tools Calories Counter brings directly to the palm of your hand.
• Select the food you take at any time of the day, and see the nutrition facts of each of them right in your screen, and keep informed about how healthy you are eating.
• Select any of the predefined meals from the app, or include anything you are eating, and keep track of the calories you are consuming in every mealtime.
• Look for the calories that specific products have by just scanning their barcodes with just a click on the screen.
• Eat healthier and see results in your body much faster with our in-app healthy menu for you to start eating better while enjoying those delicious ingredients you love.
• Keep track of your physical activity and burn those extra calories you took in your plate, with a large list of exercises and routines to get better results in less time.
• Keep yourself hydrated with our in-app water intake tracker.
• Set personal goals and reach your ideal weight faster with a completely personal and customizable tab for you to see your changes and keep track of your improvements.
Eat healthier, get the results you have always dreamed about, keep an eye on your food and drinks, start exercising properly and discover all the benefits a good food intake brings to your daily life with this easy-to-use, friendly, and useful way of changing your lifestyle.
Calorie Counter Subscription options:  
1. Title of publication or service: Calorie Counter.
2. Length of subscription & Price of subscription, and price per unit if appropriate:
- Monthly (First 3 day free trial) 
3. Price of subscription: 
- 3 day free trial then $9.99 per month
- 3 day free trial then $49.99 per year
4. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase  
5. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can turn of the auto-renew subscription from iPhone setting 
6. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
7. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. 
8. Privacy Policy: 
https://giantbrainsllc.wordpress.com/privacy-policy/ 
9. Terms of use:
https://giantbrainsllc.wordpress.com/terms-of-use/
10. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication where applicable
 11. Calorie Counter adds new features above and are available through an auto-renewing subscription. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of your current subscription, and you can cancel anytime a subscription during the active period. You can manage your subscription, either by viewing your account in iTunes from your Mac or PC, or Account Settings on your device after purchase.

bluejetty:00126668:ios.description:
MON MAGASIN U : PROMOTIONS, CARTE U ET ÉCONOMIES SUR VOS ACHATS DU QUOTIDIEN
Avec Mon Magasin U, l’application officielle des magasins U, accédez en un instant à votre Super U, Hyper U ou U Express depuis votre smartphone : promotions, cagnotte Carte U, catalogues, coupons et services en ligne. Tout est réuni pour simplifier vos achats et maîtriser votre budget au quotidien.
Une application pensée pour vous faire gagner du temps et réaliser des économies à chaque passage en caisse. 
Chez U, nous privilégions des produits de qualité, accessibles et issus de producteurs locaux, pour vous permettre de consommer mieux, à prix bas. 
C’est ça, être commerçants autrement. 
PROMOTIONS, COUPONS, CATALOGUES ET JEUX : TOUS VOS AVANTAGES AU MÊME ENDROIT
Grâce à Mon Magasin U, consultez à tout moment : 
- Les promotions et bons plans en cours dans votre magasin U
- Les offres spéciales et opérations locales de votre Super U, Hyper U ou U Express
- Le montant de votre cagnotte en € Carte U et le détail de vos économies sur vos achats
- Vos coupons personnalisés et défis fidélité pour cumuler encore plus d’avantages
- Les jeux et concours en cours pour tenter de gagner des € Carte U, des bons d’achat ou des cadeaux
Chaque mois, profitez de 20 % de réduction reversés sur votre Carte U sur une sélection de produits du quotidien : fruits et légumes, produits frais, boissons, épicerie, entretien, charcuterie…
Retrouvez votre Carte U directement dans l’application et présentez-la en caisse depuis votre téléphone, même sans connexion internet. Activez vos coupons et ne passez plus jamais à côté d’un bon plan dans votre magasin U !
ESPACE CLIENT : VOTRE COMPTE U ET VOS SERVICES EN LIGNE
Votre Compte U est commun aux applications Mon Magasin U et Courses U : un seul identifiant pour accéder à tous vos services U, en magasin comme en ligne. 
Depuis votre espace client personnel, gérez facilement : 
- Vos données personnelles et préférences de communication
- Vos commandes en ligne et l’historique de vos achats en magasin
- Vos tickets de caisse dématérialisés, accessibles à tout moment depuis votre mobile
Grâce à la géolocalisation intégrée, trouvez rapidement les coordonnées, horaires d’ouverture et services de votre magasin U ou de la station-service U la plus proche. 
Un espace sécurisé pour gérer votre compte, suivre vos avantages fidélité et centraliser tous vos services U.
BESOIN DE FAIRE VOS COURSES EN LIGNE ? DÉCOUVREZ L’APPLI COURSES U
Mon Magasin U et Courses U forment deux applications complémentaires pour profiter pleinement de tous les services des magasins U : 
- Mon Magasin U : suivez les promotions, gérez votre cagnotte Carte U et accédez aux services de votre magasin
- Courses U : commandez en ligne et choisissez votre mode de retrait, drive voiture, retrait piéton ou livraison à domicile
Depuis Mon Magasin U, accédez directement à Courses U via le lien de téléchargement intégré et profitez d’une expérience fluide, du bon plan à la livraison.
MON MAGASIN U : VOTRE BUDGET MAÎTRISÉ, VOS AVANTAGES MAXIMISÉS
Mon Magasin U vous accompagne au quotidien pour ne jamais rater une promo et optimiser chaque achat en magasin. 
- Consultez les promotions et catalogues de votre magasin en temps réel
- Suivez et utilisez votre cagnotte Carte U pour contrôler vos dépenses à chaque visite
- Activez vos coupons personnalisés et profitez d’avantages fidélité exclusifs
- Localisez votre magasin U le plus proche, consultez ses horaires et ses services en un clic
- Participez aux jeux, concours et opérations spéciales pour gagner encore plus d’avantages
Téléchargez Mon Magasin U et faites de chaque visite en magasin une opportunité d’économiser. 
Une suggestion ou une remarque ? Contactez-nous : admin@magasins-u.com 
Application compatible à partir d'iOS 16.6

bluejetty:00167574:ios.description:
Waazy: Your AI Music Maker & AI Song Generator & AI Music Video Creator!
Turn your words, images, and ideas into songs and AI music videos in seconds with Waazy AI Music Generator. Whether you want to generate an original AI Song from a simple prompt, craft AI Cover Music with unique voices, remix a track in a new style, or turn your songs into cinematic music videos, Waazy makes it possible. From Text to Song to AI Music Video production, our advanced AI Song Maker and AI Music Video Generator tools are designed for every creator.
Text to AI Music
No music experience? No problem! Just describe your idea, and Waazy’s powerful AI engine generates a complete AI song—lyrics, melody, and vocals. Your next anthem is just a few words away!
Image to AI Music
Upload one image and Waazy will turn the visual mood into a complete AI song with lyrics, melody, and vocals. Create music from a memory, a pet, a trip, a birthday moment, or someone special in just one tap.
AI Music Video Generator
Elevate your sound with our AI Music Video Generator. Turn songs into cinematic music videos, stylized animations, and social-ready visual stories. Waazy’s AI visual engine creates videos that match your rhythm, mood, and music style.
Photo to AI Lip Sync MV
Upload a photo and become the star of your own AI music video. Waazy turns the face in your image into a singing MV character, matching lip movement with your song. Create fun AI lip sync videos, personalized music gifts, and social-ready clips in just a few taps.
Create Your Own AI Cover Song
Turn any song into a unique AI Cover with one tap. Choose a track, select a voice, or create a custom voice style, then generate a brand-new AI cover in seconds. Whether you’re recreating a love song in a different voice or making a personal cover for someone special, Waazy’s AI Cover Song Maker makes it easy.
AI Remix
Upload a song and let Waazy reimagine it in a new way. Using the original audio as inspiration, Waazy can create a fresh AI remix with a different melody, vocal tone, lyrics, or music style.
Custom Voice Styles
Create covers with more personality by choosing different voice styles or building a custom sound for your song.
Next-Level Songcraft with AI
Already have lyrics or a message from the heart? Waazy’s AI Song Generator helps refine your ideas. Customize genre, emotion, tempo, and vocal style, and let AI bring your vision to life. Perfect for Valentine’s Day surprises, anniversaries, or meaningful moments.
Endless Inspiration
Discover AI-generated tracks, music styles, and continuously updated music video templates. Remix ideas, explore new visuals, and create songs and MVs that feel uniquely yours with Waazy AI Music Generator & AI Song Maker.
Discover Your Music Wrap & Wrapped Experience
Explore personalized AI-created tracks inspired by your moods, memories, and favorite sounds.
Multilingual AI Music Generation
Generate AI songs in English, German, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Indonesian, Turkish, Dutch, Chinese, and more — perfect for expressing love across cultures.
Effortless Listening, Sharing, and Commercial Use
Enjoy smooth playback with synced scrolling lyrics. Share your creations as links, music files, or lyric videos, and use eligible AI songs commercially under the user agreement. Waazy can also provide a creation proof statement for record purposes only, not as a copyright or legal guarantee.
Advanced Audio Editing Tools
Beyond AI music creation, Waazy offers powerful audio tools: record audio, convert speech to text, extract audio from videos, split and merge tracks, and add background music — everything you need to polish your sound.
Ready to turn your thoughts into sound? Download Waazy AI Music Generator and start creating today!

Pocket Big Brother is a fan companion for following Big Brother without bouncing between feeds.
Spoilers are part of the experience. Use PocketBB to track the latest notes, timeline entries, news, media, podcasts, Reddit conversation, Bluesky chatter, and houseguest status when season data is available.

- A combined Timeline for notes, social posts, media, and source updates
- Cast and houseguest status cards that handle preseason TBD/Pending data cleanly
- News, blogs, podcasts, Reddit, and Bluesky links in one place
- Apple Watch companion views for quick updates
- Ad-free subscription options
Pocket Big Brother is an independent fan app and is not affiliated with CBS, Paramount, or the Big Brother television production.

يسر البنك السعودي للاستثمار تقديم "التطبيق المدمج للهواتف الذكية" والذي يمكنك من الوصول إلى مجموعة كاملة من الخدمات المصرفية الإلكترونية.
اذا لم تكن عميلا للبنك السعودي للإستثمار، بامكانك تحميل التطبيق و الاستفادة من مجموعة من الوظائف و العمليات الاضافية.

خدمات التطبيق لعملاء البنك السعودي للاستثمار:
- الدخول لخدمة الانترنت البنكيه نسخة الأجهزة الذكية (فلكس تاتش) اينما كنت: الدخول لهذه الخدمة يكون عبر إستخدام اسم المستخدم و كلمة المرور الخاصة بخدمة الانترنت البنكية. بامكانك تنفيذ جميع العمليات البنكيه فوراً. و في حال لم تكن مسجلا بامكانك اتباع الخطوات الموضحة بعد الضغط على أيقونة الدخول.


دعم اللغتين: العربية و الإنجليزية.
----------------

The Saudi Investment Bank (SAIB) is pleased to introduce its new hybrid application that allows you to access the entire range of Internet Banking services via your smart device.
Furthermore non SAIB customers can install this application and benefit its additional functionalities.

SAIB customers’ application services:
- Login to your online mobile banking (FLEXX TOUCH): You can login via your existing online banking user credentials. You can perform any banking operation or transaction instantaneously. However, if you are not already registered, you can simply follow the steps on the registration page.



Languages: Arabic and English

bluejetty:00100784:ios.name: Little Stories: Bedtime Books
bluejetty:00100784:ios.summary: Little Stories is a collection of books where your child is the main character. Our authors and illustrators don’t use generative AI, meaning every story is thoughtfully created to help your child fall in love with reading. Enter your child
bluejetty:00100784:ios.description:
Little Stories is a collection of books where your child is the main character. Our authors and illustrators don’t use generative AI, meaning every story is thoughtfully created to help your child fall in love with reading. Enter your child’s name and gender in the settings to enjoy personalized stories starring your son or daughter.
To make things even better, we've added beautiful soundtracks and detailed illustrations to accompany each story and help you raise your child in a positive environment. You can also make your own audiobooks! Take a few minutes to record yourself and your child will be able to listen to a charming audiobook in your voice!
If you like fairy tales, bed time stories for kids, or children’s books, then “Little Stories” is a great option for you! Let love and kindness fill your family’s leisure time!
Why Little Stories?
• 4500+ illustrations
• Illustrations will match your child’s gender
• 90+ exciting stories, and many more to come
• Enchanting music accompanying each story
• Create audiobooks by recording your voice!
We’d like to tell you a bit more about the process we use to create personalized stories for kids so that you have a better idea of the hard work we put into “Little Stories”.
1) We search for an author. Regardless of the writer’s nationality or language, we look for unique and captivating short stories. Our main condition is that each bedtime story contains at most 50 scenes and is educational. Author’s bedtime story must be interesting for both – parents and kindergarteners. And the story shouldn’t contain more than 800 words, because it’s important to read short stories before bedtime.
2) Then we create the storyboard. It consists of rough sketches that serve as the template for the finalized drawings in the storybook, helping us decide how it will look.
3) Once the storyboard has been approved by our team, we search for an illustrator. We take great pride in matching each artist with a story that suits their style. Personal touches make our bedtime stories for kids come to life!
4) At the same time, our composer begins creating the soundtrack for the story. Inspired by the theme of the tale, he designs a gentle melody that will transport your child to relaxation and sleep (maybe you too).
5) At the same time we are looking for a professional narrator. We want to be sure our app could read aloud books for kindergarten kids. Currently you can listen to our audio books in three languages: English, Spanish and Russian. But don’t forget that we support 14 languages total.
6) After the story is finished, we translate it so that the children of the world can enjoy it in their language.
7) The story is then published in our library of books for kids.
The entire process might take anywhere from two to nine months. We take great care to provide an amazing experience. We also provide 4 free books that you can read to your baby anytime.
We are always looking for the highest quality content because we want to create the best bedtime stories for reading. 
We constantly add new children's stories to our collection! 
Our books are good for kids 3 to 6 year olds.
Follow us on social media: @diveomedia

Features
Remove Object: Tap or bru
bluejetty:00082404:ios.description:
Remove objects & people from photos easily with this ai retouch app. Erase backgrounds of a photo and save as transparent with just one tap. Fix your blemishes also with advanced one-tap-retouch feature. 
Features
Remove Object: Tap or brush away tourists, wires, or stains. Quick Mode erases with AI; Brush & Lasso gives precise control.
Clone Stamp: Sample any clean patch and paint over distractions. Edge-aware blending matches texture, light, and perspective.
AI Retouch: One swipe zaps blemishes, smooths skin, sharpens eyes, adds a natural glow, and whitens teeth while preserving pores.
Replace Background: Auto-cut subjects and drop them onto built-in scenes, your own images, or transparent PNGs for pro-grade product shots.
Background Blur: Pop subjects with DSLR-style depth—Gaussian, Motion, Bokeh, Hexagon, Disc, and more—and adjust focus and strength in real time.
Photo Overlay & Double Exposure: Layer textures, designer frames, or a second image, then fine-tune opacity and blend modes for instant magazine vibes.
Stylish Portrait: Soft-focus backgrounds, polish facial details, and apply studio color toning for a cover-ready finish.
Sky Changer: Auto-detect the horizon and swap gray skies for golden sunsets, auroras, or storm clouds with natural color matching and crisp edges.
Photo Blending: AI isolates your subject and fuses it with artistic overlays; refine with manual brush and eraser for cinematic double exposures.
Dripping Portrait: Melt edges into flowing paint drips; pick preset shapes or draw your own, then adjust length, direction, and gradients.
Spiral Effects: Wrap subjects in neon coils, glitter ribbons, or dotted trails. Tweak thickness, color, and rotation for instant 3-D pop.
This app includes advertisement. To enjoy ad free experience and using all premium contents, we are offering a Premium subscription package.
Retouch Premium Subscription information
• Subscription Length: Weekly, Monthly.
• Your payment will be charged to your Apple account as soon as you confirm your purchase.
• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase.
• Your subscription will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• The cost of renewal will be charged to your account 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.

bluejetty:00121086:ios.name: Kakuro: Number Crossword
bluejetty:00121086:ios.summary: Fill empty squares so each block sums up to the number on its left or on its top. Each puzzle consists of a blank grid with sum-clues in various places. The object is to fill all empty squares using numbers 1 to 9 so the sum of each horizon
bluejetty:00121086:ios.description:
Fill empty squares so each block sums up to the number on its left or on its top. Each puzzle consists of a blank grid with sum-clues in various places. The object is to fill all empty squares using numbers 1 to 9 so the sum of each horizontal block equals the clue on its left, and the sum of each vertical block equals the clue on its top. In addition, no number may be used in the same block more than once.
Kakuro are addictive logic puzzles best described as number-crosswords. Using pure logic and simple add/subtract calculations, these fascinating puzzles offer endless fun and intellectual entertainment to puzzle fans of all skills and ages.
The game includes zoom for easier solving of large puzzles, as well as helpful features such as showing possible sum combinations in a block, showing the sum remainder of a block, and using pencilmarks to make temporary placement of numbers in the grid.
To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.
For more fun, Kakuro contains no ads and includes a Weekly Bonus section providing an extra free puzzle each week.
PUZZLE FEATURES
• 200 free Kakuro puzzle samples
• Extra bonus puzzle published free each week
• Multiple difficulty levels from very easy to extremely hard
• Grid sizes up to 22x22
• Also includes 5-grid Samurai Kakuro
• Puzzle library continuously updates with new content
• Manually selected, top quality puzzles
• Unique solution for each puzzle
• Hours of intellectual challenge and fun
• Sharpens logic and improves cognitive skills
GAMING FEATURES
• No ads
• Unlimited check puzzle
• Unlimited hints
• Show errors during gameplay
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Pencilmarks feature for solving hard puzzles
• Autofill pencilmarks mode
• Show Sum Combinations feature
• Show Sum Remainder feature
• Concurrently playing and saving multiple puzzles
• Puzzle filtering, sorting and archiving options
• Dark Mode support
• Graphic previews showing puzzles progress as they are being solved
• Enlarge, reduce, move puzzle for easy viewing
• Portrait and landscape screen support (iPad only)
• Track puzzle solving times
• Backup & restore puzzle progress to iCloud
ABOUT
Kakuro have also become popular under other names such as Kakkuro, Cross Sums and Tashizan Cross. Similar to Sudoku, Hashi and Slitherlink, the puzzles are solved using logic alone. All puzzles in this app are produced by Conceptis Ltd. - the leading supplier of logic puzzles to printed and electronic gaming media all over the world. On average, more than 20 million Conceptis puzzles are solved each day in newspapers, magazines, books and online as well as on smartphones and tablets across the world.

Privacy Policy: https://www.conceptispuzzles.com/index.aspx?uri=info/doc/220

bluejetty:00094729:ios.summary: Are you ready for a brand-new adventure in tile games? Look no further than Tile Vacation – the ultimate tile match and tile puzzle experience for fans of matching games! Download now and dive into endless puzzle fun, relaxing match challen
bluejetty:00094729:ios.description:
Are you ready for a brand-new adventure in tile games? Look no further than Tile Vacation – the ultimate tile match and tile puzzle experience for fans of matching games! Download now and dive into endless puzzle fun, relaxing match challenges, and brain-teasing excitement.
With over 10,000 levels, Tile Vacation offers a perfect balance of puzzle challenge and relaxation for players of all skill levels. Solve puzzles, match tiles, and master the classic tile match gameplay, now with modern twists and creative layouts. Every Tile Vacation level is designed to make each puzzle feel clear, satisfying, and fun to match.
Tile Vacation features include:
Over 10,000 tile puzzle game levels with increasing difficulty, providing hours of immersive gameplay.
Solve challenging puzzles and match tiles in creative and fun ways.
Explore a variety of beautiful locations and unlock new backgrounds as you progress through your Tile Vacation journey.
Classic tile match gameplay with a modern twist, offering both relaxing puzzle moments and brain-training match experiences.
A wide variety of adorable tiles including fruits, cakes, animals, and more.
Powerful boosters and helpful tips to help you conquer the toughest puzzle levels and complete every match goal.
Tile Vacation combines the best of tile games, tile puzzle games, and matching games, delivering a creative, fun, and engaging experience. Thousands of puzzle layouts, undo options, and boosters ensure endless entertainment. Whether you want a quick match break or a longer Tile Vacation puzzle session, every level gives you a fresh way to match tiles and relax your mind.
Enjoy the simple rules of Tile Vacation: look carefully, match three identical tiles, clear the board, and solve each puzzle at your own pace. The tile match controls are easy to learn, while the puzzle layouts become more interesting as you progress. Tile Vacation is perfect for players who love a relaxing match game, a clever puzzle challenge, and a colorful tile journey.
Play Tile Vacation on mobile and tablet devices, online or offline, anytime, anywhere. Start a puzzle level during a short break, enjoy a match challenge while relaxing, or continue your Tile Vacation adventure whenever you want. Each tile puzzle is built for smooth play, satisfying match feedback, and a calm but rewarding sense of progress.
If you enjoy puzzle games, match games, tile games, and relaxing brain games, Tile Vacation is made for you. Discover new puzzle boards, match cute tiles, collect progress, and enjoy a beautiful Tile Vacation world full of color and charm. From the first tile match to the hardest puzzle stage, Tile Vacation keeps the gameplay simple, polished, and rewarding.
Get ready to embark on an unforgettable Tile Vacation journey – hours of challenging tile puzzle games, relaxing puzzle levels, and fun match moments await!
Contact & More Info
Exciting new features will be added to Tile Vacation in the coming months. Share your ideas and let us know what you want to see in the game!

bluejetty:00021356:ios.description:
הספרים שאתם אוהבים, תמיד איתכם!
קונים בחנות עברית וקוראים או מאזינים באפליקציה - בבית, בדרך ובכל מקום.
באפליקציה מחכים לכם 4 ספרים דיגיטליים וספר קולי אחד, מתנה מאיתנו.
עברית היא החנות הדיגיטלית הגדולה ביותר לספרי קריאה ושמע בעברית. מאות אלפי קוראים כבר נהנים לקרוא ולהאזין ליותר ספרים.
באתר שלנו (e-vrit.co.il) תמצאו רבי מכר עכשוויים לצד קלאסיקות אהובות, ספרי עיון לצד שפע של פרוזה ורומנטיקה מקורית ומתורגמת, וסופרים עצמאים לצד מיטב ההוצאות לאור בישראל.
באפליקציה תוכלו לקרוא ולהאזין לספרים שרכשתם בחנות, ולנצל כל רגע פנוי בבית, בחופשה, בבית קפה או ברכבת - לספרים שיעשו לכם טוב.
הספרים שלכם, בכל מכשיר ובכל מקום
- גיבוי בטוח, חינמי וללא הגבלת זמן לכל הספרים שלכם
- סנכרון התקדמות הקריאה וההאזנה בין המכשירים שלכם
- הורדת ספרים למכשיר לקריאה ולהאזנה גם ללא חיבור לאינטרנט - בטיסה, בחופשה או חלילה בממ"ד
- קריאה והאזנה בעד 5 מכשירים באותו חשבון
קריאה בדיוק כמו שנוח לכם
- הגדלה והקטנה של הטקסט והחלפת הגופן
- חזרה בדיוק למקום שבו הפסקתם בספר, גם ממכשיר אחר
- קריאה בדפדוף או בגלילה מלמעלה למטה — ואפילו בגלילה אוטומטית
- תצוגת אורך או רוחב, כולל אפשרות לקריאה בשני טורים
- מצב לילה לקריאה בחושך ומצב ספיה לקריאה נוחה בחדר מואר
האזנה בדיוק בקצב שלכם
- חזרה בדיוק למקום שבו הפסקתם להאזין, גם ממכשיר אחר
- שינוי מהירות ההשמעה לקצב שנוח לכם
- אפקט "קול־נע" שנועד לעזור לכם להתרכז בהאזנה
כלים נהדרים שלא תמצאו בספר מודפס
- ניווט מהיר בין עמודים ופרקים באמצעות תוכן עניינים מובנה
- חיפוש שמות, מילים וביטויים בתוך הספר
- חיפוש מהיר בגוגל ובוויקיפדיה ותרגום מילים וביטויים
- הוספת מחשבות והערות לצד הטקסט
- הוספת כמה סימניות שתרצו לעמודים שחשוב לכם לשמור
- הדגשת ציטוטים במספר צבעים
- ריכוז כל המחשבות, הסימניות וההדגשות במקום אחד
קוראים יותר, ועוקבים אחרי ההתקדמות

listings.name: עברית
listings.description:
הספרים שאתם אוהבים, תמיד איתכם!
קונים בחנות עברית וקוראים או מאזינים באפליקציה - בבית, בדרך ובכל מקום.
באפליקציה מחכים לכם 4 ספרים דיגיטליים וספר קולי אחד, מתנה מאיתנו.

עברית היא החנות הדיגיטלית הגדולה ביותר לספרי קריאה ושמע בעברית. מאות אלפי קוראים כבר נהנים לקרוא ולהאזין ליותר ספרים.
באתר שלנו (e-vrit.co.il) תמצאו רבי מכר עכשוויים לצד קלאסיקות אהובות, ספרי עיון לצד שפע של פרוזה ורומנטיקה מקורית ומתורגמת, וסופרים עצמאים לצד מיטב ההוצאות לאור בישראל.
באפליקציה תוכלו לקרוא ולהאזין לספרים שרכשתם בחנות, ולנצל כל רגע פנוי בבית, בחופשה, בבית קפה או ברכבת - לספרים שיעשו לכם טוב.

הספרים שלכם, בכל מכשיר ובכל מקום

- גיבוי בטוח, חינמי וללא הגבלת זמן לכל הספרים שלכם
- סנכרון התקדמות הקריאה וההאזנה בין המכשירים שלכם
- הורדת ספרים למכשיר לקריאה ולהאזנה גם ללא חיבור לאינטרנט - בטיסה, בחופשה או חלילה בממ"ד
- קריאה והאזנה בעד 5 מכשירים באותו חשבון

קריאה בדיוק כמו שנוח לכם

- הגדלה והקטנה של הטקסט והחלפת הגופן
- חזרה בדיוק למקום שבו הפסקתם בספר, גם ממכשיר אחר
- קריאה בדפדוף או בגלילה מלמעלה למטה — ואפילו בגלילה אוטומטית
- תצוגת אורך או רוחב, כולל אפשרות לקריאה בשני טורים
- מצב לילה לקריאה בחושך ומצב ספיה לקריאה נוחה בחדר מואר

האזנה בדיוק בקצב שלכם

- חזרה בדיוק למקום שבו הפסקתם להאזין, גם ממכשיר אחר
- שינוי מהירות ההשמעה לקצב שנוח לכם
- אפקט "קול־נע" שנועד לעזור לכם להתרכז בהאזנה

- ניווט מהיר בין עמודים ופרקים באמצעות תוכן עניינים מובנה
- חיפוש שמות, מילים וביטויים בתוך הספר
- חיפוש מהיר בגוגל ובוויקיפדיה ותרגום מילים וביטויים
- הוספת מחשבות והערות לצד הטקסט
- הוספת כמה סימניות שתרצו לעמודים שחשוב לכם לשמור
- הדגשת ציטוטים במספר צבעים
- ריכוז כל המחשבות, הסימניות וההדגשות במקום אחד

bluejetty:00058446:ios.description:
SCHIPHOL AIRPORT APP WITH PUSH NOTIFICATIONS AND APPLE WATCH APP
Do you fly from or to Amsterdam Schiphol Airport? With this app you can easily look up flight information and you are immediately informed through a push notification in the event your flight has any change in flight information. Even before the pilot knows. We also provide you with a convenient Apple Watch app.
SCHIPHOL IS A MULTI-AWARD WINNING APP
The previous edition of our Schiphol Airport App is the best travel app according to the Dutch Automobile Association (ANWB) and iCreate Magazine.
"We'd wish all iPhone apps were like this one: the app excels in ease of use, simplicity, clarity and has a very attractive presentation. The program is a great solution for people who often fly through Schiphol." [1]
"This is the app I've been looking out for" and "Absolute must for frequent travelers and airport visitors," is what travelers at Amsterdam Schiphol Airport are saying. [2]
SOME FEATURES
- Access to status, departure/arrival times, and other practical information such as hall, luggage belt and gate information
- View information on both departures and arrivals
- You are kept up to date with the latest flight information through push notifications in realtime
- Receive updates if gate, luggage belt, status, time, runway or airplane changes
- New in this edition is the display of plane type, plane registration number and the phone of the airline
- Also new is that you can open a flight in several flight tracking apps with just one tap!
- Simply the best and most accurate app on flight information for Schiphol Airport
- Access the most important flight information from your Apple Watch
CONTACT
If you have any question at all, you can always contact us by emailing us at app@schipholapp.nl. There is no point in asking questions by leaving a review, due to the fact we can not contact you because your personal contact details are not visible to us.
DISCLAIMER
No rights can be derived from the information in this app. We as developers however have an excellent track record. The previous edition of our app was rated with an 4,5 stars average. We continuously improve the app and strive to best the best available flight information for Amsterdam Airport Schiphol.
[1] iCreate Magazine, issue 17, 2010, page 94-95
[2] http://www.anwb.nl/vakantie/reizen-magazine/archief,/2010/juli/Top-5-reis-applicaties-voor-je-iPhone.html

bluejetty:00073580:ios.description:
Saddle up! And let the rodeo stampede begin!
Hold your horses! You are not going to want to miss this horse racing experience. It is the fastest, silliest, most challenging race master game to exist. Enjoy the breathtaking views of new environments and unlock dozens of new locations around the world–from the star stable in Western America to the Safari Desert in the Middle East. 
Upgrade the race track after each win and become the best horse riding jockey in the world.
It is not easy to cross the finish line, but when you do, the photo finish is spectacular. Make sure to speed by your competitors and avoid crashing into the turning race tracks. 
Feel the need to test your jockey skills? You’ll get practice, speed, jumps and a whole lot more in this addictive simulation race master game that’s as intuitive as it is outrageous. Horse Race Master 3D is like Rival Stars but easier to play and offers more excitement than one jockey can handle. 
Be fast and furious while practicing your equestrian racing skills and play this simulation game on-the-go, anywhere and anytime. There is no wifi required and you can play again and again for free. 
Your horse riding aptitude will be put to the test in increasingly harder levels and daily challenges. Become a champion at horse racing and play the ultimate race master game. If you have already completed rival stars and star stable, you will never get enough of Horse Master Race 3D. 
To opt out of CrazyLabs sales of personal information as a California resident, please visit the settings page within this app. For more information visit our Privacy Policy: https://crazylabs.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00068546:ios.description:
O ConectABR é um aplicativo exclusivo da ABR Síndicos Profissionais e está revolucionando a maneira como condomínios são administrados levando comodidade, transparência e economia.
O aplicativo ConectABR pode ser utilizado por Síndicos, Porteiros, Moradores e possui diversos recursos, dentre os principais:
• AVISOS: Comunicados enviados pelos síndicos de forma personalizada individual, por torres ou a todos os moradores que recebem online através de notificações push via aplicativo no celular ou portal na web.
• RESERVAS: Moradores realizam reservas dos espaços comuns (churrasqueiras, salão de festas…) através do app ConectABR. Chega de ligar na portaria ou síndico para consultar a agenda dos espaços.
• CORRESPONDÊNCIAS: Ansioso pela entrega da encomenda que está para chegar? Porteiros tiram fotos dos pacotes e o morador recebe um QRCode para retirada do mesmo na portaria. Chega de caderninhos com letras que ninguém entende.
• ACESSOS: “Diarista Maria chegou em seu condomínio” essa é a notificação que você recebe no seu app ConectABR quando alguém chega na sua casa! Todo o controle de entrada e saída do condomínio registrado! Chega de falhas de seguranças, torne seu patrimônio mais seguro e valorizado.
• CHAMADOS: Viu uma lâmpada queimada no seu bloco? Abra o app ConectABR, tire uma foto e envie para sua gestão na hora! Registre suas dúvidas, sugestões, manutenções, reclamações e solicitações. Chega de livros de ocorrências e exposições desnecessárias com vizinhos!
• MANUTENÇÕES: Fique por dentro de quando irá acontecer aquela limpeza da Caixa D'Água ou Dedetização e se programe para as manutenções do condomínio. Chega de transtornos e falhas de comunicação em manutenções, estejam antenados a todas as manutenções preventivas e corretivas.
• DOCUMENTOS: Tenha de forma fácil, ágil e transparente acesso a todos os documentos importantes do seu condomínio, como contratos assinados, comunicados internos, ATAs, Regulamento Interno, Convenção, Balancetes, Extratos Bancários e muito mais…
Quer mais? Vote em enquetes do condomínio com velocidade na palma de sua mão! Veja os benefícios de serviços e seguros exclusivos para seu condomínio, veja a agenda das próximas assembleias, saiba quem são os funcionários do condomínio com nome e fotos e fique mais tranquilo além de poder chamá-los pelo nome, e muito mais!
Contrate já a ABR Síndicos Profissionais para administrar seu condomínio e tenha acesso gratuito a esse excelente aplicativo exclusivo, você merece essa comodidade, transparência e economia!

bluejetty:00158622:ios.description:
Wanna talk to a psychologist but you don't have any free time to go to the hospital? OOCA, are here, the alternative choice for the tele mental health service in your phone!
OOCA is easy to use, convenient and confidential. A whole package in one app! Just download us, login, choose your personal psychiatrist or psychologist and date/time you prefer, make a payment, then BRAVO, your appointment awaits!
OOCA is a mental health service platform for the individuals and organizations. Our psychiatrists and psychologists are qualified for you and those who you care about. We believe that every problem disturbing you can be prevented and fixed. OOCA volunteers to be a part of your journey to conquer it all. 
Because you are important.
What matters to you, it’s okay, we’ll listen. 
Relationship issues, love, work-life balance, self-improvement, feeling depressed, burnout at work or school, you can try to make it better by starting a conservation with our qualified psychiatrists or psychologists just a few clicks away! 
Why OOCA?
Our mental health professionals have an array of expertise, including: 
- Licensed psychiatrists. (Verified by The Medical Council of Thailand.)
- Licensed clinical psychologists. (Verified by Thai Clinical Psychologist Association.)
- Counseling psychologist with a master’s degree or higher in counseling psychology.
***OOCA has more than 100 mental health professionals, the highest number in Thailand for the digital mental wellness platform.
Our past clients
OOCA offers services to individuals of more than 120,000 users and businesses as a mental wellness solution for employees. We are currently taking care of more than 76,000 employees of prestigious Thai corporates and companies such as Bank of Thailand, Chevron, SCG Chemicals, Kasikorn Bank and more of leading organizations in Thailand.
Who is OOCA?
OOCA is a tele mental health application from Thailand, providing counseling services via video calls with mental health professionals for individuals and corporate clients. Here at OOCA, everything will remain confidential and secured. Our goal is to make mental health topic general in our society.
We are leading progression in the health-tech start-up scene and aim to embrace technology to recreate mental-health wellness/awareness globally and look forward to bring in foreign professionals on our platform in order to provide ex-pat services and also regional expansion. 
-----------------
OOCA. It's Okay. Let's talk.
-----------------

bluejetty:00145534:ios.description:
The revolutionary photo and gallery cleaner designed to bring a fresh and creative approach to clean up your camera roll. While other photo cleaner apps exist, none compare to the simplicity, enjoyment, and style that Swipe Clean brings to photo, video, screenshot, camera roll cleaning on a month-by-month basis.
Save your time – we've got the answer! While other apps claim to swiftly delete photos, none delivered the magic we craved!
How does Swipe Clean operate? It's as easy as a swipe! Swipe right to preserve a photo or video, left to delete photo or video. Correct any mistakes with a simple tap, or explore a picture's metadata on top right corner. Once you've reviewed all the photos for the month(even without reviewing full month you can quick delete already reviewed files), take a final look to decide which ones to keep and which to delete. When you're done, the month gets crossed out, but you can revisit any month whenever you want.
But that's not all:
• Similar/Duplicate photo remover: Swipe Clean leverages advanced algorithms to analyze your similar/duplicate photos to keep your gallery cleaner.
• Filtering: Swipe Clean offers extensive filtering options, allowing you to tailor your cleaning experience. Choose between cleaning Videos, Photos, Screenshots. 
• Date range: There's a date range feature, enabling you to select photos, videos, screenshots within a specific date range for efficient organization. 
• Quick Clean already swiped files: There is also a cool feature if your camera roll for a specific month is too big, then you can quick delete already reviewed files without swiping all the photos! And you can always come back later to clean the rest of the photos.
• Privacy matters: Clean your photos offline, keeping memories on your device.
• Share: Instantly share your favorite photo with ease!
• Contact manage: Merge duplicate contacts, Delete incomplete contacts and contacts multi delete.
• Similar/Duplicate video detect.
• Video Compressor: Compress videos without loosing quality, on-device.
.. and we continually introduce exciting new features!
Swipe Clean transforms the task of cleaning into a fun and engaging experience!
If you prefer a different approach, or even if you love going month by month, you'll appreciate our new On This Day feature. This feature stays at the top of your Swipe Clean home screen, updating with photos from the same date in previous years, allowing you to relive and decide.
Keep your memory, phone, device, and storage clutter-free with Swipe Clean photo manager your all in all storage cleaner.
Swipe Clean breathes life into your memories while providing the camera roll cleaning and saving storage solution you've been searching for. It's the app that turns photo cleaning into a genuinely enjoyable experience!
Transform your photo gallery with Swipe Clean. Download our phone cleaner now for more organized experience!

bluejetty:00075092:android.description:
"Sir, our troops have been deployed, waiting for your order!" Play this strategy game Port War and conquer the world by leading troops to capture the territory! Command your troops and occupy all states. This cell battle game can train your logic ability and reaction speed.
Port War allows you to fight against armies, solve strategic puzzles to beat your rivals and expand your superiority in the world arena. Be smart and brave in this tactical and logical conquest, each of your actions will have consequences. Think strategically and react quickly to conquer states and territories in the epic clash game! Lead your army to victory in the epic battle game, be a winner in the war strategy!
🏁 Interesting gameplay. At the beginning of the game, you can get small units, expand your troop through occupation, choose the offensive target, gather the power of the troop to capture more territory, and finally win!
🏁 Variety of skins. You can freely choose the shape of the building, the type of fighter, and the color of the base.
🏁 Gold coin shop. Gold coins can be obtained by means of victory, offline rewards, etc., and gold coins can be used to increase the number and speed.
⚔️ Get the Port Game started!
Tap the screen and pick the color of your port
Tap on the base and swipe to select the target, and occupy a new base
Try to win and collect the coins to level up, accelerate the producing speed and marching speed
Playing 1v1 on first levels and versus more competitors on further levels
This war simulator demands tactics, you need to work your brain. Ready to complete this great conquest and make your domination story? Then download the game to begin your territories expansion.

bluejetty:00187497:ios.summary:
Grow the money you earn on Lyft with cashback and other perks
Designed exclusively for drivers on the Lyft platform, the Lyft Direct app gives you access to financial tools that help you manage your money.
Instant Payouts: Get your earnin
bluejetty:00187497:ios.description:
Grow the money you earn on Lyft with cashback and other perks
Designed exclusively for drivers on the Lyft platform, the Lyft Direct app gives you access to financial tools that help you manage your money.
Instant Payouts: Get your earnings immediately after each ride directly into a business bank account.
Earn Cashback: Receive 1-10% cashback on gas when you pay at the pump, 1-12% on public EV charging and additional rewards on groceries, dining, and more.
Wellness Perks by Avibra: Active drivers unlock free life and accident insurance, support for your well-being, and more.
Grow Your Savings: Set up automatic savings with a high-yield savings account that earns you interest.*
Balance Protection: Eligible drivers can access $50-$200 to cover unexpected expenses when you need it most.
Spend Insights: Monitor your average daily or monthly spending and allows you to create custom budgets.
The Lyft Direct Business Mastercard® debit card is issued by Stride Bank, N.A., member FDIC, pursuant to a license by Mastercard International. The Lyft Direct application is subject to eligibility. Once you are approved for a Lyft Direct business debit account and log into your Lyft Direct app, we'll automatically start sending your payouts to your Lyft Direct business account after every ride and trip. You can update your payout method in your Driver app.
Lyft Direct is designed for business use and may not be maintained for personal, family or household purposes. Maximum account balance and other limits, terms and conditions apply. 
Ride fare earnings will be sent after each ride. There may be instances where funding is delayed, for example if there is a system error, Express Drive rental fees are due, or an investigation is underway regarding the security of your account. Tips will be sent based on the Rider’s selection, which may take place up to 24 hours after the ride is completed.
Gas, grocery, restaurant and public EV charging merchant classification is subject to Mastercard rules. For cashback on gas, only payments made at the pump are eligible as payment inside the gas station is not generally eligible for cashback. Cashback rewards are earned for select purchases using your Lyft Direct business debit card and become available for redemption as those purchases settle. Payments via third-party apps are not eligible for cashback. Use your Lyft Direct business debit card to pay. Reward categories and amounts subject to change without notice. 
Wellness Perks is powered by Avibra and subject to eligibility for active Lyft Direct users. To be considered active, you must have received a payout to your Lyft Direct card within the last 60 days. Wellness Perks are subject to change without notice; select services are limited by state residency.
Interest is offered only on the optional savings account that you may sign up and open along with your Lyft Direct business account. Rates are variable and may change at any time without notice before or after the account is opened at our sole discretion. Additional terms and conditions apply.
Balance Protection is only available to select Lyft Direct cardholders with enabled instant payouts to the card after every trip. Eligibility requirements for Balance Protection subject to change without notice. Terms and conditions apply.
See the Stride Bank Account Agreement, Payfare Program Terms, and E-SIGN Agreement for details, including account fees, transaction limits, and restrictions due to the business nature of the Lyft Direct account. Payfare’s Privacy Policy outlines how Payfare will use your personal information. Payfare is a financial technology company.
Banking services are provided by Stride Bank, N.A.

bluejetty:00099272:ios.description:
AllWomenStalk brings you a fast, elegant way to enjoy lifestyle stories on iPhone and iPad.
Discover thoughtfully curated articles across fashion, beauty, wellness, relationships, self-care, travel, and everyday inspiration. The app is designed to feel calm, readable, and easy to explore—so you can focus on the content, not the interface.
Whether you’re browsing casually or looking for something specific, AllWomenStalk helps you find stories that fit your interests and your moment.
⌘ Latest feed
A clean, image-forward reading experience that highlights fresh stories without clutter.
⌘ Discover by category
Jump straight into topics you care about, from style and beauty to wellness and relationships.
⌘ Search
Quickly find articles by keyword when you’re looking for something specific.
⌘ Bookmarks
Save articles you love to read later. Bookmarks are stored on your device, with optional sign-in to sync across devices.
⌘ Sharing
Share article links easily from the reader.
⌘ Reading settings
Adjust text size for a more comfortable reading experience.
⌘ Home Screen widget
See a randomly selected story from your recent cache, refreshed on a schedule for quick inspiration at a glance.
⌘ Optional account
Signing in is optional. If you choose to create an account, you can sync bookmarks across devices and access profile-related features.
We’re continuously refining the experience with performance improvements, design tweaks, and new features. Keep the app updated to enjoy the latest updates.
AllWomenStalk is built to be simple, useful, and enjoyable—just open it and start reading.

bluejetty:00092312:ios.description:
Embark on your law enforcement journey with the PELLETB Law Enforcement Test app! Designed by seasoned police instructors, this comprehensive platform equips you with expertly crafted practice questions, realistic exam simulations, and personalized study plans. Prepare confidently for the POST Entry-Level Law Enforcement exam and take your first step toward a rewarding career!
Key Features:
Expertly Crafted Questions: Access a vast pool of practice questions that reflect the actual structure and content of the POST (Peace Officer Standards and Training) exam. These questions cover all exam topics.
Realistic Simulations: Experience the exam environment with our timed practice sessions. These simulations mimic real exam conditions, helping you refine your time management skills and build the confidence needed to perform under pressure on test day.
Detailed Explanations: Each question is accompanied by comprehensive explanations that clarify the reasoning behind correct answers. This feature reinforces core concepts and deepens your understanding, making it easier to remember key information.
Focused Study Plans: Tailor your preparation with flexible study plans that adapt to your unique learning preferences. Whether you prefer in-depth reviews of specific subjects or complete practice exams, our app allows you to customize your study experience for maximum efficiency.
Track Your Progress: Utilize advanced analytics to monitor your performance over time. Identify areas that require more attention and track your improvement as you move closer to the exam date. This feature keeps you informed and motivated throughout your study journey.
Stay Updated: We understand the importance of keeping up with the latest exam developments. Our app is regularly updated to reflect any changes in the POST exam format or content, ensuring you always have the most relevant study materials at your fingertips.
Why Choose PELLETB Law Enforcement Test:
Expert-Led Development: Our app is crafted by seasoned police instructors and exam experts who understand the ins and outs of the POST exam. Their insights ensure that every question and learning tool is relevant and effective, giving you the best chance of success.
Comprehensive Learning Experience: With a diverse range of topics covered, our app provides a holistic approach to your preparation. 
Realistic Exam Preparation: The app includes practice simulations that closely mimic the actual exam environment.
Personalized Study Plans: We recognize that every learner is unique. Our flexible study plans adapt to your individual needs, allowing you to focus on areas where you need the 
most improvement. This tailored approach maximizes your study efficiency and effectiveness.
With the PELLETB Law Enforcement Test app, you’re not just preparing for an exam - you’re setting the stage for a successful career in law enforcement.

All product and company names are trademarks™ or registered® trademarks of their respective holders. Use of them does not imply any affiliation with or endorsement by them. This app is an independent resource created to assist individuals in preparing for the Entry-Level Law Enforcement Test Battery. The content provided is for educational purposes only and is not an official study guide or endorsed material. 
Download now and take the first decisive step toward achieving your professional goals as a police officer!

bluejetty:00075639:ios.summary:

# Features for Apple Watch:
• Supports Cloud mode for those who want to use WhatsApp while running or swimming with only their Apple Watch on their wrist. In Cloud mode, it works even if your phon
bluejetty:00075639:ios.description:
Use WhatsApp on your Apple Watch or iPad!
# Features for Apple Watch:
• Supports Cloud mode for those who want to use WhatsApp while running or swimming with only their Apple Watch on their wrist. In Cloud mode, it works even if your phone is not nearby.
• Supports Pairing mode for general users. In pairing mode, your phone must be with your Apple Watch.
• Supports Push notifications in Cloud mode.
• Access your WhatsApp 1:1 chats and group chats from your Apple Watch.
• Send text messages and VOICE messages.
• Watch HD-quality image messages on your watch.
• Listen to VOICE messages on your watch.
• Play VIDEO messages on your watch.
• Reply to chats with the QWERTY keyboard, Quick Replies, Dictation, and Scribble.
• Various keyboards and input methods. Recent Watch models have the official QWERTY keyboard.
• This app embeds its own custom QWERTY keyboard for old watch models. The custom keyboard supports English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Icelandic, Polish, Czech, Slovak, Hungarian, Romanian, Croatian, Slovenian, Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Malay, Indonesian, Turkish, Vietnamese.
• Multi-language keyboard support: Select multiple languages and switch between them freely while typing.
• CUSTOMIZE your Quick Replies on your iPhone.
• Start a new chat from your contacts on your watch.
• Supports both phone number login and QR code login.
# Features for iPad:
• Provide WhatsApp Web version on iPad. Using one account on iPad is free.
• Major features of WhatsApp. (text, image, voice, video, contacts)
• Support up to 4 WhatsApp accounts on one iPad. (iPadOS 17 or higher)
Setting up the app for the first time only takes a few steps:
1. Open the app on your Apple Watch, and choose Pairing mode or Cloud mode.
2. Open the app on your Apple Watch, and choose Phone Number Login or QR code login.
3. Open WhatsApp on your paired iPhone.
4. In WhatsApp on your iPhone, go to [Settings] > [Linked Devices] > [Link a Device].
5. Login with your phone number or by scanning the QR code on the WatchTalk app on your Apple Watch using the WhatsApp app on your iPhone.
After that, you can use WhatsApp on your wrist.
You can use Pairing mode of this app with for free forever, but if you want to support the app's further development, please consider becoming a pro user.
This app is a 3rd-party app for WhatsApp. This app is not affiliated with WhatsApp and Meta Platforms, Inc.
This app does not collect any personal information. It collects crash reports and anonymous data for debugging purposes only.
• Contact: https://support.bitsbaker.com/watchtalk
• Privacy Policy: https://watchtalk.chat/pp/
• Terms & Conditions: https://watchtalk.chat/tnc/

bluejetty:00023992:ios.description:
PRESIDENT: SIMULATOR GAME
Take the Oval Office in the White House and keep it. In this tap-easy office simulator you are the president—campaign boss, deal-maker and crisis fixer. Run the government, pass bold policy, win every vote and protect that magic 270. Can you save Mr President, save the president from being impeached and win the White House again, or will rivals crush you in ruthless politics and war?
WHY PLAY
• Lead the nation: drive sweeping reforms, steady a restless cabinet, prove you’re the leader this country needs.
• Instant choices: tap Yes/No on bills, fire ministers, issue quick orders—small moves, huge impact.
• The election clock never stops. Raise cash, shape the next campaign, survive razor-thin run-offs.
• Live world map: sanctions or trade, troops or treaties—pure diplomacy or raw force.
• Two paths: shining republic and democracy—or ruthless dictator forging an empire.
• Become a White House tycoon—balance revenue, debt and growth like the sharpest boss games.
KEY MOMENTS
• Budget crashes, data leaks, oil shocks, coups—act fast and the world reacts.
• Social feed erupts with protests and memes; spin the story or get buried.
• Smarter rivals: the longer the president rules, the sharper media, courts and parliament.
• Recruit or sack advisers—top lawyer, media strategist, chief economist, cyber-security guru.
• Balance taxes, welfare, defense on a clean dashboard; watch GDP, prices and debt move live.
• Offline gains: upgrade ministries, media, security; prestige into fresh scenarios—fragile startup or iron-fist House of Power.
Love iCivics, Politics and War, tycoon hits or other boss games? Draft the law, call the shot, write the headline.
You are Mr President—rule wisely, or history votes you out.

bluejetty:00068076:ios.description:
The current paper-based process for the UNJSPF Certificate of Entitlement to prove a retiree’s/beneficiary’s eligibility for continued pension caters to over 70 thousand retirees and beneficiaries located in more than 190 countries. As it uses postal services, the process is very slow and cumbersome.
The App uses facial biometric technology, liveness check and geo-location to submit a Digital Certificate of Entitlement to a secure blockchain. Use of location makes it possible for retirees and beneficiaries paid under the two-track to also use the app.
All user data is stored securely either in the App or in data centres protected by UN Privileges and Immunity. No cloud-based services are used for processing of user information.
The paper-based CE will continue to be an option for the retires/beneficiaries who cannot/ do not want to use the app.

bluejetty:00075967:ios.description:
Dread Rune Is a roguelike RPG with 3d graphics and lots of variety and replayability. Every game is unique, with seven different playable characters, randomized levels and enemies, and over 130 items to collect and use. The game is simple to get into, but has lots of depth. Mastering of weapons, combos and strategic use of items will be required to win. 
Dread Rune includes:
- High replayability: Randomly generated levels, enemies, and items. No two games are the same!
- 12 hero classes: Adventurer, Pirate, Mage, Drunk, Conjurer, Lord,Pump-King, Blink, Ranger, Soul Mage, Necromancer and Chef. Each hero has a unique ability, starting stats and items.
- 5 distinct dungeon regions: Each with unique enemies and environments 
- Over 130 different items: including powerful runes, scrolls, weapons, and armour.
- 30+ different enemies, 10 different traps, and 5 bosses to test your skills.
- A destructible environment, create your own path through the dungeon.
- Character upgrades that persist across runs: Damage, Health, Stamina, Speed, Dash Speed, Carry Capacity and Special Cooldown.
- Random events, sometimes good, mostly bad, discover all 18 of these encounters
- Updates, with new content roughly every 6 months.

Build, compose, and organize rosters for Warhammer 40K, Age of Sigmar, The Horus Heresy, Kill Team, and more with Forces — a beautifully designed app that transforms how you create and manage your armies. Never build an army list manually again!

bluejetty:00164093:ios.description:
With Shop Apotheke / Redcare Pharmacy you always have your pharmacy and drugstore at hand. Order medicines, beauty and care products and many other products conveniently at low prices, fill your prescription or e-prescription (E-Rezept) and get online advice from a doctor.
We offer everything you need. Discover a huge selection with over 100,000 products and have your order delivered quickly to your home. With our app, we can deliver your orders to the following countries: Germany, Austria, Italy, Switzerland, Belgium and France.
● E-prescription on your health insurance card: Redeem your e-prescription digitally now
All you need is your German health insurance card and the Shop Apotheke app!
How do you redeem an e-prescription with your electronic health card?
● Open the Shop Apotheke app.
● Hold your health insurance card next to it.
● And everything will be delivered to your home quickly.
The e-prescription (eRx) has been officially launched in Germany.
Now you can easily and quickly redeem your e-prescription in the Shop Apotheke App. And the delivery is also quickly.
What are the advantages of the Shop Apotheke / Redcare Pharmacy app?
● Choose from a huge selection of medicine, beauty and care products & much more
● Collect your prescription or e-prescription safely and conveniently
● Get your delivery very fast with Now! service
● Enjoy regular discounts and voucher promotions
● Log in safely and securely
● Compare prices on the go using our barcode scanner
We offer a wide range of products in the categories:
■ Medications & prescription medicines
■ Baby & family
■ Beauty & care
■ Nutrition, sports & weight loss
■ Homeopathy & natural products
■ Care & Medical supply store

bluejetty:00043162:ios.description:
Experience the most comprehensive Shia Islamic app in 20 languages. Access the Quran with 75 translations, 12 reciters, 1,000+ Duas, 7,000 hadiths, 13,000 books, and eulogies. 
Navigate effortlessly with the AI-powered assistant—just ask to open Dua Kumayl or explore any feature instantly. 
Use tools like Qibla Finder, Habib Meet, Talk, Calendar, and Ahkam for all your needs.
Habib Quran
- Complete Quran with Arabic text, Shia translations, and transliteration.
- 12 renowned reciters offering verse-by-verse recitations.
- Word-by-word translation for a deeper understanding.
- Group and individual Quran completion (Khatm) options.
- Bookmarking and multilingual search functionality.
Habib Duas
- Over 1,000 prayers from Mafātīh al-Jinān and Sahifa Sajjadiya.
- Daily access to recommended prayers and deeds via calendar integration.
- Audio recitation for every prayer excerpt.
Habib Ahkam
- Comprehensive Islamic rulings from various scholars.
- Detailed guidance on women’s and teenagers’ issues.
- Available in text, audio, and video formats with bookmarking and search features.
Habib Library
- A vast collection of 13,000 books in multiple languages.
- Explore topics like Islamic jurisprudence, Mahdaviat, lifestyle, women’s and girls’ issues, Imam Hussain, and more.
- Organized collections for easy navigation and tailored learning.
Habib Calendar
- Access daily recommended deeds, prayers, and hadiths.
- Identify Qamar dar Aqrab dates for better spiritual planning.
- Includes all Shia religious occasions and national events for different countries.
- Seamlessly integrates with other services to offer relevant prayers and hadiths on each occasion.
Habib Hadith
- A curated collection of over 7,000 hadiths, expanding daily.
- Receive daily tailored hadith recommendations based on your age, interests, and life challenges.
- A highly engaging feature designed to inspire and guide users with personalized insights.
Habib Hussainiya
- Access thousands of eulogies, speeches, and Islamic art pieces.
- Organized collections for easy browsing and cultural enrichment.
- Multilingual content, including English-subtitled videos.
Habib Meet
- Join interactive rooms on topics like hadith discussions, workshops, and educational classes.
- Participate in live sessions with thousands of attendees, ask questions, and engage in meaningful conversations.
AI-Powered Assistant
- Navigate the app effortlessly with your personal assistant.
- Ask it to open Dua Kumayl, find a specific hadith, or recommend a book on Mahdaviat.
- Available in 20 languages, it connects you instantly to every feature of the app with a single command.
- Simplifies access to prayers, Quran recitations, books, and hadiths, making your spiritual journey more intuitive and fulfilling.

bluejetty:00085054:ios.description:
Designed by active traders for active traders, Questrade Edge is Questrade's most powerful way to trade on the go, commission-free¹. With lightning-fast speed and a sleek user interface, you'll have access to advanced order types including stop orders, bracket orders, option orders and more.
Put the power of an advanced trading platform into the palm of your hand with Questrade Edge.
Questrade Edge is a dedicated trading platform that excels in placing complex orders. Plus, we will be continuously adding tools and capabilities to this platform, so keep your version updated to make sure you always have the latest features.
What makes Questrade Edge great:
- Trade stocks, ETFs and most options¹ commission-free
- Advanced order types including stop and trailing stop orders, option orders and bracket orders
- Creating multi-leg options orders on your mobile device has never been easier with an order entry layout dedicated to this order type
- Full-screen charting helps you analyze the performance of a stock, option or ETF, using your mobile device's landscape mode to help you dive into the details
- Order routing so you can choose which U.S. exchange your order goes to
- A fully customizable detail view for your watchlists, positions and orders pages, that allows you to choose and arrange over 30 data points to suit your needs
- Lightning-fast speed so you spend more time trading and less time waiting
- Smooth and straightforward design which makes placing advanced orders easier
- Helpful tools including event notifications, market news feed and more on the roadmap to be added in future versions
- Alerts that are synced across your devices
- Access to accounts for which you're an Authorized Trader
Download Questrade Edge and trade like the active trader you are.
Disclosure

For options, $0 pricing applies only to contract fees for U.S.-listed equity options traded online; U.S. index options are subject to a US$0.99 per-contract fee, and Canadian-listed equity and index options are subject to a CA$0.99 per-contract fee. Developed by an olympic weightlifter, Barbell Loader is for anyone who would rather focus on lifting, not math.
Barbell Loader and Calculator is for:
-Weightlifting
-Powerlifting
-Bodybuilding
-CrossFit
and everyone else who lifts weights.
This app is perfect for saving time at Weightlifting and Powerlifting competitions!
Features
BARBELL LOADER
-Load: Click on the plate buttons to load the bar yourself.
-Calculate: Type in a weight, and Barbell Loader will load the bar with either official IWF/IPF-colored kilogram plates or standard pound plates.
-Convert: Every weight is automatically converted between pounds and kilograms.
PERCENTAGES CALCULATOR
-Every weight has percentages calculated automatically that you can then load onto the bar.
SINCLAIR AND WILKS CALCULATOR
-Enter 2 out of 3 fields and the Calculator will resolve the third.
-For example, if you enter your Total Weight Lifted and Sinclair Score, the Calculator will tell you the Bodyweight needed.
REP MAX CALCULATOR
-Enter just the weight lifted and the repetitions and the Calculator will resolve everything from you 1 Rep Max to 10 Rep Max.
LOG
-Click a button, and Barbell Loader will log the current weight and time into a notepad that you can edit further.
ALSO:
-Customize your plate inventory.
-On/off switch for competition 2.5 kg collars.
-Set your bar weight.
-Create your own custom plates.
-Optimize the weight on the bar.
-Remove plates one at a time as necessary.
-And more!

apple-itunes:1531459685.description:
Dual Chat allows you to use WhatsApp on your iPad or access the same WhatsApp account on two devices.
You can also manage two different WhatsApp numbers on a single iPhone.
Similar to WhatsApp Web, this app serves as an extension of your phone, mirroring your WhatsApp messages and conversations. 
Your messages remain securely stored on your phone.
Using two WhatsApp accounts can be useful in various situations:
- Separating personal and work communication – one account for personal chats, another for work.
- Using a local and an international number – convenient for travelers and business professionals.
- Managing a business – one account for customers, another for the team.
- Keeping social circles separate – for example, one account for family and another for friends.
- Marketing and sales purposes – different accounts for different business activities.
How It Works:
1. Open Dual Chat to generate a QR code.
2. Scan this QR code using WhatsApp on your phone to sync your chats.
3. Find this option within WhatsApp under "Linked Devices."
Features:
* Secure access with Face ID and Touch ID.
* QR Code Scanner for quick setup.
* Dual chat functionality. 
Important
* Your phone must remain connected to the internet for Dual Chat to function properly.
* A subscription is required for full access to app features. 
Disclaimer
Dual Chat is an independent tool designed for use with WhatsApp. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WhatsApp Inc.

* Limited functionality is available without a subscription.
* Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the renewal date.
* Manage subscriptions in your iTunes account settings.

fedora-packages:fnlfmt/fnlfmt.name: fnlfmt
fedora-packages:fnlfmt/fnlfmt.description: Format your Fennel! The goal of `fnlfmt` is *not* to be The One Formatter that all Fennel programmers use to format their code. We assume that most of the time, Fennel programmers will use a text editor that already knows how to indent code correctly, and that `fnlfmt` supplements existing editor support in cases where for whatever reason the editor functionality cannot be used. This means that `fnlfmt` should be treated as one implementation of the standard format rather than being canonical itself. By design there is no way to configure it. When it comes to indentation, the choices it makes should be correct other than bugs or when new features are added to Fennel itself. When it comes to where the line breaks are inserted, it tries its best, but there are certainly cases where a human could do better. Sometimes when it comes to line breaks it will defer to the existing code where possible.

fdroid:tech.mmarca.openwatch.name: OpenWatch
fdroid:tech.mmarca.openwatch.summary: Sync Garmin and Wear OS watches and a Xiaomi scale to Health Connect. No cloud.
fdroid:tech.mmarca.openwatch.description:
OpenWatch pairs your watch and your scale with your phone and writes what they record to Health Connect. It is the devices half of OpenVitals: OpenVitals shows the data, OpenWatch is where it comes from.
Your data stays on your phone. There is no account, no cloud sync, no ads and no analytics, and the app has no internet permission. Everything travels over Bluetooth between the device and the phone.
What it does
* Garmin watches, over Garmin's own Bluetooth protocol: activities with their route, steps, distance, floors, calories, heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, breathing rate, VO2 max and sleep, written to Health Connect. Forward notifications, send alarms and the watch's settings, find your watch, control music, see your calendar and the weather on the wrist, and follow CoMaps navigation there. Measurements Health Connect cannot hold, such as stress, Body Battery and the sleep score, stay in the app's Watch Data screen.
* Wear OS watches, with the OpenWatch watch app: heart rate, steps, floors and workouts with their route recorded on the watch, synced to Health Connect on a tap or on a schedule, plus an estimated sleep session and the night's resting heart rate, heart rate variability and breathing rate. On a Samsung watch, if you switch them on, blood oxygen and skin temperature at night. The watch app offers tiles for heart rate, steps and floors.
* Xiaomi Body Composition Scale S400 and S400 Pro: every weigh-in saved to Health Connect as it happens, with the app open or closed, decoded from the scale's own broadcast with the key from your Xiaomi account. Weight and heart rate as measured; body fat, lean mass and body water estimated on the phone.
Why OpenWatch
* Private by design: no account, no cloud, no ads, no tracking
* Health Connect is the source of truth. Every record names OpenWatch as its source, and any Health Connect app can show it
* You choose each permission and can change it later
* Open source: the code, release notes and builds are public
Requirements
OpenWatch needs Health Connect. It is part of Android 14 and newer. On Android 13 and older, install the Health Connect app from Google Play. The Wear OS app needs Wear OS 3 or newer.
Health disclaimer
OpenWatch is for general wellness and information only. It is not a medical device and does not give medical advice. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease or medical condition. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
